scripts.title: Camera bobs when walking
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts. Looks best in first person.
scripts.about: The camera gently bobs up and down and side to side as you walk, faster when you run, like real footsteps.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these!
local BOB_HEIGHT = 0.25
local BOB_SIDE = 0.15

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local timer = 0
local connection
connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
		connection:Disconnect()
		return
	end
	local speed = (root.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude
	local onGround = humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
	if speed > 1 and onGround then
		timer += deltaTime * speed * 0.6 -- faster steps when faster
		local up = math.abs(math.sin(timer)) * BOB_HEIGHT
		local side = math.cos(timer) * BOB_SIDE
		humanoid.CameraOffset = humanoid.CameraOffset:Lerp(Vector3.new(side, up, 0), 0.3)
	else
		humanoid.CameraOffset = humanoid.CameraOffset:Lerp(Vector3.zero, 0.1) -- settle back
	end
end)

scripts.title: Camera looks at something important
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. A server script shows something with workspace:SetAttribute("CameraFocus", "BossDoor") (the name of a Part or Model in Workspace).
scripts.about: When the server names an object, everyone's camera swoops over to look at it for a few seconds (like "the door opened!") and then swoops back.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these!
local LOOK_TIME = 3
local DISTANCE = 25

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local busy = false

workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CameraFocus"):Connect(function()
	local name = workspace:GetAttribute("CameraFocus")
	local target = type(name) == "string" and workspace:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	if not target or busy then
		return
	end
	local position = target:IsA("Model") and target:GetPivot().Position or (target:IsA("BasePart") and target.Position)
	if not position then
		return
	end
	busy = true
	local startCFrame = camera.CFrame
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	-- Look from a spot above and in front of the object
	local viewFrom = position + Vector3.new(0, DISTANCE * 0.5, DISTANCE)
	local goTo = TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), { CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(viewFrom, position) })
	goTo:Play()
	goTo.Completed:Wait()
	task.wait(LOOK_TIME)
	local goBack = TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), { CFrame = startCFrame })
	goBack:Play()
	goBack.Completed:Wait()
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	busy = false
end)

scripts.title: Camera shake (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage and name it CameraShake. In a LocalScript: require(game.ReplicatedStorage.CameraShake).Shake(1, 0.5).
scripts.about: Shakes the player's camera for a moment (great for explosions, hits and landings), fading out smoothly.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CameraShake = {}

local strength = 0
local timeLeft = 0
local totalTime = 1
local bound = false

local function bind()
	if bound then
		return
	end
	bound = true
	-- Run right after Roblox moves the camera, and add a small wobble on top
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("CameraShake", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(deltaTime)
		if timeLeft <= 0 then
			return
		end
		timeLeft -= deltaTime
		local fade = math.max(timeLeft / totalTime, 0) -- 1 at the start, 0 at the end
		local power = strength * fade
		local t = os.clock() * 25
		-- math.noise gives smooth random wiggles
		local x = math.noise(t, 0.5) * power
		local y = math.noise(0.5, t) * power
		local roll = math.noise(t, t) * power * 0.05
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, y, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, roll)
	end)
end

-- Shake(power, seconds): power 0.5 is gentle, 2 is huge
function CameraShake.Shake(power, seconds)
	bind()
	-- A stronger shake replaces a weaker one that is still going
	if power >= strength * math.max(timeLeft / totalTime, 0) then
		strength = power
		totalTime = math.max(seconds or 0.5, 0.05)
		timeLeft = totalTime
	end
end

return CameraShake

scripts.title: Cutscene camera
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. Make a Folder named CutsceneShots in Workspace with anchored, invisible Parts named 1, 2, 3... facing where the camera should look. A server script replays it with player:SetAttribute("Cutscene", os.clock()).
scripts.about: The camera glides smoothly from shot 1 to shot 2 to shot 3 like a movie, with black bars, then gives control back.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these!
local SECONDS_PER_SHOT = 3
local PLAY_ON_JOIN = true

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local shotsFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("CutsceneShots")

-- Black movie bars at the top and bottom
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "CutsceneBars"
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Enabled = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
for _, y in ipairs({ 0, 0.88 }) do
	local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
	bar.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, y)
	bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.12)
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bar.Parent = gui
end

local playing = false
local function play()
	if playing then
		return
	end
	local shots = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(shotsFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if tonumber(part.Name) then
			table.insert(shots, part)
		end
	end
	table.sort(shots, function(a, b)
		return tonumber(a.Name) < tonumber(b.Name)
	end)
	if #shots == 0 then
		return
	end
	playing = true
	gui.Enabled = true
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	camera.CFrame = shots[1].CFrame
	for i = 2, #shots do
		local tween = TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(SECONDS_PER_SHOT, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), { CFrame = shots[i].CFrame })
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Wait()
	end
	task.wait(1)
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	gui.Enabled = false
	playing = false
end

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Cutscene"):Connect(function()
	if player:GetAttribute("Cutscene") then
		play()
	end
end)
if PLAY_ON_JOIN then
	player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	task.wait(1)
	play()
end

scripts.title: Death camera shows who got you
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts. Weapons must add a "creator" tag to victims (the weapon scripts here do).
scripts.about: When you are knocked out, the camera follows the player who did it until you respawn.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local humanoid = script.Parent:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	local killer = tag and tag.Value
	if not (killer and killer:IsA("Player") and killer ~= player) then
		return
	end
	local killerHumanoid = killer.Character and killer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not killerHumanoid then
		return
	end
	task.wait(1) -- see your own fall for a moment first
	-- Following their Humanoid makes the camera orbit around them
	camera.CameraSubject = killerHumanoid

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "DeathCam"
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") -- goes away by itself when you respawn
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 60)
	label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360, 40)
	label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Text = "Watching " .. killer.DisplayName
	label.Parent = gui
end)

scripts.title: Field of view grows with speed
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.
scripts.about: The faster you move, the wider the camera view gets, so running, falling and driving feel really fast.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these!
local NORMAL_FOV = 70
local MAX_FOV = 100
local SPEED_FOR_MAX = 120 -- studs per second for the widest view

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local speed = root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude or 0
	local fraction = math.clamp((speed - 16) / (SPEED_FOR_MAX - 16), 0, 1) -- normal walking is about 16
	local goal = NORMAL_FOV + (MAX_FOV - NORMAL_FOV) * fraction
	-- Ease toward the goal so the view never jumps
	camera.FieldOfView += (goal - camera.FieldOfView) * math.min(deltaTime * 5, 1)
end)

scripts.title: Fixed security-style room cameras
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. Put anchored, invisible Parts in a Folder named RoomCameras in Workspace, one in a corner of each room.
scripts.about: The camera jumps to whichever corner camera is closest and can see you, and watches you from there, like an old horror game.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local cams = workspace:WaitForChild("RoomCameras")

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

-- Pick the closest camera part that has a clear line to the player
local function bestCamera(root)
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { cams, player.Character }
	local best, bestDistance = nil, math.huge
	for _, cam in ipairs(cams:GetChildren()) do
		if cam:IsA("BasePart") then
			local offset = root.Position - cam.Position
			if offset.Magnitude < bestDistance and not workspace:Raycast(cam.Position, offset, params) then
				best, bestDistance = cam, offset.Magnitude
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local current = nil
local checkTimer = 0
RunService:BindToRenderStep("FixedRoomCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(deltaTime)
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return
	end
	checkTimer -= deltaTime
	if checkTimer <= 0 or not current then
		checkTimer = 0.25 -- do not raycast every single frame
		current = bestCamera(root) or current
	end
	if current then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(current.Position, root.Position)
	end
end)

scripts.title: Isometric camera
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.
scripts.about: A far-away diagonal camera with a narrow view that makes your game look like a neat isometric strategy or puzzle game; scroll to zoom.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Settings: change these!
local ANGLE_AROUND = 45 -- degrees around the player
local ANGLE_DOWN = 35 -- degrees looking down
local FOV = 15 -- a small field of view from far away looks flat and neat
local MIN_DISTANCE, MAX_DISTANCE = 150, 500

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local distance = 250

-- Mouse wheel zooms in and out
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
		distance = math.clamp(distance - input.Position.Z * 25, MIN_DISTANCE, MAX_DISTANCE)
	end
end)

RunService:BindToRenderStep("IsometricCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return
	end
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	camera.FieldOfView = FOV
	local rotation = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(ANGLE_AROUND), 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-ANGLE_DOWN), 0, 0)
	local target = root.Position
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(target + rotation.LookVector * -distance) * rotation
end)

scripts.title: Over the shoulder camera
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Moves the camera over your right shoulder like a third person shooter; press Q to swap to the left shoulder.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these!
local SIDE = 2 -- studs to the side
local UP = 0.5

local humanoid = script.Parent:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local right = true

local function apply()
	local offset = Vector3.new(right and SIDE or -SIDE, UP, 0)
	-- CameraOffset moves the camera without changing where the character is
	TweenService:Create(humanoid, TweenInfo.new(0.25), { CameraOffset = offset }):Play()
end

ContextActionService:BindAction("SwapShoulder", function(_, state)
	if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		right = not right
		apply()
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end, true, Enum.KeyCode.Q)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("SwapShoulder", "Swap")

humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("SwapShoulder")
end)

apply()

scripts.title: Photo mode free camera
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. Works on computers with a keyboard and mouse.
scripts.about: Press P to detach the camera and fly it around with W, A, S, D, Q and E (hold right mouse to look) to take cool screenshots; press P again to go back.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")

-- Settings: change these!
local SPEED = 30
local LOOK_SPEED = 0.3

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local active = false
local yaw, pitch = 0, 0
local hiddenGuis = {}

local MOVE_KEYS = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.W] = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), [Enum.KeyCode.S] = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
	[Enum.KeyCode.A] = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0), [Enum.KeyCode.D] = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
	[Enum.KeyCode.E] = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), [Enum.KeyCode.Q] = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0),
}

local function sinkKeys()
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink -- eat the key so the character stays still
end

local function setActive(on)
	active = on
	if on then
		local x, y = camera.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
		pitch, yaw = x, y
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		local keys = {}
		for key in pairs(MOVE_KEYS) do
			table.insert(keys, key)
		end
		ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority("PhotoModeKeys", sinkKeys, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value, table.unpack(keys))
		-- Hide the GUI for a clean picture
		for _, screen in ipairs(player.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do
			if screen:IsA("ScreenGui") and screen.Enabled then
				screen.Enabled = false
				table.insert(hiddenGuis, screen)
			end
		end
	else
		ContextActionService:UnbindAction("PhotoModeKeys")
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		for _, screen in ipairs(hiddenGuis) do
			screen.Enabled = true
		end
		hiddenGuis = {}
	end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, typing)
	if not typing and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		setActive(not active)
	end
end)

RunService:BindToRenderStep("PhotoMode", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(deltaTime)
	if not active then
		return
	end
	-- Hold right mouse to look around
	if UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition
		local delta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
		yaw -= math.rad(delta.X * LOOK_SPEED)
		pitch = math.clamp(pitch - math.rad(delta.Y * LOOK_SPEED), -1.5, 1.5)
	else
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	end
	local move = Vector3.zero
	for key, direction in pairs(MOVE_KEYS) do
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(key) then
			move += direction
		end
	end
	local rotation = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(pitch, yaw, 0)
	local position = camera.CFrame.Position + rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(move) * SPEED * deltaTime
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * rotation
end)

scripts.title: Security camera monitor
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. Add a Part named SecurityMonitor, and a Folder named SecurityCams with anchored Parts pointing their front face where each camera looks.
scripts.about: Use the monitor to look through the security cameras around your map, switching with Next and leaving with Exit.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local monitor = workspace:WaitForChild("SecurityMonitor")
local camsFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("SecurityCams")

-- A prompt made in a LocalScript only shows for this player
local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Watch cameras"
prompt.Parent = monitor

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SecurityCams"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Enabled = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
title.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 36)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)
title.Font = Enum.Font.Code
title.TextScaled = true
title.Parent = gui

local function makeButton(text, x)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	button.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 1, -20)
	button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 44)
	button.Text = text
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	button.Parent = gui
	return button
end
local nextButton = makeButton("Next", -70)
local exitButton = makeButton("Exit", 70)

local index = 1
local function showCam()
	local cams = camsFolder:GetChildren()
	if #cams == 0 then
		return
	end
	index = (index - 1) % #cams + 1
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	camera.CFrame = cams[index].CFrame
	title.Text = "CAM " .. index .. ": " .. cams[index].Name
end

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
	gui.Enabled = true
	showCam()
end)
nextButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	index += 1
	showCam()
end)
exitButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	gui.Enabled = false
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
end)

scripts.title: See your body in first person
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: In first person you normally become invisible; this keeps your arms, legs and body visible (but hides your head and hats so they do not block the view).
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

-- Parts we keep hidden: the head and anything attached to it (hats, hair, face)
local function isHeadStuff(part)
	if part.Name == "Head" then
		return true
	end
	local accessory = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory")
	if accessory then
		local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		local weld = handle and handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Weld")
		return weld ~= nil and weld.Part1 ~= nil and weld.Part1.Name == "Head"
	end
	return false
end

local connection
connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		connection:Disconnect()
		return
	end
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and not isHeadStuff(part) then
			-- Roblox sets this to 1 in first person; setting it back to 0 shows the part
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Side scroller (2D) camera
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. Build your level along the X direction (left and right).
scripts.about: Looks at your character from the side like a 2D platformer and keeps you on one line, so you can only run left and right and jump.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these!
local DISTANCE = 35 -- how far the camera is from the level
local HEIGHT = 4
local LANE_Z = nil -- the Z line players stay on (nil = wherever you spawn)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

RunService:BindToRenderStep("SideScroller", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return
	end
	LANE_Z = LANE_Z or root.Position.Z
	-- Keep the character on the lane (we control our own character, so this works here)
	local p = root.Position
	if math.abs(p.Z - LANE_Z) > 0.05 then
		root.CFrame = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0, LANE_Z - p.Z)
		local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(v.X, v.Y, 0)
	end
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	local focus = Vector3.new(p.X, p.Y + HEIGHT, LANE_Z)
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(focus + Vector3.new(0, 0, DISTANCE), focus)
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	LANE_Z = nil -- find the lane again after respawning
end)

scripts.title: Spectate other players
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.
scripts.about: A Spectate button lets you watch other players; use the arrow buttons to switch between them and Stop to go back to yourself.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "Spectate"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function makeButton(text, position, size)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	button.Position = position
	button.Size = size
	button.Text = text
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50)
	button.Parent = gui
	return button
end
local spectateButton = makeButton("Spectate", UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -20), UDim2.fromOffset(140, 40))
local prevButton = makeButton("<", UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 1, -20), UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40))
local nextButton = makeButton(">", UDim2.new(0.5, 130, 1, -20), UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40))

local watching = false
local index = 1

local function others()
	local list = {}
	for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if other ~= player and other.Character and other.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			table.insert(list, other)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function show()
	local list = others()
	prevButton.Visible = watching
	nextButton.Visible = watching
	if not watching or #list == 0 then
		watching = false
		prevButton.Visible, nextButton.Visible = false, false
		spectateButton.Text = "Spectate"
		local myHumanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		camera.CameraSubject = myHumanoid
		return
	end
	index = (index - 1) % #list + 1
	local target = list[index]
	-- CameraSubject is what the camera follows
	camera.CameraSubject = target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	spectateButton.Text = "Stop (" .. target.DisplayName .. ")"
end

spectateButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	watching = not watching
	show()
end)
prevButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	index -= 1
	show()
end)
nextButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	index += 1
	show()
end)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait()
	show()
end)
show()

scripts.title: Switch first and third person
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.
scripts.about: Press V (or tap the on-screen button on a phone) to switch between first person and the normal third person view.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local firstPerson = false

local function setFirstPerson(on)
	firstPerson = on
	if on then
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
	else
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
		-- Zoom back out a bit so you can see your character again
		player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 8
		task.wait()
		player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
	end
end

local function onAction(_, state)
	if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		task.spawn(setFirstPerson, not firstPerson) -- task.spawn: never wait inside an action callback
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

-- true = also make a button for touch screens
ContextActionService:BindAction("ToggleView", onAction, true, Enum.KeyCode.V, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR3)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("ToggleView", "View")

scripts.title: Top down camera
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.
scripts.about: The camera floats high above your character looking straight down, like a classic top down game.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these!
local HEIGHT = 50
local TILT = 0 -- 0 = straight down; try 15 for a slight angle

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

RunService:BindToRenderStep("TopDownCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return
	end
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	local target = root.Position
	-- Place the camera above the player, a little behind if tilted
	local offset = Vector3.new(0, HEIGHT, math.tan(math.rad(TILT)) * HEIGHT + 0.01)
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(target + offset, target)
end)

scripts.title: Zoom in with a scope
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.
scripts.about: Hold the right mouse button (or Z, or the Zoom button on a phone) to zoom way in with a round scope overlay and slower aiming.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local ZOOM_FOV = 20
local NORMAL_FOV = 70

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local normalSensitivity = UserInputService.MouseDeltaSensitivity

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "Scope"
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Enabled = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
-- A see-through circle with a thick black border looks like a scope
local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
ring.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
ring.SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeYY
ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ring.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner", ring).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Thickness = 600
stroke.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
stroke.Parent = ring

local function zoom(on)
	gui.Enabled = on
	TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { FieldOfView = on and ZOOM_FOV or NORMAL_FOV }):Play()
	-- Slower mouse while zoomed so aiming is easier
	UserInputService.MouseDeltaSensitivity = on and normalSensitivity * 0.3 or normalSensitivity
end

ContextActionService:BindAction("ScopeZoom", function(_, state)
	if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		zoom(true)
	elseif state == Enum.UserInputState.End or state == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
		zoom(false)
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end, true, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2, Enum.KeyCode.Z)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("ScopeZoom", "Zoom")

scripts.title: Zoom limits indoors and out
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. Optional: put see-through, CanCollide-off Parts covering your rooms in a Folder named IndoorZones.
scripts.about: Sets how far players can zoom out, and zooms the camera in closer automatically when they walk inside a building.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local OUTDOOR_MAX_ZOOM = 40
local INDOOR_MAX_ZOOM = 12
local MIN_ZOOM = 2

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild("IndoorZones")

player.CameraMinZoomDistance = MIN_ZOOM
player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = OUTDOOR_MAX_ZOOM

local function isInside(part, position)
	local offset = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	return math.abs(offset.X) <= half.X and math.abs(offset.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(offset.Z) <= half.Z
end

if not zones then
	return -- no indoor zones: just keep the outdoor limit
end

local wasInside = false
while true do
	task.wait(0.3)
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local inside = false
	if root then
		for _, zone in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
			if zone:IsA("BasePart") and isInside(zone, root.Position) then
				inside = true
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if inside ~= wasInside then
		wasInside = inside
		player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = inside and INDOOR_MAX_ZOOM or OUTDOOR_MAX_ZOOM
	end
end

scripts.title: /help lists all commands

local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

help.Name = "HelpCommand"

scripts.title: Admin chat commands
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and add your friends' UserIds to ADMINS (the game's owner is always an admin).
scripts.about: Gives admins chat commands: /heal, /kill, /speed and /goto, each followed by a player's name (or "me").
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

-- Settings: extra admins by UserId
local ADMINS = {}

local function isAdmin(player)
	return player.UserId == game.CreatorId or table.find(ADMINS, player.UserId) ~= nil
end

-- "me" means yourself; otherwise the first player whose name starts with the text
local function findPlayer(speaker, text)
	if not text or text == "" or string.lower(text) == "me" then
		return speaker
	end
	text = string.lower(text)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if string.sub(string.lower(player.Name), 1, #text) == text or string.sub(string.lower(player.DisplayName), 1, #text) == text then
			return player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function humanoidOf(player)
	return player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

-- Each command: what it does to the target player
local COMMANDS = {
	heal = function(admin, target)
		local humanoid = humanoidOf(target)
		if humanoid then
			humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
		end
	end,
	kill = function(admin, target)
		local humanoid = humanoidOf(target)
		if humanoid then
			humanoid.Health = 0
		end
	end,
	speed = function(admin, target, number)
		local humanoid = humanoidOf(target)
		if humanoid then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(number) or 16, 0, 200)
		end
	end,
	["goto"] = function(admin, target)
		local theirRoot = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if theirRoot and admin.Character then
			admin.Character:PivotTo(theirRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 4))
		end
	end,
}

for name, action in pairs(COMMANDS) do
	-- A TextChatCommand catches messages that start with its alias
	local command = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
	command.Name = "Admin_" .. name
	command.PrimaryAlias = "/" .. name
	command.Parent = TextChatService
	command.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
		local admin = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
		if not admin or not isAdmin(admin) then
			return
		end
		local words = string.split(message, " ")
		local target = findPlayer(admin, words[2])
		if target then
			action(admin, target, words[3])
			admin:SetAttribute("Notice", "/" .. name .. " used on " .. target.Name)
		else
			admin:SetAttribute("Notice", "No player found")
		end
	end)
end

scripts.title: Admin ranks (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ServerScriptService and name it Ranks. Other scripts use require(game.ServerScriptService.Ranks).IsAtLeast(player, "Mod").
scripts.about: One place to decide who is Owner, Admin, Mod or Player (by UserId or group rank), so every admin script agrees.
scripts.code:
local Ranks = {}

-- Settings: change these!
local LEVELS = { Player = 0, Mod = 1, Admin = 2, Owner = 3 }
local BY_USER_ID = {
	-- [123456789] = "Admin",
}
local GROUP_ID = 0 -- your group's id, or 0 for none
local BY_GROUP_RANK = {
	-- group rank number (1 to 255) at or above which you get this level
	{ minRank = 250, level = "Admin" },
	{ minRank = 100, level = "Mod" },
}

local cache = {}

-- GetRank(player) returns "Owner", "Admin", "Mod" or "Player"
function Ranks.GetRank(player)
	if cache[player] then
		return cache[player]
	end
	local rank = "Player"
	if player.UserId == game.CreatorId then
		rank = "Owner"
	elseif BY_USER_ID[player.UserId] then
		rank = BY_USER_ID[player.UserId]
	elseif GROUP_ID ~= 0 then
		local ok, groupRank = pcall(function()
			return player:GetRankInGroup(GROUP_ID)
		end)
		if ok then
			for _, rule in ipairs(BY_GROUP_RANK) do
				if groupRank >= rule.minRank then
					rank = rule.level
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	cache[player] = rank
	player.AncestryChanged:Once(function()
		cache[player] = nil -- forget them when they leave
	end)
	return rank
end

-- IsAtLeast(player, "Mod") is true for Mods, Admins and the Owner
function Ranks.IsAtLeast(player, levelName)
	return LEVELS[Ranks.GetRank(player)] >= (LEVELS[levelName] or math.huge)
end

return Ranks

scripts.title: Announce command
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Use it with the Announcement banner GUI script so players see the message.
scripts.about: Admins type /announce followed by a message, and a big banner with that message slides onto everyone's screen.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")

-- Settings: extra admins by UserId (the owner always counts)
local ADMINS = {}

local function isAdmin(player)
	return player.UserId == game.CreatorId or table.find(ADMINS, player.UserId) ~= nil
end

local command = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
command.PrimaryAlias = "/announce"
command.Parent = TextChatService

command.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
	local admin = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
	if not admin or not isAdmin(admin) then
		return
	end
	local text = string.sub(message, #"/announce " + 1)
	if text == "" then
		return
	end
	-- Roblox requires filtering text that other players will see
	local ok, filtered = pcall(function()
		local result = TextService:FilterStringAsync(text, admin.UserId)
		return result:GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
	end)
	if ok then
		workspace:SetAttribute("Announcement", "") -- clear first so the same text can show twice
		workspace:SetAttribute("Announcement", filtered)
	end
end)

scripts.title: Announce to every server
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Use it with the Announcement banner GUI script. Only the game owner (and ADMINS) can use it.
scripts.about: The owner types /global followed by a message, and it shows as a banner in every running server of the game.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")

local ADMINS = {}
local TOPIC = "GlobalAnnouncement"

local function isAdmin(player)
	return player.UserId == game.CreatorId or table.find(ADMINS, player.UserId) ~= nil
end

-- Listen for messages from any server (including this one)
pcall(function()
	MessagingService:SubscribeAsync(TOPIC, function(packet)
		if type(packet.Data) == "string" then
			workspace:SetAttribute("Announcement", "")
			workspace:SetAttribute("Announcement", "[Global] " .. packet.Data)
		end
	end)
end)

local command = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
command.PrimaryAlias = "/global"
command.Parent = TextChatService

command.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
	local admin = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
	if not admin or not isAdmin(admin) then
		return
	end
	local text = string.sub(message, #"/global " + 1)
	if text == "" then
		return
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local filtered = TextService:FilterStringAsync(text, admin.UserId):GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPIC, filtered)
	end)
	admin:SetAttribute("Notice", ok and "Sent to all servers" or ("Failed: " .. tostring(err)))
end)

scripts.title: Ban command
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and add admin UserIds to ADMINS (the game's owner is always an admin).
scripts.about: Admins can type /ban Name to ban a player from your game, or /kick Name to only remove them from this server.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

-- Settings: change these!
local ADMINS = {}
local BAN_DAYS = 7 -- how long a ban lasts (use -1 for forever)

local function isAdmin(player)
	return player.UserId == game.CreatorId or table.find(ADMINS, player.UserId) ~= nil
end

local function findPlayer(text)
	text = string.lower(text or "")
	if text == "" then
		return nil
	end
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if string.sub(string.lower(player.Name), 1, #text) == text then
			return player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function makeCommand(alias, action)
	local command = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
	command.PrimaryAlias = alias
	command.Parent = TextChatService
	command.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
		local admin = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
		if not admin or not isAdmin(admin) then
			return
		end
		local target = findPlayer(string.split(message, " ")[2])
		if not target or isAdmin(target) then
			admin:SetAttribute("Notice", "Can't do that to them")
			return
		end
		action(admin, target)
	end)
end

makeCommand("/kick", function(admin, target)
	target:Kick("You were kicked by an admin.")
	admin:SetAttribute("Notice", "Kicked " .. target.Name)
end)

makeCommand("/ban", function(admin, target)
	-- BanAsync bans them from every server of your game
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		Players:BanAsync({
			UserIds = { target.UserId },
			ApplyToUniverse = true,
			Duration = BAN_DAYS < 0 and -1 or BAN_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60,
			DisplayReason = "You broke the game's rules.",
			PrivateReason = "Banned by " .. admin.Name,
			ExcludeAltAccounts = false,
		})
	end)
	admin:SetAttribute("Notice", ok and ("Banned " .. target.Name) or ("Ban failed: " .. tostring(err)))
end)

scripts.title: Chat tags and name colors
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. Server scripts give tags with player:SetAttribute("ChatTag", "VIP"). Only use one script that sets OnIncomingMessage.
scripts.about: Adds colored tags like [VIP] or [OWNER] in front of names in the chat, and colors names by team.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

-- Settings: tag name = color (as a hex code)
local TAG_COLORS = {
	OWNER = "#FF4040",
	ADMIN = "#FF8C00",
	VIP = "#FFD700",
	PREMIUM = "#B0B0FF",
}

local function tagFor(player)
	if player.UserId == game.CreatorId then
		return "OWNER"
	end
	local tag = player:GetAttribute("ChatTag")
	if type(tag) == "string" and tag ~= "" then
		return string.upper(tag)
	end
	if player.MembershipType == Enum.MembershipType.Premium then
		return "PREMIUM"
	end
	return nil
end

-- This runs for every message before it shows in the chat window
TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(message)
	local properties = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
	local source = message.TextSource
	local player = source and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(source.UserId)
	if not player then
		return properties
	end
	local prefix = message.PrefixText
	-- Color the name by team (if they are on one)
	if player.Team then
		prefix = string.format("<font color='#%s'>%s</font>", player.TeamColor.Color:ToHex(), prefix)
	end
	local tag = tagFor(player)
	if tag then
		local color = TAG_COLORS[tag] or "#FFFFFF"
		prefix = string.format("<font color='%s'>[%s]</font> %s", color, tag, prefix)
	end
	properties.PrefixText = prefix
	return properties
end

scripts.title: Freeze command
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and add admin UserIds to ADMINS (the owner always counts).
scripts.about: Admins type /freeze Name to trap a player in a block of ice so they cannot move, and /thaw Name to let them go.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local ADMINS = {}

local function isAdmin(player)
	return player.UserId == game.CreatorId or table.find(ADMINS, player.UserId) ~= nil
end

local function findPlayer(text)
	text = string.lower(text or "")
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if text ~= "" and string.sub(string.lower(player.Name), 1, #text) == text then
			return player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function freeze(target, on)
	local character = target.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local oldIce = character:FindFirstChild("AdminIce")
	if oldIce then
		oldIce:Destroy()
	end
	root.Anchored = on -- an anchored body cannot move at all
	if on then
		local ice = Instance.new("Part")
		ice.Name = "AdminIce"
		ice.Size = Vector3.new(5, 7, 5)
		ice.CFrame = root.CFrame
		ice.Anchored = true
		ice.CanCollide = false
		ice.Material = Enum.Material.Ice
		ice.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255)
		ice.Transparency = 0.4
		ice.Parent = character
	end
end

local function makeCommand(alias, on)
	local command = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
	command.PrimaryAlias = alias
	command.Parent = TextChatService
	command.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
		local admin = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
		if admin and isAdmin(admin) then
			local target = findPlayer(string.split(message, " ")[2])
			if target then
				freeze(target, on)
			end
		end
	end)
end
makeCommand("/freeze", true)
makeCommand("/thaw", false)

scripts.title: Give coins command
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and add admin UserIds to ADMINS (the owner always counts). Players need a leaderstats Coins value.
scripts.about: Admins type /givecoins Name 100 to give a player coins (handy for testing your shop), or /givecoins all 50 for everyone.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

-- Settings: change these!
local ADMINS = {}
local STAT_NAME = "Coins"
local MAX_AMOUNT = 1000000

local function isAdmin(player)
	return player.UserId == game.CreatorId or table.find(ADMINS, player.UserId) ~= nil
end

local function targetsFor(text)
	text = string.lower(text or "")
	if text == "all" then
		return Players:GetPlayers()
	end
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if text ~= "" and string.sub(string.lower(player.Name), 1, #text) == text then
			return { player }
		end
	end
	return {}
end

local command = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
command.PrimaryAlias = "/givecoins"
command.Parent = TextChatService

command.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
	local admin = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
	if not admin or not isAdmin(admin) then
		return
	end
	local words = string.split(message, " ")
	local amount = math.floor(tonumber(words[3]) or 0)
	if amount == 0 or math.abs(amount) > MAX_AMOUNT then
		admin:SetAttribute("Notice", "Try: /givecoins Name 100")
		return
	end
	for _, target in ipairs(targetsFor(words[2])) do
		local stats = target:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local stat = stats and stats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
		if stat then
			stat.Value = math.max(0, stat.Value + amount) -- negative numbers take coins away
			target:SetAttribute("Notice", "An admin gave you " .. amount .. " " .. STAT_NAME)
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: How long the server has been up
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Use it with the Notification toasts GUI so players see the answer.
scripts.about: Anyone can type /uptime to see how long this server has been running and how many players are in it.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local startedAt = os.time() -- when this server started

local function formatTime(seconds)
	local hours = math.floor(seconds / 3600)
	local minutes = math.floor(seconds % 3600 / 60)
	local secs = seconds % 60
	if hours > 0 then
		return string.format("%dh %dm", hours, minutes)
	end
	return string.format("%dm %ds", minutes, secs)
end

local command = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
command.PrimaryAlias = "/uptime"
command.Parent = TextChatService

command.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
	if player then
		local up = formatTime(os.time() - startedAt)
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Server up for " .. up .. " with " .. #Players:GetPlayers() .. " players")
	end
end)

scripts.title: Joined and left messages
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.
scripts.about: Shows a gray message in the chat whenever a player joins or leaves the server.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local general = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChannels"):WaitForChild("RBXGeneral")

local function system(text, color)

end

scripts.title: Mute command
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and add admin UserIds to ADMINS (the owner always counts).
scripts.about: Admins can type /mute Name to stop a player from sending chat messages, and /unmute Name to let them talk again.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local ADMINS = {}
local muted = {} -- muted[userId] = true

local function isAdmin(player)
	return player.UserId == game.CreatorId or table.find(ADMINS, player.UserId) ~= nil
end

local function findPlayer(text)
	text = string.lower(text or "")
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if text ~= "" and string.sub(string.lower(player.Name), 1, #text) == text then
			return player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Every chat channel has a TextSource for each player; CanSend decides if they can talk
local function applyMute(userId)
	for _, channel in ipairs(TextChatService:GetDescendants()) do
		if channel:IsA("TextChannel") then
			for _, source in ipairs(channel:GetChildren()) do
				if source:IsA("TextSource") and source.UserId == userId then
					source.CanSend = not muted[userId]
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- New channels or sources (like rejoining) keep the mute
TextChatService.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
	if object:IsA("TextSource") and muted[object.UserId] then
		object.CanSend = false
	end
end)

local function makeCommand(alias, muteIt)
	local command = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
	command.PrimaryAlias = alias
	command.Parent = TextChatService
	command.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
		local admin = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
		if not admin or not isAdmin(admin) then
			return
		end
		local target = findPlayer(string.split(message, " ")[2])
		if target then
			muted[target.UserId] = muteIt or nil
			applyMute(target.UserId)
			admin:SetAttribute("Notice", (muteIt and "Muted " or "Unmuted ") .. target.Name)
			target:SetAttribute("Notice", muteIt and "You were muted" or "You can chat again")
		end
	end)
end
makeCommand("/mute", true)
makeCommand("/unmute", false)

scripts.title: Private server owner powers
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Only works in private (VIP) servers.
scripts.about: The owner of a private server can type /pkick Name to remove someone, and /lock or /unlock to stop new non-friends joining.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local isPrivate = game.PrivateServerId ~= "" and game.PrivateServerOwnerId ~= 0
local locked = false

local function isServerOwner(player)
	return isPrivate and player.UserId == game.PrivateServerOwnerId
end

local function findPlayer(text)
	text = string.lower(text or "")
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if text ~= "" and string.sub(string.lower(player.Name), 1, #text) == text then
			return player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function makeCommand(alias, action)
	local command = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
	command.PrimaryAlias = alias
	command.Parent = TextChatService
	command.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
		local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
		if owner and isServerOwner(owner) then
			action(owner, string.split(message, " ")[2])
		end
	end)
end

makeCommand("/pkick", function(owner, name)
	local target = findPlayer(name)
	if target and target ~= owner then
		target:Kick("The private server owner removed you.")
	end
end)
makeCommand("/lock", function(owner)
	locked = true
	owner:SetAttribute("Notice", "Server locked: only friends can join")
end)
makeCommand("/unlock", function(owner)
	locked = false
	owner:SetAttribute("Notice", "Server unlocked")
end)

-- While locked, only the owner's friends may join
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	if not locked or isServerOwner(player) then
		return
	end
	local ok, isFriend = pcall(function()
		return player:IsFriendsWith(game.PrivateServerOwnerId)
	end)
	if not (ok and isFriend) then
		player:Kick("This private server is locked right now.")
	end
end)

local ADMINS = {}
local COUNTDOWN = 30

local function isAdmin(player)
	return player.UserId == game.CreatorId or table.find(ADMINS, player.UserId) ~= nil
end

		player:Kick("This server is closing. Please join another one!")
	end

scripts.title: Sign anyone can write on
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part named MessageSign that has a SurfaceGui with a TextLabel on its front.
scripts.about: Players type /sign followed by a message to write it on the sign; the text goes through Roblox's filter first so it is safe for everyone.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")

-- Settings: change these!
local COOLDOWN = 30 -- seconds before the same player can write again
local MAX_LENGTH = 80

local sign = script.Parent
local label = sign:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
local lastWrite = {}

local command = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
command.PrimaryAlias = "/sign"
command.Parent = TextChatService

command.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
	if not player or not label then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - (lastWrite[player] or -COOLDOWN) < COOLDOWN then
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Wait a bit before writing again")
		return
	end
	local text = string.sub(message, #"/sign " + 1, #"/sign " + MAX_LENGTH)
	if text == "" then
		return
	end
	-- Every text that other players will read MUST be filtered
	local ok, filtered = pcall(function()
		return TextService:FilterStringAsync(text, player.UserId):GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
	end)
	if ok then
		lastWrite[player] = os.clock()
		label.Text = player.DisplayName .. " wrote:\n" .. filtered
	else
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Could not check your text, try again")
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastWrite[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Stop chat spam
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.
scripts.about: If someone sends too many chat messages too fast, their extra messages are not delivered and they get a "slow down" note.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

-- Settings: change these!
local MAX_MESSAGES = 5 -- at most this many...
local PER_SECONDS = 6 -- ...in this many seconds

local recent = {} -- recent[userId] = list of times they sent messages
local checked = {} -- checked[messageId] = true (deliver) or false (block)

local function allowed(userId)
	local now = os.clock()
	local times = recent[userId] or {}
	-- Forget messages older than the time window
	local kept = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		if now - t < PER_SECONDS then
			table.insert(kept, t)
		end
	end
	if #kept >= MAX_MESSAGES then
		recent[userId] = kept
		return false
	end
	table.insert(kept, now)
	recent[userId] = kept
	return true
end

local function protect(channel)
	-- ShouldDeliverCallback decides if a message goes out (runs on the server)
	channel.ShouldDeliverCallback = function(message, targetSource)
		local sender = message.TextSource
		if not sender then
			return true
		end
		-- This runs once per person receiving it, so only count the first one
		local id = message.MessageId
		if checked[id] == nil then
			local ok = allowed(sender.UserId)
			checked[id] = ok
			task.delay(10, function()
				checked[id] = nil -- forget old messages
			end)
			if not ok then
				local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(sender.UserId)
				if player then
					player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Slow down! Too many messages.")
				end
			end
		end
		return checked[id]
	end
end

local channels = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChannels")
for _, channel in ipairs(channels:GetChildren()) do
	if channel:IsA("TextChannel") then
		protect(channel)
	end
end
channels.ChildAdded:Connect(function(channel)
	if channel:IsA("TextChannel") then
		protect(channel)
	end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	recent[player.UserId] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Admin only door
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Anchored door Part and put admin user ids in the list.
scripts.about: Only the user ids in your admin list can walk through this door; everyone else bumps into it.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: put the user ids of your admins here
local ADMINS = {
	[1] = true, -- change 1 to your user id
}

local door = script.Parent
door.Anchored = true
door.CanCollide = true
local cooldown = {}

-- Put the player on the other side of the door
local function passThrough(root)
	local side = door.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position).Z
	local distance = door.Size.Z / 2 + 3
	local target = door.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, side > 0 and -distance or distance)
	root.Parent:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target.Position) * root.CFrame.Rotation)
end

door.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not player or not root or cooldown[player] or not ADMINS[player.UserId] then
		return
	end
	cooldown[player] = true
	passThrough(root)
	task.wait(1)
	cooldown[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Double doors that open when you walk up
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model with two Anchored Parts named LeftDoor and RightDoor that close in the middle.
scripts.about: Like a supermarket: both doors slide apart when a player comes close and close when everyone leaves.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SENSE_DISTANCE = 12
local SLIDE_TIME = 0.5

local model = script.Parent
local left = model:WaitForChild("LeftDoor")
local right = model:WaitForChild("RightDoor")
local center = (left.Position + right.Position) / 2

-- Work out the open spots: each door slides away from the middle by its own width
local function openCFrame(door)
	local away = (door.Position - center).Unit
	return door.CFrame + away * door.Size.X
end
local doors = {
	{ part = left, closed = left.CFrame, open = openCFrame(left) },
	{ part = right, closed = right.CFrame, open = openCFrame(right) },
}

local function someoneNear()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root and (root.Position - center).Magnitude < SENSE_DISTANCE then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local isOpen = false
while true do
	task.wait(0.2)
	local shouldOpen = someoneNear()
	if shouldOpen ~= isOpen then
		isOpen = shouldOpen
		for _, door in ipairs(doors) do
			local goal = isOpen and door.open or door.closed
			TweenService:Create(door.part, TweenInfo.new(SLIDE_TIME), { CFrame = goal }):Play()
		end
	end
end

		end)
		allowed[player] = ok and rank >= MIN_RANK
	end
	return allowed[player]
end

local function passThrough(root)
	local side = door.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position).Z
	local distance = door.Size.Z / 2 + 3
	local target = door.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, side > 0 and -distance or distance)
	root.Parent:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target.Position) * root.CFrame.Rotation)
end

door.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not player or not root or cooldown[player] then
		return
	end
	cooldown[player] = true
	if isAllowed(player) then
		passThrough(root)
	else
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Join the group to get in!")
	end
	task.wait(1.5)
	cooldown[player] = nil
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	allowed[player] = nil
	cooldown[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Hide in a locker
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a locker Model with a Part named Inside (an invisible, non-colliding part in the middle of the locker) and a Part named LockerDoor.
scripts.about: Press E to hide inside the locker (you cannot move and you get a Hiding attribute), and press E again to come out.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change this!
local EXIT_DISTANCE = 4 -- studs in front of the locker you pop out

local locker = script.Parent
local inside = locker:WaitForChild("Inside")
local lockerDoor = locker:WaitForChild("LockerDoor")
local hider = nil -- the player hiding right now
local saved = {}

local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Hide"
prompt.ObjectText = "Locker"
prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
prompt.Parent = lockerDoor

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if hider == nil then
		-- Go in: freeze the player inside the locker
		hider = player
		saved = { humanoid.WalkSpeed, humanoid.JumpHeight }
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
		humanoid.JumpHeight = 0
		character:PivotTo(inside.CFrame)
		player:SetAttribute("Hiding", true) -- monsters can check this and ignore them
		prompt.ActionText = "Leave"
		humanoid.Died:Once(function()
			if hider == player then
				hider = nil
				player:SetAttribute("Hiding", nil)
				prompt.ActionText = "Hide"
			end
		end)
	elseif hider == player then
		-- Come out in front of the locker door
		hider = nil
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = saved[1]
		humanoid.JumpHeight = saved[2]
		character:PivotTo(lockerDoor.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -EXIT_DISTANCE))
		player:SetAttribute("Hiding", nil)
		prompt.ActionText = "Hide"
	end
end)

-- If the hider leaves the game or dies, free up the locker
game:GetService("Players").PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	if player == hider then
		hider = nil
		prompt.ActionText = "Hide"
	end
end)

scripts.title: Key door
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the door Part, and make a Tool named Key (with a Handle part) that players can get.
scripts.about: The door only opens for players who have the Key tool.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local KEY_NAME = "Key" -- the exact name of your key Tool
local OPEN_TIME = 3 -- seconds the door stays open
local USE_UP_KEY = false -- true = the key disappears after opening the door

local door = script.Parent
local closedTransparency = door.Transparency
local isOpen = false

-- Find the player who touched the door (even if it was their tool or hat)
local function getPlayer(hit)
	local model = hit.Parent
	local player = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
	if not player and model and model.Parent then
		player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model.Parent)
	end
	return player
end

-- Look for the key in their hand or their backpack
local function findKey(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	return (character and character:FindFirstChild(KEY_NAME))
		or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(KEY_NAME))
end

door.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if isOpen then
		return
	end
	local player = getPlayer(hit)
	local key = player and findKey(player)
	if not key then
		return -- no key, no entry!
	end

	isOpen = true
	if USE_UP_KEY then
		key:Destroy()
	end
	door.CanCollide = false
	door.Transparency = 0.7

	task.wait(OPEN_TIME)
	door.CanCollide = true
	door.Transparency = closedTransparency
	isOpen = false
end)

scripts.title: Keypad code door (server part)
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model with two Anchored Parts named Door and Keypad, and also add the Keypad code door (screen part) LocalScript.
scripts.about: Players type a code on the keypad; only the right code opens the door, and the code stays secret on the server.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these!
local CODE = "1234" -- the secret code (players never see this)
local OPEN_TIME = 5

local model = script.Parent
local door = model:WaitForChild("Door")
local keypad = model:WaitForChild("Keypad")

-- The prompt the screen part listens for
local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.Name = "KeypadPrompt"
prompt.ActionText = "Enter code"
prompt.ObjectText = "Keypad"
prompt.Parent = keypad

-- The screen part sends the typed code here
local submit = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
submit.Name = "SubmitCode"
submit.Parent = model

local lastTry = {}
local opening = false

submit.OnServerInvoke = function(player, typed)
	if typeof(typed) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	-- Only 1 try every 2 seconds so nobody can guess super fast
	if os.clock() - (lastTry[player] or 0) < 2 then
		return false
	end
	lastTry[player] = os.clock()
	-- Must be standing near the keypad
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or (root.Position - keypad.Position).Magnitude > 15 then
		return false
	end
	if typed ~= CODE then
		return false
	end
	if not opening then
		opening = true
		task.spawn(function()
			door.Transparency = 0.8
			door.CanCollide = false
			task.wait(OPEN_TIME)
			door.Transparency = 0
			door.CanCollide = true
			opening = false
		end)
	end
	return true
end

scripts.title: Press all the buttons puzzle
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model with an Anchored Part named Door and a Folder named Buttons holding the button Parts.
scripts.about: Every button must be stepped on before time runs out; then the door opens. Great for team puzzles.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local TIME_LIMIT = 20 -- seconds from the first button to press them all
local OPEN_TIME = 10

local model = script.Parent
local door = model:WaitForChild("Door")
local buttons = {}
for _, part in ipairs(model:WaitForChild("Buttons"):GetChildren()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") then
		table.insert(buttons, part)
		part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40)
	end
end

local pressed = {}
local count = 0
local firstPress = 0
local solved = false

local function reset()
	table.clear(pressed)
	count = 0
	for _, button in ipairs(buttons) do
		button.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40)
	end
end

for _, button in ipairs(buttons) do
	button.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		if solved or pressed[button] or not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) then
			return
		end
		if count == 0 then
			firstPress = os.clock()
			task.delay(TIME_LIMIT, function()
				if not solved and firstPress ~= 0 and os.clock() - firstPress >= TIME_LIMIT then
					reset() -- too slow, start over
				end
			end)
		end
		pressed[button] = true
		count += 1
		button.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 40)

		if count == #buttons then
			solved = true
			door.Transparency = 1
			door.CanCollide = false
			task.wait(OPEN_TIME)
			door.Transparency = 0
			door.CanCollide = true
			firstPress = 0
			reset()
			solved = false
		end
	end)
end

scripts.title: Pressure plate door
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model with two Anchored Parts named Plate (on the floor) and Door.
scripts.about: The door stays open only while someone (or something) is standing on the plate.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DOOR_RISE = 12 -- how far up the door slides

local model = script.Parent
local plate = model:WaitForChild("Plate")
local door = model:WaitForChild("Door")
local closed = door.CFrame
local open = closed + Vector3.new(0, DOOR_RISE, 0)
local plateUp = plate.CFrame
local plateDown = plateUp - Vector3.new(0, plate.Size.Y / 2, 0)

local params = OverlapParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { model }

-- Is anything sitting on top of the plate? (players, boxes, anything not anchored)
local function somethingOnPlate()
	local box = plateUp * CFrame.new(0, plate.Size.Y / 2 + 1, 0)
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(box, Vector3.new(plate.Size.X, 2, plate.Size.Z), params)) do
		if not part.Anchored then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local isOpen = false
while true do
	task.wait(0.15)
	local pressed = somethingOnPlate()
	if pressed ~= isOpen then
		isOpen = pressed
		TweenService:Create(door, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { CFrame = isOpen and open or closed }):Play()
		plate.CFrame = isOpen and plateDown or plateUp
	end
end

-- Models cannot be tweened directly, so we tween a CFrameValue and move the model with it
local function slideTo(goal, seconds)

		shelf:PivotTo(cf)

end

local SWING_TIME = 0.5

local isOpen = false

scripts.title: Team-only door
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the door Part, make sure you have Teams (in the Teams service), and set TEAM_NAME below.
scripts.about: Players on one team can walk right through the door, but everyone else is blocked.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")

-- Settings: change this to your team's exact name!
local TEAM_NAME = "Red"

local door = script.Parent
local doorGroup = "TeamDoor_" .. TEAM_NAME
local memberGroup = "TeamMembers_" .. TEAM_NAME

-- Collision groups: team members and this door don't bump into each other
for _, groupName in ipairs({ doorGroup, memberGroup }) do
	if not PhysicsService:IsCollisionGroupRegistered(groupName) then
		PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(groupName)
	end
end
PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(doorGroup, memberGroup, false)
door.CollisionGroup = doorGroup

local function isOnTeam(player)
	return player.Team ~= nil and player.Team.Name == TEAM_NAME
end

-- Put a body part in the right group
local function updatePart(player, part)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	if isOnTeam(player) then
		part.CollisionGroup = memberGroup
	elseif part.CollisionGroup == memberGroup then
		part.CollisionGroup = "Default"
	end
end

local function updateCharacter(player, character)
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		updatePart(player, part)
	end
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local function onCharacter(character)
		updateCharacter(player, character)
		character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
			updatePart(player, part)
		end)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
	if player.Character then
		onCharacter(player.Character)
	end
	-- Switching teams? Update right away
	player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function()
		if player.Character then
			updateCharacter(player, player.Character)
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

scripts.title: VIP game pass door
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Anchored door Part and put your game pass id below.
scripts.about: Only players who own the VIP game pass can walk through; everyone else gets asked to buy it.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

-- Settings: change this!
local GAME_PASS_ID = 0

local door = script.Parent
door.Anchored = true
door.CanCollide = true
local owners = {}
local cooldown = {}

local function ownsPass(player)
	if owners[player] == nil then
		local ok, owns = pcall(function()
			return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, GAME_PASS_ID)
		end)
		owners[player] = ok and owns
	end
	return owners[player]
end

-- Move the player to the other side of the door
local function passThrough(root)
	local side = door.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position).Z
	local distance = door.Size.Z / 2 + 3
	local target = door.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, side > 0 and -distance or distance)
	root.Parent:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target.Position) * root.CFrame.Rotation)
end

door.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not player or not root or cooldown[player] then
		return
	end
	cooldown[player] = true
	if ownsPass(player) then
		passThrough(root)
	else
		MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, GAME_PASS_ID)
	end
	task.wait(2)
	cooldown[player] = nil
end)

MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, bought)
	if bought and passId == GAME_PASS_ID then
		owners[player] = true
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	owners[player] = nil
	cooldown[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Coins count up smoothly
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript inside a TextLabel in a ScreenGui. It shows the player's leaderstats Coins.
scripts.about: Instead of jumping straight to the new number, the coin text quickly counts up (or down) to it and pops a little.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change this!
local STAT_NAME = "Coins"
local COUNT_TIME = 0.6 -- seconds to reach the new number

local label = script.Parent
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local stat = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild(STAT_NAME)

local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = label

local shown = stat.Value
label.Text = tostring(shown)
local animation = nil

stat.Changed:Connect(function(target)
	if animation then
		animation:Disconnect()
	end
	local from = shown
	local elapsed = 0
	scale.Scale = 1.2
	TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	-- Every frame, move the shown number a bit closer to the real one
	animation = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		elapsed += deltaTime
		local alpha = math.min(elapsed / COUNT_TIME, 1)
		shown = math.floor(from + (target - from) * alpha + 0.5)
		label.Text = tostring(shown)
		if alpha >= 1 then
			animation:Disconnect()
			animation = nil
		end
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Drag a window around
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript inside the Frame you want to be draggable (in a ScreenGui in StarterGui).
scripts.about: Lets players grab the frame with the mouse or a finger and drag it anywhere on the screen.
scripts.code:
local frame = script.Parent

-- UIDragDetector is the built-in Roblox object that makes GUI draggable
local dragger = Instance.new("UIDragDetector")
dragger.DragStyle = Enum.UIDragDetectorDragStyle.TranslatePlane
dragger.Parent = frame

-- Keep the frame on the screen when the drag ends
dragger.DragEnd:Connect(function()
	local screen = frame:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
	if not screen then
		return
	end
	local screenSize = screen.AbsoluteSize
	local pos = frame.AbsolutePosition
	local size = frame.AbsoluteSize
	if pos.X < 0 or pos.Y < 0 or pos.X + size.X > screenSize.X or pos.Y + size.Y > screenSize.Y then
		-- Snap back to the middle if it went off the edge
		frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	end
end)

-- Make the frame slightly see-through while dragging so you can see behind it
local startTransparency = frame.BackgroundTransparency
dragger.DragStart:Connect(function()
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(startTransparency + 0.3, 1)
end)
dragger.DragEnd:Connect(function()
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = startTransparency
end)

scripts.title: Game time clock on screen
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. Works best with a day and night cycle script.
scripts.about: Shows the in-game time (from Lighting.ClockTime) like "7:30 PM" with a sun or moon word.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "GameClock"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 44)
label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 32)
label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextScaled = true
label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
label.Parent = gui

local function update()
	local time = Lighting.ClockTime -- 0 to 24
	local hours = math.floor(time)
	local minutes = math.floor((time - hours) * 60)
	local suffix = hours >= 12 and "PM" or "AM"
	local shownHours = hours % 12
	if shownHours == 0 then
		shownHours = 12
	end
	local isDay = time >= 6 and time < 18
	label.Text = string.format("%d:%02d %s  %s", shownHours, minutes, suffix, isDay and "Day" or "Night")
end

Lighting:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ClockTime"):Connect(update)
update()

scripts.title: Inventory list of your tools
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.
scripts.about: Shows a list of every Tool you own on the left side; click one to hold it, click again to put it away.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "Inventory"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.25, 0)
list.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 300)
list.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
list.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
list.ScrollBarThickness = 6
list.Parent = gui
local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
layout.Parent = list

local function refresh()
	for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextButton") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local tools = {}
	for _, holder in ipairs({ backpack, character }) do
		if holder then
			for _, tool in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
				if tool:IsA("Tool") then
					table.insert(tools, tool)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, tool in ipairs(tools) do
		local held = tool.Parent == character
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 36)
		button.Text = tool.Name
		button.TextScaled = true
		button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		button.BackgroundColor3 = held and Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 220) or Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
		button.Parent = list
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not humanoid then
				return
			end
			if tool.Parent == character then
				humanoid:UnequipTools()
			else
				humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
			end
		end)
	end
end

-- Refresh whenever tools move in or out of the backpack or hands
local function watch(holder)
	holder.ChildAdded:Connect(refresh)
	holder.ChildRemoved:Connect(refresh)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	watch(character)
	watch(player:WaitForChild("Backpack"))
	refresh()
end)
if player.Character then
	watch(player.Character)
	watch(player:WaitForChild("Backpack"))
	refresh()
end
