scripts.title: Pop-up notifications
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts; server scripts show a message with player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Hello!").
scripts.about: Shows little messages that slide in at the top right and fade away; many other scripts here use the Notice attribute to talk to players.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these!
local SHOW_TIME = 3.5
local MAX_ON_SCREEN = 4

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "Notifications"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
holder.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 16)
holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 400)
holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
holder.Parent = gui
local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
layout.Parent = holder

local count = 0

local function notify(text)
	count += 1
	local toast = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	toast.LayoutOrder = count
	toast.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 46)
	toast.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
	toast.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	toast.TextTransparency = 1
	toast.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	toast.TextScaled = true
	toast.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	toast.Text = text
	toast.Parent = holder
	Instance.new("UICorner", toast).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
	padding.Parent = toast

	-- Too many? remove the oldest
	local toasts = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			table.insert(toasts, child)
		end
	end
	table.sort(toasts, function(a, b) return a.LayoutOrder < b.LayoutOrder end)
	if #toasts > MAX_ON_SCREEN then
		toasts[1]:Destroy()
	end

	TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.25), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, TextTransparency = 0 }):Play()
	task.delay(SHOW_TIME, function()
		local fade = TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1 })
		fade:Play()
		fade.Completed:Wait()
		toast:Destroy()
	end)

scripts.title: Progress bar maker (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage and name it ProgressBar. In a LocalScript: local bar = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ProgressBar).new(parentFrame) then bar:Set(0.5).
scripts.about: A reusable module that makes a smooth fill bar you can set to any amount from 0 to 1, with optional text.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local ProgressBar = {}
ProgressBar.__index = ProgressBar

-- new(parent, color) makes a bar that fills its parent
function ProgressBar.new(parent, color)
	local self = setmetatable({}, ProgressBar)
	self.Back = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.Back.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	self.Back.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
	self.Back.Parent = parent
	Instance.new("UICorner", self.Back)

	self.Fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.Fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
	self.Fill.BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 90)
	self.Fill.Parent = self.Back
	Instance.new("UICorner", self.Fill)

	self.Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	self.Label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	self.Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	self.Label.TextScaled = true
	self.Label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	self.Label.Text = ""
	self.Label.Parent = self.Back
	return self
end

-- Set(amount, text): amount is 0 to 1
function ProgressBar:Set(amount, text)
	amount = math.clamp(amount, 0, 1)
	TweenService:Create(self.Fill, TweenInfo.new(0.25), { Size = UDim2.fromScale(amount, 1) }):Play()
	self.Label.Text = text or (math.floor(amount * 100) .. "%")
end

function ProgressBar:Destroy()
	self.Back:Destroy()
end

return ProgressBar

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change this to the item this button buys
local ITEM_NAME = "Sword" -- must match a name in the Shop (server part) PRICES list
local MESSAGE_TIME = 1.5 -- seconds the "Bought!" message stays

local button = script.Parent
local buyItem = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyItem")
local normalText = button.Text
local normalColor = button.BackgroundColor3
local messageNumber = 0

-- Tapping or clicking the button asks the server to buy (the server checks the coins)
button.Activated:Connect(function()
	buyItem:FireServer(ITEM_NAME)
end)

-- The server answers: did it work?
buyItem.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(itemName, success, message)
	if itemName ~= ITEM_NAME then
		return -- this answer is for a different button
	end
	messageNumber = messageNumber + 1
	local myNumber = messageNumber

	button.Text = message
	if success then
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 90) -- green
	else
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 70, 70) -- red
	end

	-- Go back to normal after a moment
	task.delay(MESSAGE_TIME, function()
		if myNumber == messageNumber then
			button.Text = normalText
			button.BackgroundColor3 = normalColor
		end
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Capture the flag
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Make two Teams (Red and Blue). In Workspace add Parts named RedFlag and BlueFlag (the flags) and RedBase and BlueBase (where you bring them).
scripts.about: Touch the other team's flag to carry it, bring it to your own base to score, and drop it if you die.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

-- Settings: change these!
local SCORE_TO_WIN = 3

local flags = {
	Red = { flag = workspace:WaitForChild("RedFlag"), base = workspace:WaitForChild("RedBase") },
	Blue = { flag = workspace:WaitForChild("BlueFlag"), base = workspace:WaitForChild("BlueBase") },
}
local scores = { Red = 0, Blue = 0 }

for teamName, info in pairs(flags) do
	info.home = info.flag.CFrame
	info.flag.Anchored = true
	info.flag.CanCollide = false
	info.carrier = nil
end

local function resetFlag(info)
	info.carrier = nil
	info.flag.CFrame = info.home
end

for teamName, info in pairs(flags) do
	-- Picking up the enemy flag
	info.flag.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local humanoid = hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not player or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or info.carrier then
			return
		end
		if player.Team and player.Team.Name ~= teamName then
			info.carrier = player
			humanoid.Died:Once(function()
				if info.carrier == player then
					resetFlag(info) -- dropped flags go home
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	-- Scoring at your own base
	info.base.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		if not player or not player.Team or player.Team.Name ~= teamName then
			return
		end
		for enemyName, enemy in pairs(flags) do
			if enemy.carrier == player then
				resetFlag(enemy)
				scores[teamName] += 1
				local team = Teams:FindFirstChild(teamName)
				for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					p:SetAttribute("Notice", player.Name .. " captured the " .. enemyName .. " flag!")
				end
				workspace:SetAttribute("RedScore", scores.Red)
				workspace:SetAttribute("BlueScore", scores.Blue)
				if scores[teamName] >= SCORE_TO_WIN then
					workspace:SetAttribute("Announcement", (team and team.Name or teamName) .. " team wins!")
					scores.Red, scores.Blue = 0, 0
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Make carried flags float above the carrier's head
while true do
	task.wait(0.1)
	for _, info in pairs(flags) do
		local carrier = info.carrier
		if carrier then
			local character = carrier.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root and carrier.Parent then
				info.flag.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 4, 0.5)
			else
				resetFlag(info)
			end
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Color floor minigame
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model or Folder full of anchored floor tiles (Parts), with something deadly (like a kill brick) below them.
scripts.about: Paints the floor tiles random colors, calls out one color, then makes every other tile vanish so players must stand on the right color.
scripts.code:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local COLORS = {
	Red = Color3.fromRGB(230, 60, 60),
	Blue = Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 240),
	Green = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 90),
	Yellow = Color3.fromRGB(250, 220, 60),
}
local START_TIME = 5 -- seconds to find the color at first
local MIN_TIME = 1.5 -- it gets faster each turn down to this

local tiles = {}
for _, part in ipairs(script.Parent:GetDescendants()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") then
		table.insert(tiles, part)
	end
end
local names = {}
for name in pairs(COLORS) do
	table.insert(names, name)
end

local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local waitTime = START_TIME
while true do
	-- Paint every tile and make them all solid
	for _, tile in ipairs(tiles) do
		local name = names[math.random(1, #names)]
		tile.Color = COLORS[name]
		tile:SetAttribute("ColorName", name)
		tile.Transparency = 0
		tile.CanCollide = true
	end
	local target = names[math.random(1, #names)]
	status.Value = "Stand on " .. target .. "!"
	task.wait(waitTime)
	-- Every tile that is not the target color disappears
	for _, tile in ipairs(tiles) do
		if tile:GetAttribute("ColorName") ~= target then
			tile.Transparency = 1
			tile.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
	task.wait(3)
	waitTime = math.max(MIN_TIME, waitTime - 0.5)
	if waitTime == MIN_TIME then
		waitTime = START_TIME -- start the speed over again
	end
end

scripts.title: Enemy waves
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Put an enemy Model with a Humanoid (and its own chase script) in ServerStorage named Enemy, and Parts in a Folder named EnemySpawns in Workspace.
scripts.about: Sends bigger and bigger waves of enemies; when every enemy in a wave is defeated, the next wave starts and players get coins.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local ENEMIES_FIRST_WAVE = 3
local EXTRA_PER_WAVE = 2
local COINS_PER_WAVE = 25

local enemyTemplate = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Enemy")
local spawns = workspace:WaitForChild("EnemySpawns"):GetChildren()
local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function anyoneAlive()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local wave = 0
while true do
	if not anyoneAlive() then
		wave = 0
		status.Value = "Waiting for players..."
		task.wait(3)
		continue
	end
	wave += 1
	for t = 5, 1, -1 do
		status.Value = "Wave " .. wave .. " in " .. t
		task.wait(1)
	end
	local count = ENEMIES_FIRST_WAVE + (wave - 1) * EXTRA_PER_WAVE
	local alive = 0
	for i = 1, count do
		local enemy = enemyTemplate:Clone()
		local spot = spawns[math.random(1, #spawns)]
		enemy:PivotTo(spot.CFrame + Vector3.new(math.random(-4, 4), 3, math.random(-4, 4)))
		enemy.Parent = workspace
		local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			alive += 1
			humanoid.MaxHealth += wave * 10 -- tougher every wave
			humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
			humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
				alive -= 1
				task.delay(3, function()
					enemy:Destroy()
				end)
			end)
		end
		task.wait(0.4)
	end
	while alive > 0 and anyoneAlive() do
		status.Value = "Wave " .. wave .. ": " .. alive .. " enemies left"
		task.wait(1)
	end
	if alive == 0 then
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			if stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins") then
				stats.Coins.Value += COINS_PER_WAVE * wave
			end
		end
		status.Value = "Wave " .. wave .. " cleared!"
		task.wait(3)
	else
		status.Value = "Everyone fell on wave " .. wave
		for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
			if object.Name == enemyTemplate.Name then
				object:Destroy()
			end
		end
		wave = 0
		task.wait(5)
	end
end

scripts.title: First to 10 knockouts
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Weapons must tag victims with a "creator" ObjectValue (the weapon scripts here do).
scripts.about: A free-for-all round where the first player to knock out 10 others wins, then everyone's round score resets.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local KILLS_TO_WIN = 10

local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local roundKills = {}
local roundActive = true

local function leader()
	local best, bestKills = nil, 0
	for player, kills in pairs(roundKills) do
		if kills > bestKills and player.Parent then
			best, bestKills = player, kills
		end
	end
	return best, bestKills
end

local function onDied(humanoid)
	if not roundActive then
		return
	end
	local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	local killer = tag and tag.Value
	if not (killer and killer:IsA("Player")) then
		return
	end
	roundKills[killer] = (roundKills[killer] or 0) + 1
	killer:SetAttribute("RoundKills", roundKills[killer])
	local best, bestKills = leader()
	status.Value = best.Name .. " leads with " .. bestKills .. " / " .. KILLS_TO_WIN
	if roundKills[killer] >= KILLS_TO_WIN then
		roundActive = false
		status.Value = killer.Name .. " wins the round!"
		local stats = killer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Wins") then
			stats.Wins.Value += 1
		end
		task.wait(6)
		roundKills = {}
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			player:SetAttribute("RoundKills", 0)
			player:LoadCharacter()
		end
		status.Value = "New round! First to " .. KILLS_TO_WIN
		roundActive = true
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			onDied(humanoid)
		end)
	end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	roundKills[player] = nil
end)
status.Value = "First to " .. KILLS_TO_WIN .. " knockouts wins!"

scripts.title: Give round prizes (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ServerScriptService and name it RoundRewards. Round scripts use require(game.ServerScriptService.RoundRewards).Give(player, "Winner").
scripts.about: One place to set how many coins and wins each kind of round result gives, so all your round scripts reward players the same way.
scripts.code:
local RoundRewards = {}

-- Settings: change these prizes!
RoundRewards.Prizes = {
	Winner = { Coins = 100, Wins = 1, Message = "You won! +100 coins" },
	Survivor = { Coins = 50, Wins = 0, Message = "You survived! +50 coins" },
	Played = { Coins = 10, Wins = 0, Message = "Thanks for playing! +10 coins" },
}

local function addStat(player, name, amount)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local stat = stats and stats:FindFirstChild(name)
	if stat and amount > 0 then
		stat.Value += amount
	end
end

-- Give(player, kind) gives the prize for that kind (Winner, Survivor or Played)
function RoundRewards.Give(player, kind)
	local prize = RoundRewards.Prizes[kind]
	if not prize or not player.Parent then
		return
	end
	-- Gamepass or upgrade multipliers from other scripts can boost coins
	local multiplier = player:GetAttribute("Multiplier") or 1
	addStat(player, "Coins", math.floor(prize.Coins * multiplier))
	addStat(player, "Wins", prize.Wins)
	player:SetAttribute("Notice", prize.Message)
end

-- GiveAll(list, kind) rewards a whole list of players
function RoundRewards.GiveAll(players, kind)
	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		RoundRewards.Give(player, kind)
	end
end

return RoundRewards

scripts.title: Hide and seek
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and put a Part named SeekerWait in a closed room (the seeker waits there while others hide).
scripts.about: One seeker waits while everyone hides, then hunts them; touching a hider finds them, and hiders who last until time runs out win.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local HIDE_TIME = 30
local SEEK_TIME = 120

local seekerWait = workspace:WaitForChild("SeekerWait")
local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

while true do
	while #Players:GetPlayers() < 2 do
		status.Value = "Need 2 players"
		task.wait(2)
	end
	local everyone = Players:GetPlayers()
	local seeker = everyone[math.random(1, #everyone)]
	local hiders = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(everyone) do
		if player ~= seeker then
			hiders[player] = true
			player:LoadCharacter() -- hiders start fresh at spawn
		end
	end
	seeker:LoadCharacter()
	local seekerChar = seeker.Character or seeker.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	seekerChar:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	seekerChar:PivotTo(seekerWait.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))

	for t = HIDE_TIME, 1, -1 do
		status.Value = "Hide! " .. seeker.Name .. " is seeking in " .. t
		task.wait(1)
	end
	seekerChar = seeker.Character
	local spawnLocation = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
	if seekerChar and spawnLocation then
		seekerChar:PivotTo(spawnLocation.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
	end

	-- Touching a hider with the seeker's body finds them
	local connections = {}
	if seekerChar then
		for _, part in ipairs(seekerChar:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				table.insert(connections, part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
					local found = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
					if found and hiders[found] then
						hiders[found] = nil
						status.Value = found.Name .. " was found!"
						found:SetAttribute("Notice", "You were found!")
					end
				end))
			end
		end
	end

	for t = SEEK_TIME, 1, -1 do
		local left = 0
		for player in pairs(hiders) do
			if player.Parent then
				left += 1
			end
		end
		if left == 0 then
			break
		end
		status.Value = left .. " hiding, " .. t .. "s left"
		task.wait(1)
	end
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end

	local winners = {}
	for player in pairs(hiders) do
		if player.Parent then
			table.insert(winners, player.Name)
			local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			if stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Wins") then
				stats.Wins.Value += 1
			end
		end
	end
	status.Value = #winners > 0 and ("Hiders win: " .. table.concat(winners, ", ")) or (seeker.Name .. " found everyone!")
	task.wait(6)
end

scripts.title: King of the hill
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an anchored Part that marks the hill zone (make it see-through and CanCollide off, big enough to stand in).
scripts.about: Whoever stands alone on the hill gets a point every second; the first to reach the goal wins and scores reset.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local POINTS_TO_WIN = 60
local STAT_NAME = "Wins"

local zone = script.Parent
local points = {} -- points[player] = number

local params = OverlapParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

local function playersOnHill()
	local characters = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Character then
			table.insert(characters, player.Character)
		end
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = characters
	local found = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(zone, params)) do
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(part.Parent)
		local humanoid = part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if player and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			found[player] = true
		end
	end
	return found
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	points[player] = nil
end)

while true do
	task.wait(1)
	local onHill = playersOnHill()
	local list = {}
	for player in pairs(onHill) do
		table.insert(list, player)
	end
	if #list == 1 then
		local king = list[1]
		points[king] = (points[king] or 0) + 1
		king:SetAttribute("HillPoints", points[king]) -- a GUI can show this
		zone.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40)
		if points[king] >= POINTS_TO_WIN then
			local stats = king:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			local stat = stats and stats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
			if stat then
				stat.Value += 1
			end
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				player:SetAttribute("Notice", king.Name .. " is King of the Hill!")
				player:SetAttribute("HillPoints", 0)
			end
			points = {}
		end
	elseif #list > 1 then
		zone.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 60, 60) -- contested: nobody scores
	else
		zone.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	end
end

scripts.title: Last player standing
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and put a Part named ArenaSpawn in the arena. Players who die or fall off are out.
scripts.about: Sends everyone into the arena; when you die you are out, and the last one alive wins a Win.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local MIN_PLAYERS = 2
local LOBBY_TIME = 15
local MAX_ROUND_TIME = 180

local arenaSpawn = workspace:WaitForChild("ArenaSpawn")
local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function giveWin(player)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local wins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Wins")
	if wins then
		wins.Value += 1
	end
end

while true do
	while #Players:GetPlayers() < MIN_PLAYERS do
		status.Value = "Waiting for " .. MIN_PLAYERS .. " players..."
		task.wait(2)
	end
	for t = LOBBY_TIME, 1, -1 do
		status.Value = "Round starts in " .. t
		task.wait(1)
	end

	-- Everyone who has a character is in
	local alive = {}
	local connections = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			alive[player] = true
			character:PivotTo(arenaSpawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), 4, math.random(-10, 10)))
			table.insert(connections, humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
				alive[player] = nil
			end))
		end
	end
	table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		alive[player] = nil
	end))

	local function countAlive()
		local count, last = 0, nil
		for player in pairs(alive) do
			count += 1
			last = player
		end
		return count, last
	end

	local timeLeft = MAX_ROUND_TIME
	while timeLeft > 0 and countAlive() > 1 do
		status.Value = countAlive() .. " players left (" .. timeLeft .. ")"
		task.wait(1)
		timeLeft -= 1
	end

	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	local count, winner = countAlive()
	if count == 1 and winner then
		status.Value = winner.Name .. " wins!"
		giveWin(winner)
	else
		status.Value = "Nobody won this time!"
	end
	task.wait(4)
	for player in pairs(alive) do
		player:LoadCharacter() -- survivors go back to the lobby
	end
end

	votes[player] = nil
end)

while true do
	-- Pick some random maps to vote on
	local pool = maps:GetChildren()
	options = {}
	while #options < math.min(CHOICES, #maps:GetChildren()) do
		local pick = table.remove(pool, math.random(1, #pool))
		table.insert(options, pick.Name)
	end
	votes = {}
	-- Clients read these attributes to build their buttons
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("VoteOptions", table.concat(options, ","))
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("VotingOpen", true)
	for t = VOTE_TIME, 1, -1 do
		ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("VoteTime", t)
		task.wait(1)
	end
	ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("VotingOpen", false)

	-- Count the votes (ties go to the first one listed)
	local counts = {}
	for _, name in pairs(votes) do
		counts[name] = (counts[name] or 0) + 1
	end
	local winner = options[1]
	for _, name in ipairs(options) do
		if (counts[name] or 0) > (counts[winner] or 0) then
			winner = name
		end
	end

	if winner then
		local map = maps[winner]:Clone()
		map.Name = "CurrentMap"
		map.Parent = workspace
		local spawnPart = map:FindFirstChild("MapSpawn", true)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player.Character and spawnPart then
				player.Character:PivotTo(spawnPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(math.random(-5, 5), 4, math.random(-5, 5)))
			end
		end
		task.wait(ROUND_TIME)
		map:Destroy()
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			player:LoadCharacter()
		end
	else
		task.wait(5) -- no maps yet
	end
end

scripts.title: Musical chairs
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Folder in Workspace that holds your Seats (and optionally a Sound named Music). Players walk around the seats while the music plays.
scripts.about: While the music plays the seats are locked; when it stops everyone rushes to sit, and anyone without a seat is out until one player is left.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local folder = script.Parent
local music = folder:FindFirstChild("Music")
local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local allSeats = {}
for _, seat in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
	if seat:IsA("Seat") then
		table.insert(allSeats, seat)
	end
end

local function setSeats(count)
	for i, seat in ipairs(allSeats) do
		seat.Transparency = i <= count and 0 or 1
		seat.CanCollide = i <= count
		seat.Disabled = true -- nobody can sit until the music stops
	end
end

while true do
	while #Players:GetPlayers() < 2 do
		status.Value = "Musical chairs needs 2 players"
		task.wait(2)
	end
	local playing = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		playing[player] = true
	end
	local function count()
		local n = 0
		for player in pairs(playing) do
			if player.Parent then
				n += 1
			else
				playing[player] = nil
			end
		end
		return n
	end

	while count() > 1 do
		local seats = math.min(count() - 1, #allSeats)
		setSeats(seats)
		status.Value = "Walk around the chairs!"
		if music then
			music:Play()
		end
		task.wait(math.random(8, 16))
		if music then
			music:Stop()
		end
		status.Value = "SIT DOWN!"
		for i = 1, seats do
			allSeats[i].Disabled = false
		end
		task.wait(4)
		-- Anyone playing who is not sitting is out
		for player in pairs(playing) do
			local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not (humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart) then
				playing[player] = nil
				player:SetAttribute("Notice", "No chair! You are out.")
				if humanoid then
					humanoid.Health = 0
				end
			end
		end
		-- Stand everyone back up
		for _, seat in ipairs(allSeats) do
			if seat.Occupant then
				seat.Occupant.Sit = false
			end
		end
		task.wait(2)
	end
	for player in pairs(playing) do
		status.Value = player.Name .. " wins musical chairs!"
		local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Wins") then
			stats.Wins.Value += 1
		end
	end
	task.wait(6)
end

scripts.title: Race to the finish
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Add a Part named RaceStart (start line) and a Part named RaceFinish (finish line) to Workspace.
scripts.about: Lines everyone up, counts down, then gives places (1st, 2nd, 3rd) as racers touch the finish line, with coins for the top three.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local RACE_TIME = 90
local PRIZES = { 100, 50, 25 } -- coins for 1st, 2nd, 3rd

local startPart = workspace:WaitForChild("RaceStart")
local finishPart = workspace:WaitForChild("RaceFinish")
local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local racing = false
local finished = {}

finishPart.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if not racing or not player or table.find(finished, player) then
		return
	end
	table.insert(finished, player)
	local place = #finished
	status.Value = player.Name .. " finished #" .. place .. "!"
	local prize = PRIZES[place]
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if prize and stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins") then
		stats.Coins.Value += prize
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Place #" .. place .. "! +" .. prize .. " coins")
	end
end)

while true do
	for t = 15, 1, -1 do
		status.Value = "Race starts in " .. t
		task.wait(1)
	end
	-- Line everyone up at the start and freeze them
	local racers = {}
	for i, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			character:PivotTo(startPart.CFrame * CFrame.new((i - 1) * 4, 4, 0))
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
			table.insert(racers, humanoid)
		end
	end
	workspace:SetAttribute("Countdown", 3) -- the Big countdown script shows 3 2 1 GO
	task.wait(3)
	workspace:SetAttribute("Countdown", 0)
	finished = {}
	racing = true
	for _, humanoid in ipairs(racers) do
		if humanoid.Parent then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
		end
	end
	for t = RACE_TIME, 1, -1 do
		if #finished >= #racers then
			break
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
	racing = false
	status.Value = "Race over!"
	task.wait(4)
end

scripts.title: Random map each round
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, and put each map as a Model in a Folder named Maps in ServerStorage. Each map needs a Part named MapSpawn inside it.
scripts.about: Picks a random map from ServerStorage, puts it in the world, sends everyone onto it, then removes it when the round ends.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local LOBBY_TIME = 15
local ROUND_TIME = 60

local maps = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Maps")
local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local lastMap = nil

local function pickMap()
	local list = maps:GetChildren()
	if #list == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local choice
	repeat
		choice = list[math.random(1, #list)]
	until choice ~= lastMap or #list == 1 -- try not to play the same map twice in a row
	lastMap = choice
	return choice
end

while true do
	for t = LOBBY_TIME, 1, -1 do
		status.Value = "Next map in " .. t
		task.wait(1)
	end
	local chosen = pickMap()
	if not chosen then
		status.Value = "Add maps to ServerStorage.Maps!"
		task.wait(5)
		continue
	end
	local map = chosen:Clone()
	map.Name = "CurrentMap"
	map.Parent = workspace
	local spawnPart = map:FindFirstChild("MapSpawn", true)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		if character and spawnPart then
			-- Spread players out a little so they do not land on each other
			local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-6, 6), 4, math.random(-6, 6))
			character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spawnPart.Position + offset))
		end
	end
	for t = ROUND_TIME, 1, -1 do
		status.Value = chosen.Name .. ": " .. t
		task.wait(1)
	end
	status.Value = "Round over!"
	map:Destroy()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		player:LoadCharacter() -- back to the lobby spawn
	end
end

scripts.title: Red light, green light
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and add a Part named FinishLine to Workspace.
scripts.about: Players may run on green light, but anyone still moving when the light turns red is knocked out; reach the finish to win.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local GRACE = 0.5 -- seconds to stop after red is called
local MOVE_LIMIT = 2 -- how fast counts as "moving"

local finish = workspace:WaitForChild("FinishLine")
local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local isRed = false
local winners = {}

finish.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if player and not winners[player] then
		winners[player] = true
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "You made it!")
		local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Wins") then
			stats.Wins.Value += 1
		end
		task.delay(3, function()
			winners[player] = nil
			if player.Parent then
				player:LoadCharacter() -- back to the start to play again
			end
		end)
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)
		if isRed then
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local character = player.Character
				local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and not winners[player] then
					local flat = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
					if flat.Magnitude > MOVE_LIMIT then
						humanoid.Health = 0
						status.Value = player.Name .. " moved!"
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

while true do
	status.Value = "GREEN LIGHT"
	workspace:SetAttribute("LightColor", "Green")
	task.wait(math.random(20, 50) / 10) -- 2 to 5 seconds
	status.Value = "RED LIGHT"
	workspace:SetAttribute("LightColor", "Red")
	task.wait(GRACE)
	isRed = true
	task.wait(math.random(20, 40) / 10)
	isRed = false
end

scripts.title: Round timer with intermission
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService; add a normal Part named RoundSpawn where rounds start (not a SpawnLocation), and use the Round timer text script to show the time.
scripts.about: Runs an intermission countdown, sends everyone into a round, then brings them back to the lobby, forever.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local INTERMISSION = 15 -- seconds in the lobby between rounds
local ROUND_TIME = 60 -- seconds each round lasts
local MIN_PLAYERS = 1 -- players needed to start (use 2 for a real game)

-- The text everyone sees, shared in ReplicatedStorage
local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status")
if not status then
	status = Instance.new("StringValue")
	status.Name = "Status"
	status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

-- Count down one second at a time
local function countdown(text, seconds)
	for i = seconds, 1, -1 do
		status.Value = text .. i
		task.wait(1)
	end
end

while true do
	-- Wait until there are enough players
	while #Players:GetPlayers() < MIN_PLAYERS do
		status.Value = "Waiting for players..."
		task.wait(1)
	end

	countdown("Intermission: ", INTERMISSION)

	-- Round start: send everyone to RoundSpawn (spread out a little)
	local roundSpawn = workspace:FindFirstChild("RoundSpawn")
	if roundSpawn then
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local character = player.Character
			if character then
				local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-5, 5), 5, math.random(-5, 5))
				character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(roundSpawn.Position + offset))
			end
		end
	end

	countdown("Round: ", ROUND_TIME)

	-- Round over: respawn everyone back in the lobby
	status.Value = "Round over!"
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		player:LoadCharacter()
	end
	task.wait(3)
end

scripts.title: Send players to arena or lobby (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ServerScriptService and name it Teleports. Put Parts in a Folder named ArenaSpawns, and one Part named LobbySpawn, in Workspace.
scripts.about: Helpers that move a list of players onto different arena spawn spots, and back to the lobby when the round ends.
scripts.code:
local Teleports = {}

local function moveTo(player, cframe)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero -- stop falling speed from carrying over
		character:PivotTo(cframe + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- ToArena(players) gives each player their own spawn spot (it loops if there are more players than spots)
function Teleports.ToArena(players)
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("ArenaSpawns")
	local spots = folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}
	if #spots == 0 then
		warn("Add Parts to a Folder named ArenaSpawns")
		return {}
	end
	-- Shuffle the spots so nobody always gets the same one
	for i = #spots, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(1, i)
		spots[i], spots[j] = spots[j], spots[i]
	end
	local moved = {}
	for i, player in ipairs(players) do
		local spot = spots[(i - 1) % #spots + 1]
		if moveTo(player, spot.CFrame) then
			table.insert(moved, player)
		end
	end
	return moved -- only the players who really got moved
end

-- ToLobby(players) brings them back
function Teleports.ToLobby(players)
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("LobbySpawn")
	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		if lobby then
			moveTo(player, lobby.CFrame + Vector3.new(math.random(-5, 5), 0, math.random(-5, 5)))
		else
			player:LoadCharacter()
		end
	end
end

return Teleports

scripts.title: Survive the disaster
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and put a Part named DisasterArea over your map (its size is where disasters happen).
scripts.about: Picks a random disaster (flood, meteors or strong wind) each round, and everyone still alive at the end gets a Win.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these!
local DISASTER_TIME = 45
local area = workspace:WaitForChild("DisasterArea")

local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function randomPointAbove()
	local half = area.Size / 2
	return area.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-half.X, half.X), half.Y, math.random(-half.Z, half.Z))
end

local disasters = {}

disasters.Flood = function()
	local water = Instance.new("Part")
	water.Anchored = true
	water.CanCollide = false
	water.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 220)
	water.Transparency = 0.4
	water.Size = Vector3.new(area.Size.X, 1, area.Size.Z)
	water.Position = area.Position - Vector3.new(0, area.Size.Y / 2, 0)
	water.Parent = workspace
	for _ = 1, DISASTER_TIME do
		water.Size += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) -- rise one stud a second
		water.Position += Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
		local top = water.Position.Y + water.Size.Y / 2
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local head = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if head and humanoid and head.Position.Y < top then
				humanoid.Health = 0 -- head under water
			end
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
	water:Destroy()
end

disasters.Meteors = function()
	for _ = 1, DISASTER_TIME * 2 do
		local rock = Instance.new("Part")
		rock.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		rock.Size = Vector3.new(4, 4, 4)
		rock.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
		rock.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 50)
		rock.Position = randomPointAbove()
		rock.Parent = workspace
		rock.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			if hit.Anchored or hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
				local blast = Instance.new("Explosion")
				blast.Position = rock.Position
				blast.BlastRadius = 8
				blast.Parent = workspace
				rock:Destroy()
			end
		end)
		Debris:AddItem(rock, 10)
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
end

disasters.Wind = function()
	local push = Vector3.new(math.random(-1, 1), 0, math.random(-1, 1))
	if push.Magnitude == 0 then
		push = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
	end
	push = push.Unit * 40
	for _ = 1, DISASTER_TIME * 2 do
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += push * 0.3 -- a gust shoves you
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
end

while true do
	for t = 15, 1, -1 do
		status.Value = "Disaster in " .. t
		task.wait(1)
	end
	local names = {}
	for name in pairs(disasters) do
		table.insert(names, name)
	end
	local name = names[math.random(1, #names)]
	status.Value = "DISASTER: " .. name .. "!"
	disasters[name]()
	-- Everyone still alive wins
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Wins") then
			stats.Wins.Value += 1
			player:SetAttribute("Notice", "You survived the " .. name .. "!")
		end
	end
	status.Value = "Survivors get a Win!"
	task.wait(5)
end

scripts.title: Tag, you're it!
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.
scripts.about: One random player is "It" and glows red; touching another player makes them It, and whoever is It the least time wins.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local ROUND_TIME = 120
local TAG_COOLDOWN = 2 -- seconds before you can tag back

local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local it = nil
local lastTag = 0
local timeAsIt = {}

local function setIt(player)
	if it and it.Character then
		local old = it.Character:FindFirstChild("ItGlow")
		if old then
			old:Destroy()
		end
	end
	it = player
	lastTag = os.clock()
	if player and player.Character then
		local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")
		glow.Name = "ItGlow"
		glow.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
		glow.Parent = player.Character
		status.Value = player.Name .. " is IT!"
	end
end

-- Watch every character's parts for touches from the It player
local function hookCharacter(player, character)
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				local toucher = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
				if toucher and toucher == it and player ~= it and os.clock() - lastTag > TAG_COOLDOWN then
					setIt(player)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		hookCharacter(player, character)
		if player == it then
			setIt(player) -- put the glow back after respawning
		end
	end)
end)

while true do
	while #Players:GetPlayers() < 2 do
		status.Value = "Need 2 players for tag"
		task.wait(2)
	end
	timeAsIt = {}
	local everyone = Players:GetPlayers()
	setIt(everyone[math.random(1, #everyone)])
	for t = ROUND_TIME, 1, -1 do
		task.wait(1)
		if not it or not it.Parent then
			local list = Players:GetPlayers()
			setIt(list[math.random(1, #list)])
		end
		timeAsIt[it] = (timeAsIt[it] or 0) + 1
	end
	-- Winner: the player who was It for the shortest time
	local best, bestTime = nil, math.huge
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local seconds = timeAsIt[player] or 0
		if seconds < bestTime then
			best, bestTime = player, seconds
		end
	end
	setIt(nil)
	status.Value = best and (best.Name .. " wins tag!") or "Tag over"
	task.wait(8)
end

scripts.title: Team deathmatch round
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and make two Teams in the Teams service. Weapons must add a "creator" tag (the weapon scripts here do).
scripts.about: Each knockout gives your team a point; when the timer runs out the team with the most points wins and every player on it gets a Win.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local ROUND_TIME = 180

local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local teamScores = {}

local function scoreText()
	local parts = {}
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		table.insert(parts, team.Name .. " " .. (teamScores[team] or 0))
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "  vs  ")
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
			local killer = tag and tag.Value
			if killer and killer:IsA("Player") and killer.Team and killer.Team ~= player.Team then
				teamScores[killer.Team] = (teamScores[killer.Team] or 0) + 1
			end
		end)
	end)
end)

while true do
	teamScores = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		player:LoadCharacter() -- everyone starts at their team spawn
	end
	for t = ROUND_TIME, 1, -1 do
		status.Value = scoreText() .. "   (" .. t .. ")"
		task.wait(1)
	end
	local best, bestScore, tie = nil, -1, false
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		local score = teamScores[team] or 0
		if score > bestScore then
			best, bestScore, tie = team, score, false
		elseif score == bestScore then
			tie = true
		end
	end
	if best and not tie then
		status.Value = best.Name .. " team wins! " .. scoreText()
		for _, player in ipairs(best:GetPlayers()) do
			local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			if stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Wins") then
				stats.Wins.Value += 1
			end
		end
	else
		status.Value = "It's a tie! " .. scoreText()
	end
	task.wait(8)
end

scripts.title: Wait for enough players (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ServerScriptService and name it WaitForPlayers. In a round script: require(game.ServerScriptService.WaitForPlayers)(2).
scripts.about: Pauses your round script until enough players are in the server, showing "Waiting for players (1/2)" in the Status text.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

-- Call it with how many players you need. It returns when there are enough.
-- In Studio's Play Solo there is only you, so it lets 1 player through when STUDIO_TEST is true.
local STUDIO_TEST = true

return function(minimum)
	minimum = minimum or 2
	if STUDIO_TEST and game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then
		minimum = 1
	end
	while #Players:GetPlayers() < minimum do
		status.Value = "Waiting for players (" .. #Players:GetPlayers() .. "/" .. minimum .. ")"
		-- Wake up as soon as someone joins, or check again after 5 seconds
		local joined = false
		local connection = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
			joined = true
		end)
		local waited = 0
		while not joined and waited < 5 do
			task.wait(0.25)
			waited += 0.25
		end
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	return Players:GetPlayers()
end

scripts.title: Win pad
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the finish Part at the end of your obby or race, and add a Part named Lobby in Workspace if you want winners sent back there.
scripts.about: Touching the finish gives the player a Win on the leaderboard and sends them back to the lobby.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local LOBBY_NAME = "Lobby" -- winners get sent to a part with this name (if it exists)
local COOLDOWN = 5 -- seconds before the same player can win again

local pad = script.Parent
local recent = {} -- players who just won

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player or recent[player] then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	recent[player] = true

	-- Find (or make) the Wins number on the leaderboard
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
		leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
		leaderstats.Parent = player
	end
	local wins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Wins")
	if not wins then
		wins = Instance.new("IntValue")
		wins.Name = "Wins"
		wins.Parent = leaderstats
	end
	wins.Value = wins.Value + 1

	-- Send the winner back to the lobby
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild(LOBBY_NAME)
	if lobby and lobby:IsA("BasePart") then
		character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(lobby.Position + Vector3.new(0, lobby.Size.Y / 2 + 3, 0)))
	end

	task.delay(COOLDOWN, function()
		recent[player] = nil
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Zombie infection round
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.
scripts.about: One player starts as a green zombie; zombies turn humans into zombies by touching them, and humans who survive the timer win.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local ROUND_TIME = 120
local ZOMBIE_SPEED = 18

local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status") or Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local zombies = {}
local roundOn = false

local function makeZombie(player)
	zombies[player] = true
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")
	glow.Name = "ZombieGlow"
	glow.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 60)
	glow.Parent = character
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = ZOMBIE_SPEED
	end
	-- Touching with a zombie body infects humans
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				local victim = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
				if roundOn and zombies[player] and victim and not zombies[victim] then
					makeZombie(victim)
					status.Value = victim.Name .. " got infected!"
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function humansLeft()
	local list = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if not zombies[player] then
			table.insert(list, player)
		end
	end
	return list
end

while true do
	while #Players:GetPlayers() < 2 do
		status.Value = "Need 2 players"
		task.wait(2)
	end
	-- Fresh characters for everyone (removes old zombie looks)
	zombies = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		player:LoadCharacter()
	end
	for t = 10, 1, -1 do
		status.Value = "Run! Patient zero in " .. t
		task.wait(1)
	end
	local everyone = Players:GetPlayers()
	roundOn = true
	makeZombie(everyone[math.random(1, #everyone)])
	for t = ROUND_TIME, 1, -1 do
		local humans = humansLeft()
		if #humans == 0 then
			break
		end
		status.Value = #humans .. " humans left, " .. t .. "s"
		task.wait(1)
	end
	roundOn = false
	local survivors = humansLeft()
	if #survivors > 0 then
		status.Value = "Humans survive!"
		for _, player in ipairs(survivors) do
			local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			if stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Wins") then
				stats.Wins.Value += 1
			end
		end
	else
		status.Value = "The zombies took over!"
	end
	task.wait(6)
end

scripts.title: All time record sign
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an anchored Part with a flat front (the sign). It watches a leaderstats value (Coins by default).
scripts.about: Remembers the highest score anyone has ever reached in any server, shows it with the holder's name, and announces when someone beats it.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

-- Settings: change this!
local STAT_NAME = "Coins"

local sign = script.Parent
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("AllTimeRecord_v1")
local KEY = STAT_NAME

local surface = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
surface.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
surface.Parent = sign
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 20, 10)
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
label.TextScaled = true
label.Text = "Loading record..."
label.Parent = surface

local record = { value = 0, name = "nobody" }
local function show()
	label.Text = "ALL TIME RECORD\n" .. record.value .. " " .. STAT_NAME .. "\nby " .. record.name
end

local ok, saved = pcall(function()
	return store:GetAsync(KEY)
end)
if ok and type(saved) == "table" then
	record = saved
end
show()

while true do
	task.wait(30)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
		if stat and stat.Value > record.value then
			local newRecord = { value = stat.Value, name = player.DisplayName }
			-- UpdateAsync makes sure another server's higher record is never overwritten
			local saveOk, result = pcall(function()
				return store:UpdateAsync(KEY, function(old)
					if type(old) == "table" and old.value >= newRecord.value then
						return nil
					end
					return newRecord
				end)
			end)
			if saveOk then
				record = result or record
				if record.name == newRecord.name then
					workspace:SetAttribute("Announcement", "")
					workspace:SetAttribute("Announcement", player.DisplayName .. " set a new record!")
				end
				show()
			end
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Crown on the richest player
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. It looks at a leaderstats value (Coins by default).
scripts.about: Puts a floating golden crown above the head of whoever has the most coins in the server, and moves it when someone passes them.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change this!

local current = nil

local function makeCrown()
	local crown = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	crown.Name = "LeaderCrown"
	crown.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60)
	crown.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	crown.AlwaysOnTop = true

	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "#1"
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 40)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.Parent = crown
	return crown
end

local function richest()
	local best, bestValue = nil, 0
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
		if stat and stat.Value > bestValue then
			best, bestValue = player, stat.Value
		end
	end
	return best
end

while true do

	local leader = richest()
	local head = leader and leader.Character and leader.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

		end
	end
	if head and not head:FindFirstChild("LeaderCrown") then

local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")

	local statNames = {}

		table.insert(rows, { cells = cells, sortBy = tonumber(cells[2]) or 0, me = other == player })
	end
	table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
		return a.sortBy > b.sortBy
	end)
	for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
		addRow(i, row.cells, row.me and Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255) or nil)
	end
end

ContextActionService:BindAction("ShowScores", function(_, state)

scripts.title: Daily or weekly top board
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an anchored Part (the board). It counts how much of a leaderstats value (like Coins) players EARN today or this week.
scripts.about: A top 10 board that starts fresh every day (or every week), so new players can get to the top too.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

-- Settings: change these!
local STAT_NAME = "Coins"
local PERIOD = "Daily" -- "Daily" or "Weekly"

local board = script.Parent

-- Each day (or week) gets its own store name, so the board resets by itself
local function periodKey()
	local day = math.floor(os.time() / 86400)
	if PERIOD == "Weekly" then
		return "Week" .. math.floor(day / 7)
	end
	return "Day" .. day
end

local surface = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
surface.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
surface.Parent = board
local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
text.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 25, 45)
text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
text.TextScaled = true
text.Parent = surface

-- Remember each player's stat when they join, so we only count what they earn
local startValue = {}
local earned = {}
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local stat = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild(STAT_NAME, 10)
	if not stat then
		return
	end
	startValue[player] = stat.Value
	stat.Changed:Connect(function(value)
		if value < startValue[player] then
			startValue[player] = value -- they spent some; do not count that as negative
		end
		earned[player] = (earned[player] or 0) + math.max(0, value - startValue[player])
		startValue[player] = value
	end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	startValue[player] = nil
end)

while true do
	task.wait(60)
	local store = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore(STAT_NAME .. PERIOD .. "_" .. periodKey())
	for player, amount in pairs(earned) do
		earned[player] = nil
		pcall(function()
			store:IncrementAsync(tostring(player.UserId), math.floor(amount))
		end)
	end
	local ok, page = pcall(function()
		return store:GetSortedAsync(false, 10):GetCurrentPage()
	end)
	if ok then
		local lines = { PERIOD .. " top " .. STAT_NAME }
		for rank, entry in ipairs(page) do
			local nameOk, name = pcall(Players.GetNameFromUserIdAsync, Players, tonumber(entry.key))
			table.insert(lines, rank .. ". " .. (nameOk and name or "???") .. "  " .. entry.value)
		end
		text.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
	end
end

scripts.title: Damage dealt stat
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Weapons must add a "creator" tag to what they hit (the weapon scripts here do).
scripts.about: Adds a Damage stat to the player list that adds up all the damage each player does to players and enemies.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function watchHumanoid(humanoid)
	local lastHealth = humanoid.Health
	humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
		local lost = lastHealth - health
		lastHealth = health
		if lost <= 0 then
			return -- healing, not damage
		end
		-- Whoever tagged this humanoid most recently gets the credit
		local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
		local attacker = tag and tag.Value
		if attacker and attacker:IsA("Player") and attacker.Character ~= humanoid.Parent then
			local stat = attacker:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and attacker.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Damage")
			if stat then
				stat.Value += math.floor(lost + 0.5)
			end
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	local damage = Instance.new("IntValue")
	damage.Name = "Damage"
	damage.Parent = leaderstats
end)

-- Watch every Humanoid in the world: players and NPCs
for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if object:IsA("Humanoid") then
		watchHumanoid(object)
	end
end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
	if object:IsA("Humanoid") then
		watchHumanoid(object)
	end
end)

scripts.title: Fastest times board
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an anchored Part (the board). It uses the Best Time value made by the Obby speedrun timer script.
scripts.about: Saves every player's best obby time and shows the 10 fastest times from all servers, quickest at the top.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

-- Settings: change these!
local STAT_NAME = "Best Time"
local REFRESH_EVERY = 60

local board = script.Parent
local store = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("FastestTimes_v1")

local surface = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
surface.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
surface.Parent = board
local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
text.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 35, 30)
text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
text.Font = Enum.Font.Code
text.TextScaled = true
text.Parent = surface

while true do
	-- OrderedDataStores only hold whole numbers, so save hundredths of a second (12.34 s = 1234)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local best = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
		if best and best.Value > 0 then
			local hundredths = math.floor(best.Value * 100 + 0.5)
			pcall(function()
				store:UpdateAsync(tostring(player.UserId), function(old)
					if old and old <= hundredths then
						return nil -- their saved time is already faster
					end
					return hundredths
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
	-- true = smallest first (fastest times on top)
	local ok, page = pcall(function()
		return store:GetSortedAsync(true, 10):GetCurrentPage()
	end)
	if ok then
		local lines = { "FASTEST TIMES" }
		for rank, entry in ipairs(page) do
			local nameOk, name = pcall(Players.GetNameFromUserIdAsync, Players, tonumber(entry.key))
			table.insert(lines, string.format("%d. %s  %.2fs", rank, nameOk and name or "???", entry.value / 100))
		end
		text.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
	end
	task.wait(REFRESH_EVERY)
end

scripts.title: Global top 10 board

scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

-- Settings: change these!
local STAT_NAME = "Wins"
local TITLE = "Top Winners"
local REFRESH_EVERY = 60

local board = script.Parent
-- OrderedDataStores can sort numbers, so we can ask "who is the highest?"
local store = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("Global" .. STAT_NAME .. "_v1")

surface.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud

surface.Parent = board
local list = Instance.new("Frame")

list.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
list.Parent = surface

	label.LayoutOrder = order

	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	label.Text = text
	label.Parent = list
end

local MEDALS = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), Color3.fromRGB(205, 127, 50) }

local function refresh()
	-- First save everyone in this server
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
		if stat then
			pcall(function()

		end
	end
	-- Then read the top 10 (false = biggest first)
	local ok, page = pcall(function()
		return store:GetSortedAsync(false, 10):GetCurrentPage()
	end)
	if not ok then
		return
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	row(0, TITLE, Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255))
	for rank, entry in ipairs(page) do
		local nameOk, name = pcall(function()
			return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(tonumber(entry.key))
		end)
		row(rank, rank .. ". " .. (nameOk and name or "???") .. "  " .. entry.value, MEDALS[rank])
	end
end

while true do
	refresh()
	task.wait(REFRESH_EVERY)
end

scripts.title: K/D ratio stat
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService together with the Kills and Deaths on the leaderboard script.
scripts.about: Adds a K/D number to the player list (kills divided by deaths) that updates every time either number changes.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")
	local kills = leaderstats:WaitForChild("Kills")
	local deaths = leaderstats:WaitForChild("Deaths")

	-- A StringValue lets us show "1.50" with 2 decimals
	local ratio = Instance.new("StringValue")
	ratio.Name = "K/D"
	ratio.Parent = leaderstats

	local function update()
		-- Dividing by 0 is not allowed, so with 0 deaths the ratio is just the kills
		local value = kills.Value / math.max(deaths.Value, 1)
		ratio.Value = string.format("%.2f", value)
	end
	kills.Changed:Connect(update)
	deaths.Changed:Connect(update)
	update()
end)

scripts.title: Kills and Deaths on the leaderboard
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Weapons must add a "creator" tag to victims (the weapon scripts here do).
scripts.about: Adds Kills and Deaths to the player list and counts them up every time someone is knocked out.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function getStat(player, name)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	return stats and stats:FindFirstChild(name)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Kills", "Deaths" }) do
		if not leaderstats:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local value = Instance.new("IntValue")
			value.Name = name
			value.Parent = leaderstats
		end
	end

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			local deaths = getStat(player, "Deaths")
			if deaths then
				deaths.Value += 1
			end
			-- The creator tag tells us who did the damage last
			local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
			local killer = tag and tag.Value
			if killer and killer:IsA("Player") and killer ~= player then
				local kills = getStat(killer, "Kills")
				if kills then
					kills.Value += 1
				end
			end
		end)
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Send scores to a global board (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ServerScriptService and name it BoardWriter. Use require(game.ServerScriptService.BoardWriter).Submit("Wins", player, 25).
scripts.about: Saves a player's score to a global board, keeping only their best score, and waits politely so DataStore limits are not hit.
scripts.code:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local BoardWriter = {}

local stores = {}
local queue = {} -- waiting saves: queue["Wins|12345"] = {board, userId, score}

local function storeFor(boardName)
	if not stores[boardName] then
		stores[boardName] = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("Global" .. boardName .. "_v1")
	end
	return stores[boardName]
end

-- Submit(boardName, player, score, lowerIsBetter)
-- lowerIsBetter = true for things like fastest times
function BoardWriter.Submit(boardName, player, score, lowerIsBetter)
	score = math.floor(score)
	local key = boardName .. "|" .. player.UserId
	local waiting = queue[key]
	-- If there is already a better score waiting, keep that one
	if waiting and ((lowerIsBetter and waiting.score <= score) or (not lowerIsBetter and waiting.score >= score)) then
		return
	end
	queue[key] = { board = boardName, userId = player.UserId, score = score, lower = lowerIsBetter }
end

-- Every 30 seconds, write the waiting scores one at a time
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(30)
		for key, item in pairs(queue) do
			queue[key] = nil
			pcall(function()
				storeFor(item.board):UpdateAsync(tostring(item.userId), function(old)
					if old and ((item.lower and old <= item.score) or (not item.lower and old >= item.score)) then
						return nil -- the saved score is already better
					end
					return item.score
				end)
			end)
			task.wait(1) -- small gap between saves
		end
	end
end)

return BoardWriter

scripts.title: Tell players their global rank

scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

-- Settings: change these!
local STAT_NAME = "Wins"
local CHECK_TOP = 100 -- how far down the list to look (bigger costs more requests)

local store = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("Global" .. STAT_NAME .. "_v1")

local function findRank(userId)
	local ok, pages = pcall(function()
		return store:GetSortedAsync(false, 100) -- 100 entries per page
	end)
	if not ok then
		return nil
	end
	local rank = 0
	while rank < CHECK_TOP do
		for _, entry in ipairs(pages:GetCurrentPage()) do
			rank += 1
			if tonumber(entry.key) == userId then
				return rank
			end
		end
		if pages.IsFinished or rank >= CHECK_TOP then
			break
		end
		local nextOk = pcall(function()
			pages:AdvanceToNextPageAsync()
		end)
		if not nextOk then
			break
		end
	end
	return nil
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.wait(8) -- let other scripts load their data and show welcome messages first
	if not player.Parent then
		return
	end
	local rank = findRank(player.UserId)
	if rank then
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "You are #" .. rank .. " in the world for " .. STAT_NAME .. "!")
	else
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Get more " .. STAT_NAME .. " to reach the top " .. CHECK_TOP .. "!")
	end
end)

scripts.title: Clock with moving hands
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model with an Anchored Part named Center (its front face is the clock face) and Anchored Parts named HourHand, MinuteHand and SecondHand (each long along Y).
scripts.about: Turns the clock hands to show the real time of day, ticking every second.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change this to your time zone! (hours away from UTC, like -5 for New York, 1 for Paris)
local TIME_ZONE = -5

local model = script.Parent
local center = model:WaitForChild("Center")
local hands = {
	{ part = model:WaitForChild("HourHand"), depth = 0.2 },
	{ part = model:WaitForChild("MinuteHand"), depth = 0.3 },
	{ part = model:WaitForChild("SecondHand"), depth = 0.4 },
}

-- Point a hand at an angle (0 = 12 o'clock) with one end at the middle of the clock
local function placeHand(hand, fraction)
	local angle = fraction * math.pi * 2
	local part = hand.part
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CFrame = center.CFrame
		* CFrame.new(0, 0, -hand.depth) -- sit a bit in front of the face so you can see it
		* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, angle) -- turn clockwise
		* CFrame.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2, 0) -- move out so the end sits in the middle
end

while true do
	local now = os.date("!*t", os.time() + TIME_ZONE * 3600)
	local seconds = now.sec
	local minutes = now.min + seconds / 60
	local hours = (now.hour % 12) + minutes / 60
	placeHand(hands[1], hours / 12)
	placeHand(hands[2], minutes / 60)
	placeHand(hands[3], seconds / 60)
	task.wait(1)
end

scripts.title: Domino run
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part on the floor; its front face points where the line of dominoes goes.
scripts.about: Click the part to set up a fresh line of dominoes and knock the first one over.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local COUNT = 30 -- how many dominoes
local GAP = 2.5 -- studs between dominoes
local SIZE = Vector3.new(3, 5, 0.6)

local base = script.Parent
local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "Dominoes"
folder.Parent = workspace

local clicker = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
clicker.MaxActivationDistance = 30
clicker.Parent = base

local function buildAndPush()
	folder:ClearAllChildren()
	local first
	for i = 1, COUNT do
		local domino = Instance.new("Part")
		domino.Size = SIZE
		-- Line them up in front of the base, standing on the floor
		local offset = CFrame.new(0, SIZE.Y / 2 - base.Size.Y / 2, -(i * GAP))
		domino.CFrame = base.CFrame * offset
		domino.Color = Color3.fromHSV((i / COUNT) % 1, 0.7, 1) -- rainbow!
		domino.Parent = folder
		domino:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
		first = first or domino
	end
	task.wait(1)
	-- Tip the first one over by pushing its top forward
	local push = base.CFrame.LookVector * first.AssemblyMass * 15
	first:ApplyImpulseAtPosition(push, first.Position + Vector3.new(0, SIZE.Y / 2, 0))
end

local busy = false
clicker.MouseClick:Connect(function()
	if busy then
		return
	end
	busy = true
	buildAndPush()
	task.wait(3)
	busy = false
end)

a1.WorldCFrame = a0.WorldCFrame

local hinge = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
hinge.Attachment0 = a0
hinge.Attachment1 = a1
hinge.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Motor
hinge.AngularVelocity = SPEED
hinge.MotorMaxTorque = TORQUE
hinge.MotorMaxAcceleration = 1 -- start and stop gently
hinge.Parent = hub

-- Let the server run the physics so it looks the same for everyone
hub:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

scripts.title: Flipper arm that launches you
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a flat unanchored Part (the flipper) and add an Anchored Part named FlipperPivot at one end, turned so its red X arrow runs along the hinge line.
scripts.about: Every few seconds the flipper snaps up with a physics hinge and flings anything standing on it.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local FLIP_ANGLE = 60 -- degrees it flips up (use -60 if it flips the wrong way)
local FLIP_SPEED = 25 -- radians per second, very fast
local WAIT_TIME = 3 -- seconds between flips

local flipper = script.Parent
local pivot = flipper.Parent:WaitForChild("FlipperPivot")
pivot.Anchored = true
flipper.Anchored = false

local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a0.Parent = pivot
local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a1.Parent = flipper
a1.WorldCFrame = a0.WorldCFrame

local hinge = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
hinge.Attachment0 = a0
hinge.Attachment1 = a1
hinge.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
hinge.ServoMaxTorque = 1e10
hinge.AngularSpeed = FLIP_SPEED
hinge.TargetAngle = 0
hinge.Parent = flipper

flipper:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

while true do
	task.wait(WAIT_TIME)
	hinge.AngularSpeed = FLIP_SPEED
	hinge.TargetAngle = FLIP_ANGLE -- SNAP up!
	task.wait(0.5)
	hinge.AngularSpeed = 2 -- come back down slowly
