scripts.title: Laser that turns on and off
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a thin Anchored Part that is your laser beam (Neon material looks best).
keywords: laser that turns on and off
scripts.about: The laser blinks on and off, and touching it while it is on resets you.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local ON_TIME = 2 -- seconds the laser is dangerous
local OFF_TIME = 2 -- seconds the laser is safe
local LASER_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)

local laser = script.Parent
laser.Anchored = true
laser.CanCollide = false -- you walk through it (and get zapped!)
laser.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
laser.Color = LASER_COLOR

-- Touching the laser only works while CanTouch is true (when it is on)
laser.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end)

-- Blink forever
while true do
	-- ON: you can see it and it hurts
	laser.Transparency = 0.2
	laser.CanTouch = true
	task.wait(ON_TIME)

	-- OFF: invisible and safe
	laser.Transparency = 1
	laser.CanTouch = false
	task.wait(OFF_TIME)
end

scripts.title: Low gravity zone
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts, then make a Folder named LowGravityZones in Workspace with invisible, non-colliding Parts inside.
scripts.about: Inside a low gravity zone players float down slowly and jump much higher, like on the moon.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change this number!
local GRAVITY_SCALE = 0.25 -- 0.25 = a quarter of normal gravity, 0 = no gravity at all

local character = script.Parent
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local zones = workspace:WaitForChild("LowGravityZones")

local function isInside(part, point)
	local localPoint = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	return math.abs(localPoint.X) <= half.X and math.abs(localPoint.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(localPoint.Z) <= half.Z
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	for _, zone in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
		if zone:IsA("BasePart") and isInside(zone, root.Position) then
			-- Push up a little to cancel part of the gravity pulling us down
			local lift = workspace.Gravity * (1 - GRAVITY_SCALE) * deltaTime
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)
			return
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Moving saw blade
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Cylinder Part (the saw) standing on its edge.
scripts.about: The saw spins fast and slides back and forth, resetting anyone it touches.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SLIDE_DISTANCE = 16 -- how far it slides each way (studs)
local SLIDE_SPEED = 1 -- bigger = faster sliding
local SPIN_SPEED = 720 -- degrees per second

local saw = script.Parent
saw.Anchored = true
local start = saw.CFrame
local spin = 0

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	spin = (spin + SPIN_SPEED * deltaTime) % 360
	-- Slide along the saw's front direction using a smooth sine wave
	local offset = math.sin(os.clock() * SLIDE_SPEED) * SLIDE_DISTANCE
	-- A Roblox cylinder spins around its X axis
	saw.CFrame = start * CFrame.new(0, 0, offset) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(spin), 0, 0)
end)

saw.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid.Health = 0
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: No jumping zone
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored, non-colliding Part that covers the area where jumping is not allowed.
scripts.about: Players inside the zone cannot jump until they walk out of it.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local zone = script.Parent
zone.CanCollide = false
local params = OverlapParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { zone }

local blocked = {} -- humanoid -> the jump numbers they had before

while true do
	task.wait(0.2)
	local inside = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(zone, params)) do
		local humanoid = part.Parent and part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent) then
			inside[humanoid] = true
		end
	end

	for humanoid in pairs(inside) do
		if not blocked[humanoid] then
			blocked[humanoid] = { humanoid.JumpHeight, humanoid.JumpPower }
			humanoid.JumpHeight = 0
			humanoid.JumpPower = 0 -- for games that use JumpPower instead
		end
	end

	for humanoid, old in pairs(blocked) do
		if not inside[humanoid] then
			if humanoid.Parent then
				humanoid.JumpHeight = old[1]
				humanoid.JumpPower = old[2]
			end
			blocked[humanoid] = nil
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Obby speedrun timer
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, then add two Anchored Parts to Workspace named TimerStart and TimerFinish.
scripts.about: Starts a stopwatch when you touch the start, stops it at the finish and shows your best time on the leaderboard.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local startPart = workspace:WaitForChild("TimerStart")
local finishPart = workspace:WaitForChild("TimerFinish")
local startedAt = {} -- player -> the time they touched the start

-- Make a "Best Time" stat on the leaderboard
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	local best = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	best.Name = "Best Time"
	best.Value = 0 -- 0 means "no time yet"
	best.Parent = leaderstats
end)

startPart.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if player then
		startedAt[player] = os.clock() -- touching the start again restarts the clock
	end
end)

finishPart.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if not player or not startedAt[player] then
		return
	end
	local seconds = os.clock() - startedAt[player]
	startedAt[player] = nil
	seconds = math.floor(seconds * 100) / 100 -- keep 2 decimals

	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local best = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Best Time")
	if best and (best.Value == 0 or seconds < best.Value) then
		best.Value = seconds
	end
	player:SetAttribute("LastRunTime", seconds) -- a GUI can show this
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	startedAt[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Obby stage counter

scripts.about: Shows each player's obby stage on the leaderboard and raises it when they reach a new stage.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: set to true so players can't skip stages
local ONLY_NEXT_STAGE = false

local checkpoints = workspace:WaitForChild("Checkpoints")

-- Make the Stage number on the leaderboard
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
		leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats" -- must be lowercase like this!
		leaderstats.Parent = player
	end
	local stage = Instance.new("IntValue")
	stage.Name = "Stage"
	stage.Value = 0
	stage.Parent = leaderstats
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

-- Touching a stage part raises your Stage number
local function setupStage(part)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local number = tonumber(part.Name)
		local leaderstats = player and player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local stage = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Stage")
		if not stage or not number then
			return
		end
		if ONLY_NEXT_STAGE then
			if number == stage.Value + 1 then
				stage.Value = number
			end
		elseif number > stage.Value then
			stage.Value = number
		end
	end)
end

for _, part in ipairs(checkpoints:GetChildren()) do
	setupStage(part)
end
checkpoints.ChildAdded:Connect(setupStage)

scripts.title: Pop-up spikes
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part (or spike mesh) sitting where the spikes stick out of the floor.
keywords: spikes come out of the floor
scripts.about: The spikes slide down into the floor and pop back up, hurting anyone standing on them.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local HIDE_DEPTH = 4 -- how far down the spikes hide (studs)
local UP_TIME = 1.5 -- seconds the spikes stay up
local DOWN_TIME = 2 -- seconds the spikes stay hidden
local DAMAGE = 35

local spikes = script.Parent
spikes.Anchored = true
local upCFrame = spikes.CFrame
local downCFrame = upCFrame * CFrame.new(0, -HIDE_DEPTH, 0)

local popUp = TweenService:Create(spikes, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { CFrame = upCFrame })
local goDown = TweenService:Create(spikes, TweenInfo.new(0.6), { CFrame = downCFrame })

local dangerous = false
local lastHit = {}

spikes.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not dangerous or not player or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	-- Only hurt the same player once each time the spikes pop up
	if lastHit[player] then
		return
	end
	lastHit[player] = true
	humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
end)

spikes.CFrame = downCFrame
while true do
	task.wait(DOWN_TIME)
	table.clear(lastHit)
	dangerous = true
	popUp:Play()
	task.wait(UP_TIME)
	dangerous = false
	goDown:Play()
	goDown.Completed:Wait()
end

scripts.title: Quicksand pit
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part that covers the quicksand area (turn CanCollide off so players sink into it).
scripts.about: Players inside the quicksand move slowly, can barely jump and lose health until they get out.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SLOW_SPEED = 4 -- walk speed while inside
local SLOW_JUMP = 2 -- jump height while inside
local DAMAGE_PER_SECOND = 5 -- set to 0 for no damage

local zone = script.Parent
local params = OverlapParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { zone }

local stuck = {} -- humanoid -> {speed, jump} we must give back later

while true do
	task.wait(0.25)
	-- Find every humanoid with a body part inside the zone
	local inside = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(zone, params)) do
		local humanoid = part.Parent and part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent) then
			inside[humanoid] = true
		end
	end

	-- Slow down everyone inside
	for humanoid in pairs(inside) do
		if not stuck[humanoid] then
			stuck[humanoid] = { humanoid.WalkSpeed, humanoid.JumpHeight }
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = SLOW_SPEED
		humanoid.JumpHeight = SLOW_JUMP
		humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE_PER_SECOND * 0.25)
	end

	-- Give speed back to anyone who escaped
	for humanoid, saved in pairs(stuck) do
		if not inside[humanoid] then
			if humanoid.Parent then
				humanoid.WalkSpeed = saved[1]
				humanoid.JumpHeight = saved[2]
			end
			stuck[humanoid] = nil
		end
	end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local STRIKE_EVERY = 1.5 -- seconds between strikes
local WARNING_TIME = 1.2 -- seconds you get to run away
local RADIUS = 6 -- size of the strike
local DAMAGE = 45

local floor = script.Parent

local function strike()
	-- Pick a random spot on top of the floor
	local x = (math.random() - 0.5) * floor.Size.X
	local z = (math.random() - 0.5) * floor.Size.Z
	local spot = (floor.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, floor.Size.Y / 2, z)).Position

	-- A flat red circle warns players
	local circle = Instance.new("Part")
	circle.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	circle.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, RADIUS * 2, RADIUS * 2)
	circle.CFrame = CFrame.new(spot) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	circle.Anchored = true
	circle.CanCollide = false
	circle.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	circle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
	circle.Transparency = 0.5
	circle.Parent = workspace
	task.wait(WARNING_TIME)
	circle:Destroy()

	-- The bolt: a tall glowing beam from the sky
	local bolt = Instance.new("Part")
	bolt.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 200, 1.5)
	bolt.CFrame = CFrame.new(spot + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0))
	bolt.Anchored = true
	bolt.CanCollide = false
	bolt.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	bolt.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 230, 255)
	bolt.Parent = workspace
	Debris:AddItem(bolt, 0.25)

	-- Hurt everyone inside the circle
	local hurt = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(spot, RADIUS)) do
		local humanoid = part.Parent and part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and not hurt[humanoid] and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent) then
			hurt[humanoid] = true
			humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
		end
	end
end

while true do
	task.spawn(strike)
	task.wait(STRIKE_EVERY)
end

scripts.title: Random maze generator
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and add an Anchored Part named MazeCorner in Workspace where the maze should start (its corner).
scripts.about: Builds a brand new random maze out of wall parts every time the server starts.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local WIDTH = 12 -- cells across
local HEIGHT = 12 -- cells deep
local CELL = 12 -- studs per cell
local WALL_HEIGHT = 10
local WALL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(70, 120, 70)

local corner = workspace:WaitForChild("MazeCorner")
local origin = corner.Position

-- walls[x][y] = {N=true, E=true, S=true, W=true} means that wall is still standing
local walls, visited = {}, {}
for x = 1, WIDTH do
	walls[x], visited[x] = {}, {}
	for y = 1, HEIGHT do
		walls[x][y] = { N = true, E = true, S = true, W = true }
	end
end

local moves = { { 0, -1, "N", "S" }, { 1, 0, "E", "W" }, { 0, 1, "S", "N" }, { -1, 0, "W", "E" } }

-- "Recursive backtracker": walk randomly, knocking down walls, and back up at dead ends
local stack = { { 1, 1 } }
visited[1][1] = true
while #stack > 0 do
	local x, y = stack[#stack][1], stack[#stack][2]
	local options = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(moves) do
		local nx, ny = x + m[1], y + m[2]
		if nx >= 1 and nx <= WIDTH and ny >= 1 and ny <= HEIGHT and not visited[nx][ny] then
			table.insert(options, m)
		end
	end
	if #options == 0 then
		table.remove(stack)
	else
		local m = options[math.random(#options)]
		local nx, ny = x + m[1], y + m[2]
		walls[x][y][m[3]] = false
		walls[nx][ny][m[4]] = false
		visited[nx][ny] = true
		table.insert(stack, { nx, ny })
	end
end

-- Open an entrance and an exit
walls[1][1].W = false
walls[WIDTH][HEIGHT].E = false

-- Build the walls as parts
local model = Instance.new("Model")
model.Name = "Maze"
local function wall(position, size)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.Size = size
	part.Position = origin + position + Vector3.new(0, WALL_HEIGHT / 2, 0)
	part.Color = WALL_COLOR
	part.Parent = model
end
for x = 1, WIDTH do
	for y = 1, HEIGHT do
		local cx, cz = (x - 0.5) * CELL, (y - 0.5) * CELL
		local w = walls[x][y]
		if w.N then wall(Vector3.new(cx, 0, cz - CELL / 2), Vector3.new(CELL + 1, WALL_HEIGHT, 1)) end
		if w.W then wall(Vector3.new(cx - CELL / 2, 0, cz), Vector3.new(1, WALL_HEIGHT, CELL + 1)) end
		if y == HEIGHT and w.S then wall(Vector3.new(cx, 0, cz + CELL / 2), Vector3.new(CELL + 1, WALL_HEIGHT, 1)) end
		if x == WIDTH and w.E then wall(Vector3.new(cx + CELL / 2, 0, cz), Vector3.new(1, WALL_HEIGHT, CELL + 1)) end
	end
end
model.Parent = workspace

scripts.title: Rising lava
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a big flat lava Part placed at the bottom of your map (make it Anchored).
scripts.about: The lava slowly rises up, kills anyone it touches, then drops back down and starts again.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local RISE_SPEED = 2 -- studs per second (bigger = faster)
local RISE_HEIGHT = 100 -- how many studs the lava climbs
local WAIT_AT_TOP = 5 -- seconds it stays at the top
local WAIT_AT_BOTTOM = 5 -- seconds before it rises again

local lava = script.Parent
lava.Anchored = true
local startCFrame = lava.CFrame

-- Touching the lava resets the player
lava.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end)

while true do
	task.wait(WAIT_AT_BOTTOM)

	-- Rise a little bit every frame
	local risen = 0
	while risen < RISE_HEIGHT do
		local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		risen = math.min(risen + RISE_SPEED * dt, RISE_HEIGHT)
		lava.CFrame = startCFrame + Vector3.new(0, risen, 0)
	end

	task.wait(WAIT_AT_TOP)
	lava.CFrame = startCFrame -- back to the bottom
end

scripts.title: Slippery ice floor
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts, then set the Material of any floor part to Ice.
scripts.about: Any part made of Ice becomes slippery, so players slide around and find it hard to stop.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local GRIP = 1.5 -- smaller = more slippery (try 0.5 to 3)

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local slideVelocity = Vector3.zero -- the speed we keep while sliding

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local flat = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)

	-- FloorMaterial tells us what we are standing on
	if humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Ice or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		slideVelocity = flat -- not on ice: just remember our speed
		return
	end

	-- Where the player WANTS to go
	local wanted = humanoid.MoveDirection * humanoid.WalkSpeed
	-- Slowly turn our sliding speed toward where we want to go
	local alpha = math.clamp(GRIP * deltaTime, 0, 1)
	slideVelocity = slideVelocity:Lerp(wanted, alpha)
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(slideVelocity.X, velocity.Y, slideVelocity.Z)
end)

scripts.title: Swinging pendulum blade
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part (the blade) that hangs below the spot it should swing from.
scripts.about: Swings the part back and forth like a pendulum and hurts players it hits.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local ROPE_LENGTH = 12 -- studs from the blade up to the swing point
local MAX_ANGLE = 60 -- how far it swings to each side (degrees)
local SPEED = 1.5 -- bigger = faster swings
local DAMAGE = 100 -- 100 = instant reset
local HIT_COOLDOWN = 1 -- seconds before the same player can be hit again

local blade = script.Parent
blade.Anchored = true

-- The swing point is straight above where the blade starts
local pivot = blade.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, ROPE_LENGTH, 0)
local startTime = os.clock()

-- Every frame, work out the new angle with math.sin (it goes smoothly from -1 to 1)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local t = os.clock() - startTime
	local angle = math.rad(MAX_ANGLE) * math.sin(t * SPEED)
	blade.CFrame = pivot * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, angle) * CFrame.new(0, -ROPE_LENGTH, 0)
end)

-- Hurt players that get hit
local lastHit = {}
blade.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not player or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastHit[player] or 0) < HIT_COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastHit[player] = now
	humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastHit[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Tilting platform
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a flat Part (it does not need to be Anchored) that players stand on.
scripts.about: The platform tips over when players stand near the edge and slowly levels out again.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPRING_STIFFNESS = 20000 -- how hard it pushes back to level
local SPRING_DAMPING = 3000 -- stops it wobbling forever
local MAX_TILT = 35 -- most it can tip (degrees)

local platform = script.Parent
platform.Anchored = false

-- An invisible anchored part in the middle holds the platform up
local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
anchor.Name = "TiltAnchor"
anchor.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
anchor.Transparency = 1
anchor.CanCollide = false
anchor.Anchored = true
anchor.CFrame = platform.CFrame
anchor.Parent = platform.Parent

local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a0.Parent = anchor
local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a1.Parent = platform

-- The hinge lets it tip around the X axis
local hinge = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
hinge.Attachment0 = a0
hinge.Attachment1 = a1
hinge.LimitsEnabled = true
hinge.UpperAngle = MAX_TILT
hinge.LowerAngle = -MAX_TILT
hinge.Parent = platform

-- The spring tries to bring it back to flat
local spring = Instance.new("TorsionSpringConstraint")
spring.Attachment0 = a0
spring.Attachment1 = a1
spring.Stiffness = SPRING_STIFFNESS
spring.Damping = SPRING_DAMPING
spring.Parent = platform

platform:SetNetworkOwner(nil) -- the server runs its physics so everyone sees the same tilt

scripts.title: Trap door floor
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part that is the trap door in the floor.
scripts.about: Every few seconds the trap door swings open and drops anyone standing on it, then closes again.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local CLOSED_TIME = 4 -- seconds it stays shut
local OPEN_TIME = 2 -- seconds it stays open

local door = script.Parent
door.Anchored = true
local closed = door.CFrame
-- Swing down 90 degrees around one edge (the edge on the -X side)
local hinge = closed * CFrame.new(-door.Size.X / 2, 0, 0)
local open = hinge * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-90)) * CFrame.new(door.Size.X / 2, 0, 0)

local info = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
local openTween = TweenService:Create(door, info, { CFrame = open })
local closeTween = TweenService:Create(door, TweenInfo.new(0.8), { CFrame = closed })

while true do
	task.wait(CLOSED_TIME)
	door.CanCollide = false -- players fall right through
	openTween:Play()

scripts.title: Wind zone that pushes you
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts, then make a Folder named WindZones in Workspace with invisible, non-colliding Parts inside (the front face of each part points where the wind blows).
scripts.about: Players standing inside a wind zone get pushed the way the part is facing.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change this number! (each part can also have a number Attribute named Strength)
local DEFAULT_STRENGTH = 40 -- how hard the wind pushes

local character = script.Parent
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local windZones = workspace:WaitForChild("WindZones")

-- Is a point inside a (possibly rotated) part?
local function isInside(part, point)
	local localPoint = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	return math.abs(localPoint.X) <= half.X and math.abs(localPoint.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(localPoint.Z) <= half.Z
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	for _, zone in ipairs(windZones:GetChildren()) do
		if zone:IsA("BasePart") and isInside(zone, root.Position) then
			local strength = zone:GetAttribute("Strength") or DEFAULT_STRENGTH
			-- Add a little speed every frame in the direction the zone faces
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += zone.CFrame.LookVector * strength * deltaTime
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Buy coins with Robux (developer products)
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and put your developer product ids below (only ONE script in your game may set ProcessReceipt).
scripts.about: Safely gives coins when someone buys a developer product, and never gives them twice for the same purchase.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

-- Settings: product id -> coins it gives
local PRODUCTS = {
	[0] = 100, -- change 0 to your product id
	[1] = 1000,
}

local purchaseHistory = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PurchaseHistory_v1")

local function giveCoins(player, amount)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins then
		error("No Coins stat yet")
	end
	coins.Value = coins.Value + amount
end

-- Roblox calls this for every purchase (and again later if we say "not processed yet")
MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receipt)
	local key = receipt.PlayerId .. "_" .. receipt.PurchaseId
	local ok, recorded = pcall(function()
		return purchaseHistory:UpdateAsync(key, function(alreadyGiven)
			if alreadyGiven then
				return true -- we already gave it, do nothing
			end
			local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receipt.PlayerId)
			local amount = PRODUCTS[receipt.ProductId]
			if not player or not amount then
				return nil -- try again later
			end
			giveCoins(player, amount)
			return true -- remember that we gave it
		end)
	end)
	if not ok or recorded == nil then
		-- Something went wrong: Roblox will ask again later, no Robux are lost
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end

scripts.title: Click to get stronger (simulator tool)

scripts.about: Every click with the tool adds Strength to the leaderboard, boosted by rebirths and upgrades.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local BASE_GAIN = 1
local COOLDOWN = 0.3 -- seconds between clicks (stops auto clickers being too fast)

local tool = script.Parent
local lastClick = {}

local function getStat(player, name)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then
		stats = Instance.new("Folder")
		stats.Name = "leaderstats"
		stats.Parent = player
	end
	local stat = stats:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not stat then
		stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
		stat.Name = name
		stat.Parent = stats
	end
	return stat
end

-- Activated runs on the server when the player clicks while holding the tool
tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(tool.Parent)
	if not player then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastClick[player] or 0) < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastClick[player] = now

	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local rebirths = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")
	local multiplier = (1 + (rebirths and rebirths.Value or 0)) * (player:GetAttribute("Multiplier") or 1)
	local strength = getStat(player, "Strength")
	strength.Value = strength.Value + BASE_GAIN * multiplier
end)

scripts.title: Coin magnet
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and give your coin Parts the tag Coin (works great with the Coin pickup script inside each coin).
scripts.about: Coins close to a player fly toward them so they are easier to collect; players with the Magnet attribute pull from further away.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local NORMAL_RANGE = 8 -- studs
local MAGNET_RANGE = 30 -- studs for players whose "Magnet" attribute is true
local PULL_SPEED = 40 -- studs per second

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	local coins = CollectionService:GetTagged("Coin")
	if #coins == 0 then
		return
	end
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			local range = player:GetAttribute("Magnet") and MAGNET_RANGE or NORMAL_RANGE
			for _, coin in ipairs(coins) do
				if coin:IsA("BasePart") and coin.Anchored and coin.Transparency < 1 then
					local toPlayer = root.Position - coin.Position
					local distance = toPlayer.Magnitude
					if distance < range and distance > 0.5 then
						-- Move a small step toward the player each frame
						local step = math.min(PULL_SPEED * deltaTime, distance)
						coin.CFrame = coin.CFrame + toPlayer.Unit * step
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Coin pickup
scripts.where: Put this Script inside your coin Part, and add the Leaderstats with saving script to ServerScriptService so players have Coins.
scripts.about: Touching the coin gives the player coins, then the coin comes back after a few seconds.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local COINS = 1 -- coins you get each time
local RESPAWN_TIME = 5 -- seconds before the coin comes back
local SPIN_SPEED = 90 -- degrees per second (0 = no spinning)
local STAT_NAME = "Coins" -- must match your leaderstats name

local coin = script.Parent
coin.Anchored = true
coin.CanCollide = false
local startTransparency = coin.Transparency
local collected = false

coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if collected then
		return
	end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	local leaderstats = player and player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
	if not coins then
		return
	end

	-- Give the coins and hide the coin
	collected = true
	coins.Value = coins.Value + COINS
	coin.Transparency = 1

	-- Bring it back later
	task.wait(RESPAWN_TIME)
	coin.Transparency = startTransparency
	collected = false
end)

-- Spin around and around (straight up and down, no matter how the coin is turned)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if SPIN_SPEED ~= 0 then
		local turn = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(SPIN_SPEED) * dt, 0)
		coin.CFrame = CFrame.new(coin.Position) * turn * (coin.CFrame - coin.Position)
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

		pile.Parent = workspace

			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
			local stats = player and player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
			if coins and not taken then

				pile:Destroy()

scripts.title: Egg hatching with rare pets
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored egg Part (works with the Pet that follows you script and a Coins stat).
scripts.about: Press E on the egg and pay coins to hatch a random pet; rarer pets have a smaller chance.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these! Bigger weight = more common
local PRICE = 100
local PETS = {
	{ name = "Dog", weight = 60 },
	{ name = "Cat", weight = 30 },
	{ name = "Dragon", weight = 9 },
	{ name = "Golden Unicorn", weight = 1 }, -- super rare: 1 in 100
}

local egg = script.Parent
local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Hatch (" .. PRICE .. " coins)"
prompt.ObjectText = "Pet Egg"
prompt.HoldDuration = 0.5
prompt.Parent = egg

-- Pick a pet using weights (like putting names in a hat many times)
local function rollPet()
	local total = 0
	for _, pet in ipairs(PETS) do
		total = total + pet.weight
	end
	local roll = math.random() * total
	for _, pet in ipairs(PETS) do
		roll = roll - pet.weight
		if roll <= 0 then
			return pet.name
		end
	end
	return PETS[1].name
end

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins or coins.Value < PRICE then
		return
	end
	coins.Value = coins.Value - PRICE
	local petName = rollPet()

	-- Keep a list of owned pets in a folder on the player
	local owned = player:FindFirstChild("OwnedPets")
	if not owned then
		owned = Instance.new("Folder")
		owned.Name = "OwnedPets"
		owned.Parent = player
	end
	local entry = Instance.new("StringValue")
	entry.Name = petName
	entry.Value = petName
	entry.Parent = owned

	player:SetAttribute("EquippedPet", petName) -- show it off right away
	player:SetAttribute("LastHatch", petName) -- a GUI can announce this
end)

	local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if not handle then
		warn("The Tool needs a part named Handle")
		return
	end
	-- Float it above the pedestal
	handle.Anchored = true
	handle.CFrame = pedestal.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, pedestal.Size.Y / 2 + 2, 0)
	tool.Parent = workspace

	-- When someone picks it up, the tool moves into their character
	tool.AncestryChanged:Wait()
	handle.Anchored = false -- let it move with the player's hand
	task.wait(RESPAWN_TIME)
end

scripts.title: Leaderstats with saving
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, and to test saving in Studio turn on Game Settings > Security > Enable Studio Access to API Services.
scripts.about: Adds a Coins number to the leaderboard and saves it, so players keep their coins next time they play.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

-- Settings: change these!
local STAT_NAME = "Coins" -- the name shown on the leaderboard
local START_AMOUNT = 0 -- coins a brand new player gets
local AUTOSAVE_EVERY = 120 -- seconds between autosaves

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerCoins_v1")
local loaded = {} -- only save players whose coins loaded fine, so we never wipe them

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	-- The folder MUST be named "leaderstats" (all lowercase)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	local stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
	stat.Name = STAT_NAME
	stat.Value = START_AMOUNT
	stat.Parent = leaderstats

	-- Load saved coins (pcall stops errors from breaking the script)
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if ok and player.Parent then
		if typeof(saved) == "number" then
			stat.Value = saved
		end
		loaded[player] = true
	elseif not ok then
		warn("Could not load coins for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(saved))
	end
end

local function save(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local stat = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
	if not loaded[player] or not stat then return end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, stat.Value)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("Could not save coins for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

-- Save when a player leaves
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	save(player)
	loaded[player] = nil
end)

-- Save everyone when the server shuts down
game:BindToClose(function()
	local left = 0
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		left = left + 1
		task.spawn(function()
			save(player)
			left = left - 1
		end)
	end
	while left > 0 do task.wait() end
end)

-- Autosave every few minutes, just in case
while true do
	task.wait(AUTOSAVE_EVERY)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(save, player)
	end
end

scripts.title: Loot crate with random rewards
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored crate Part; put reward Tools in a Folder named CrateLoot in ServerStorage (needs a Coins stat).
scripts.about: Pay coins to open the crate and win a random Tool or coins; rare rewards have smaller chances.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- Settings: what can drop and how likely (bigger weight = more common)
local PRICE = 250
local REWARDS = {
	{ kind = "coins", amount = 100, weight = 50 },
	{ kind = "coins", amount = 500, weight = 20 },
	{ kind = "tool", name = "Sword", weight = 25 }, -- a Tool name inside ServerStorage.CrateLoot
	{ kind = "tool", name = "Rocket Launcher", weight = 5 },
}

local crate = script.Parent
local loot = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("CrateLoot")

local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Open (" .. PRICE .. " coins)"
prompt.ObjectText = "Loot Crate"
prompt.Parent = crate

local function roll()
	local total = 0
	for _, reward in ipairs(REWARDS) do
		total += reward.weight
	end
	local pick = math.random() * total
	for _, reward in ipairs(REWARDS) do
		pick -= reward.weight
		if pick <= 0 then
			return reward
		end
	end
	return REWARDS[1]
end

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins or coins.Value < PRICE then
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "You need " .. PRICE .. " coins")
		return
	end
	coins.Value -= PRICE
	local reward = roll()
	if reward.kind == "coins" then
		coins.Value += reward.amount
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "You won " .. reward.amount .. " coins!")
	else
		local tool = loot:FindFirstChild(reward.name)
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if tool and backpack then
			tool:Clone().Parent = backpack
			player:SetAttribute("Notice", "You won a " .. reward.name .. "!")
		else
			coins.Value += PRICE -- refund if the tool is missing
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Money helper (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ServerScriptService and name it Currency, then require it from your server Scripts.
scripts.about: Gives your server scripts simple add, spend and get functions for any leaderstats money, so you never write that code twice.
scripts.code:
--[[ How to use it from a server Script:
	local Currency = require(game.ServerScriptService.Currency)
	Currency.add(player, "Coins", 50)
	if Currency.spend(player, "Coins", 100) then
		print("Bought it!")
	end
	print(Currency.get(player, "Gems"))
]]

local Currency = {}

-- Finds (or makes) the stat in the player's leaderstats
local function getStat(player, name)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then
		stats = Instance.new("Folder")
		stats.Name = "leaderstats"
		stats.Parent = player
	end
	local stat = stats:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not stat then
		stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
		stat.Name = name
		stat.Parent = stats
	end
	return stat
end

function Currency.get(player, name)
	return getStat(player, name).Value
end

function Currency.add(player, name, amount)
	if type(amount) ~= "number" or amount ~= amount then
		return -- not a real number (amount ~= amount catches NaN)
	end
	local stat = getStat(player, name)
	stat.Value = stat.Value + math.floor(amount)
end

-- Takes money only if they have enough. Returns true if it worked.
function Currency.spend(player, name, amount)
	if type(amount) ~= "number" or amount < 0 then
		return false
	end
	local stat = getStat(player, name)
	if stat.Value < amount then
		return false
	end
	stat.Value = stat.Value - amount
	return true
end

return Currency

scripts.title: Multiplier upgrade shop (server)
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService; it makes a RemoteEvent named BuyUpgrade that a GUI button can fire (needs a Coins stat).
scripts.about: Players buy upgrade levels that raise their Multiplier attribute; each level costs more than the last.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local BASE_PRICE = 50
local PRICE_GROWTH = 1.5 -- each level costs 1.5 times more
local BONUS_PER_LEVEL = 0.25 -- each level adds 25 percent
local MAX_LEVEL = 50

local buyUpgrade = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BuyUpgrade") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
buyUpgrade.Name = "BuyUpgrade"
buyUpgrade.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function priceFor(level)
	return math.floor(BASE_PRICE * PRICE_GROWTH ^ level)
end

local function refresh(player)
	local level = player:GetAttribute("UpgradeLevel") or 0
	player:SetAttribute("Multiplier", 1 + level * BONUS_PER_LEVEL)
	player:SetAttribute("UpgradePrice", priceFor(level)) -- the GUI shows this
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player:SetAttribute("UpgradeLevel", player:GetAttribute("UpgradeLevel") or 0)
	refresh(player)
end)

buyUpgrade.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local level = player:GetAttribute("UpgradeLevel") or 0
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins or level >= MAX_LEVEL then
		return
	end
	local price = priceFor(level)
	if coins.Value < price then
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Need " .. price .. " coins")
		return
	end
	coins.Value -= price
	player:SetAttribute("UpgradeLevel", level + 1)
	refresh(player)
end)

scripts.title: Pet that follows you
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService; optional: put pet Models in a Folder named Pets in ServerStorage and set a player's EquippedPet attribute to a pet's name.
scripts.about: Gives every player a little pet that floats next to them and follows them everywhere.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local OFFSET = Vector3.new(3, 1, 3) -- right, up, back from the player
local DEFAULT_PET_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)

local petsFolder = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Pets")

-- Make the pet: a model from ServerStorage.Pets, or a glowing ball if there is none
local function makePet(petName)
	local template = petsFolder and petName and petsFolder:FindFirstChild(petName)
	if template and template:IsA("Model") and template.PrimaryPart then
		local pet = template:Clone()
		return pet, pet.PrimaryPart
	end
	local ball = Instance.new("Part")
	ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	ball.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
	ball.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	ball.Color = DEFAULT_PET_COLOR
	return ball, ball
end

local function givePet(player, character)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local pet, main = makePet(player:GetAttribute("EquippedPet"))
	pet.Name = "Pet"
	for _, part in ipairs(pet:IsA("BasePart") and { pet } or pet:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Anchored = false
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.Massless = true
		end
	end
	main.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(OFFSET)

	-- The pet chases an attachment that sits beside the player
	local target = Instance.new("Attachment")
	target.Name = "PetSpot"
	target.Position = OFFSET
	target.Parent = root
	local petAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	petAttachment.Parent = main

	local align = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
	align.Attachment0 = petAttachment
	align.Attachment1 = target
	align.Responsiveness = 15
	align.MaxForce = math.huge
	align.Parent = main
	local turn = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	turn.Attachment0 = petAttachment
	turn.Attachment1 = target
	turn.Responsiveness = 15
	turn.Parent = main

	pet.Parent = character
	main:SetNetworkOwner(player) -- smooth movement for the owner
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		givePet(player, character)
	end)
	-- Changing the equipped pet swaps it straight away
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EquippedPet"):Connect(function()
		local character = player.Character
		if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			local old = character:FindFirstChild("Pet")
			if old then
				old:Destroy()
			end
			local spot = character.HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("PetSpot")
			if spot then
				spot:Destroy()
			end
			givePet(player, character)
		end
	end)
end)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local COST_GROWTH = 2 -- each rebirth costs this many times more

scripts.title: Redeem codes (server)
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService (it makes a RemoteFunction named RedeemCode; use the Redeem codes box script for the GUI).
scripts.about: Checks codes players type in, gives the reward once per player, and saves which codes they used.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

-- Settings: your codes (write them in CAPITALS) and how many coins each gives
local CODES = {
	["RELEASE"] = 100,
	["THANKS1K"] = 500,
}

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("UsedCodes_v1")
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RedeemCode") or Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
remote.Name = "RedeemCode"
remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local lastTry = {}

remote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, code)
	if typeof(code) ~= "string" or #code > 30 then
		return false, "Invalid code"
	end
	if os.clock() - (lastTry[player] or 0) < 2 then
		return false, "Slow down!"
	end
	lastTry[player] = os.clock()

	code = string.upper(code:gsub("%s", "")) -- ignore spaces and capitals
	local reward = CODES[code]
	if not reward then
		return false, "That code does not exist"
	end

	-- Save the code as used (UpdateAsync makes sure two servers cannot both give it)
	local alreadyUsed = false
	local ok = pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(used)
			used = used or {}
			if used[code] then
				alreadyUsed = true
				return nil
			end
			used[code] = true
			return used
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false, "Try again in a moment"
	elseif alreadyUsed then
		return false, "You already used that code"
	end

	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if coins then
		coins.Value = coins.Value + reward
	end
	return true, "+" .. reward .. " coins!"
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastTry[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Shop (server part)
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, add a RemoteEvent named BuyItem to ReplicatedStorage, and put your Tools in a Folder named ShopItems in ServerStorage.
scripts.about: Checks a player has enough coins, takes them, and gives the Tool they bought (use it with the Shop button script).
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- Settings: item names and prices (each name must match a Tool in ShopItems)
local PRICES = {
	["Sword"] = 50,
	["Speed Coil"] = 100,
}
local STAT_NAME = "Coins"
local COOLDOWN = 1 -- seconds between buys (stops button spamming)

local buyItem = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyItem")
local shopItems = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("ShopItems")
local lastBuy = {}

-- Does the player already own this tool?
local function ownsTool(player, name)
	local gear = player:FindFirstChild("StarterGear")
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local character = player.Character
	return (gear and gear:FindFirstChild(name))
		or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(name))
		or (character and character:FindFirstChild(name))
end

buyItem.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemName)
	-- Never trust the client: the server checks everything!
	if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastBuy[player] and now - lastBuy[player] < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastBuy[player] = now

	local price = PRICES[itemName]
	local tool = shopItems:FindFirstChild(itemName)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
	if not price or not tool or not coins then
		buyItem:FireClient(player, itemName, false, "Not for sale")
	elseif ownsTool(player, itemName) then
		buyItem:FireClient(player, itemName, false, "You have it!")
	elseif coins.Value < price then
		buyItem:FireClient(player, itemName, false, "Need " .. price .. " coins")
	else
		-- Take the coins and give the tool (StarterGear keeps it after you respawn)
		coins.Value = coins.Value - price
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if backpack then
			tool:Clone().Parent = backpack
		end
		local gear = player:FindFirstChild("StarterGear")
		if gear then
			tool:Clone().Parent = gear
		end
		buyItem:FireClient(player, itemName, true, "Bought!")
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastBuy[player] = nil
end)

scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage and name it ShortNumbers, then require it from any Script or LocalScript.
scripts.about: Turns big numbers into short text like 1.5K, 2.3M or 4B, and can also add commas like 1,234,567.
scripts.code:
--[[ How to use it:
	local ShortNumbers = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ShortNumbers)
	print(ShortNumbers.short(1500))       --> 1.5K
	print(ShortNumbers.short(2340000))    --> 2.34M
	print(ShortNumbers.commas(1234567))   --> 1,234,567
]]

local ShortNumbers = {}

local SUFFIXES = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi", "Sx", "Sp", "Oc", "No", "Dc" }

function ShortNumbers.short(number)
	local negative = number < 0
	number = math.abs(number)
	local index = 1
	-- Divide by 1000 until the number is small, counting how many times
	while number >= 1000 and index < #SUFFIXES do
		number = number / 1000
		index = index + 1
	end
	local text
	if index == 1 then
		text = tostring(math.floor(number))
	else
		-- Keep 2 decimals, then remove extra zeros (1.50 becomes 1.5)
		text = string.format("%.2f", math.floor(number * 100) / 100):gsub("%.?0+$", "")
	end
	return (negative and "-" or "") .. text .. SUFFIXES[index]
end

function ShortNumbers.commas(number)
	local text = tostring(math.floor(number))
	-- Keep adding a comma before the last 3 digits that have none yet
	local result, count
	repeat
		result, count = text:gsub("^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
		text = result
	until count == 0
	return text
end

return ShortNumbers

scripts.title: Speed power-up pickup
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored, non-colliding Part (the power-up).
scripts.about: Grabbing the power-up gives a speed and jump boost for a few seconds, then it respawns.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPEED_BOOST = 16 -- added to walk speed
local JUMP_BOOST = 10 -- added to jump height
local BOOST_TIME = 8
local RESPAWN_TIME = 15

local powerup = script.Parent
powerup.CanCollide = false
local available = true

powerup.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not available or not player or not humanoid or character:GetAttribute("Boosted") then
		return
	end
	available = false
	powerup.Transparency = 1

	-- Boost!
	character:SetAttribute("Boosted", true)
	humanoid.WalkSpeed += SPEED_BOOST
	humanoid.JumpHeight += JUMP_BOOST
	task.delay(BOOST_TIME, function()
		if humanoid.Parent then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed -= SPEED_BOOST
			humanoid.JumpHeight -= JUMP_BOOST
			character:SetAttribute("Boosted", nil)
		end
	end)

	task.wait(RESPAWN_TIME)
	powerup.Transparency = 0
	available = true
end)

scripts.title: Treasure chest with cooldown
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored chest Part or the PrimaryPart of a chest Model (needs a Coins stat).
scripts.about: Press E to open the chest for random coins; each player has to wait before opening it again.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local MIN_COINS = 20
local MAX_COINS = 100
local COOLDOWN_MINUTES = 10

local chest = script.Parent
local nextOpen = {} -- player -> time they can open it again

local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Open"
prompt.ObjectText = "Treasure Chest"
prompt.HoldDuration = 1
prompt.Parent = chest

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	local now = os.time()
	if nextOpen[player] and now < nextOpen[player] then
		local secondsLeft = nextOpen[player] - now
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Chest ready in " .. math.ceil(secondsLeft / 60) .. " min")
		return
	end
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins then
		return
	end
	local amount = math.random(MIN_COINS, MAX_COINS)
	coins.Value = coins.Value + amount
	nextOpen[player] = now + COOLDOWN_MINUTES * 60
	player:SetAttribute("Notice", "You found " .. amount .. " coins!")
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	nextOpen[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Tycoon buy buttons
scripts.where: Put this Script inside your tycoon Model; add a Folder named Items (things to buy) and a Folder named Buttons whose Parts have a number Attribute Price and a text Attribute Item (the name of a thing in Items).
scripts.about: Hides everything in Items until the owner steps on its button and pays for it, then the thing appears.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local STAT_NAME = "Coins"

local tycoon = script.Parent
local owner = tycoon:WaitForChild("Owner")
local items = tycoon:WaitForChild("Items")
local buttons = tycoon:WaitForChild("Buttons")

-- Hide the items in ServerStorage until they are bought
local hidden = Instance.new("Folder")
hidden.Name = tycoon.Name .. "_Hidden"
hidden.Parent = ServerStorage
for _, item in ipairs(items:GetChildren()) do
	item.Parent = hidden
end

local function setupButton(button)
	local itemName = button:GetAttribute("Item")
	local price = button:GetAttribute("Price") or 0
	-- Show the price on a little sign
	local sign = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	sign.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 40)
	sign.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	sign.Parent = button
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	label.Text = tostring(itemName) .. ": $" .. price
	label.Parent = sign

	local bought = false
	button.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		if bought or not player or player ~= owner.Value then
			return
		end
		local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
		local item = hidden:FindFirstChild(itemName)
		if not coins or not item or coins.Value < price then
			return
		end
		bought = true
		coins.Value = coins.Value - price
		item.Parent = items -- it appears!
		button:Destroy()
	end)
end

for _, button in ipairs(buttons:GetChildren()) do
	if button:IsA("BasePart") then
		setupButton(button)
	end
end

scripts.title: Tycoon cash collect pad
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part in your tycoon Model (needs the Tycoon claim door script and a Coins stat in leaderstats).
scripts.about: Shows how much money the tycoon has made; the owner steps on it to collect it all.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local STAT_NAME = "Coins"

local pad = script.Parent
local tycoon = pad:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
local owner = tycoon:WaitForChild("Owner")
local bank = tycoon:WaitForChild("Bank")

-- Show the bank amount on the pad
local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top
gui.Parent = pad
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.TextScaled = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)
label.Parent = gui

local function refresh()
	label.Text = "$" .. bank.Value
end
bank.Changed:Connect(refresh)
refresh()

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if not player or player ~= owner.Value or bank.Value <= 0 then
		return -- only the owner can collect

	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")

	if coins then
		coins.Value = coins.Value + bank.Value
		bank.Value = 0
	end
end)

scripts.title: Tycoon claim door
scripts.where: Put this Script inside your tycoon Model, and add a Part named ClaimDoor to the Model.
scripts.about: The first player to touch the door owns the tycoon; it frees up again when they leave the game.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local tycoon = script.Parent
local door = tycoon:WaitForChild("ClaimDoor")

-- Other tycoon scripts read these two values
local owner = tycoon:FindFirstChild("Owner") or Instance.new("ObjectValue")
owner.Name = "Owner"
owner.Parent = tycoon
local bank = tycoon:FindFirstChild("Bank") or Instance.new("IntValue")
bank.Name = "Bank" -- money waiting to be collected
bank.Parent = tycoon

-- A sign above the door
local sign = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
sign.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 50)
sign.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, door.Size.Y / 2 + 2, 0)
sign.Parent = door
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.TextScaled = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
label.Text = "Touch to claim!"
label.Parent = sign

door.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if not player or owner.Value ~= nil or player:GetAttribute("OwnsTycoon") then
		return -- already owned, or this player has a tycoon already
	end
	owner.Value = player
	player:SetAttribute("OwnsTycoon", true)
	label.Text = player.DisplayName .. "'s Tycoon"
	door.Transparency = 0.8
	door.CanCollide = false
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	if owner.Value == player then
		owner.Value = nil
		bank.Value = 0
		label.Text = "Touch to claim!"
		door.Transparency = 0
		door.CanCollide = true
	end
end)

scripts.title: Tycoon collector
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part at the end of your conveyor, inside the tycoon Model (use it with the Tycoon claim door script).
scripts.about: Money blocks that touch the collector disappear and their value goes into the tycoon's bank.
scripts.code:
local collector = script.Parent
local tycoon = collector:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
local bank = tycoon:WaitForChild("Bank")

collector.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local value = hit:GetAttribute("Value")
	if not value or hit:GetAttribute("Collected") then
		return
	end
	hit:SetAttribute("Collected", true) -- never count the same block twice
	bank.Value = bank.Value + value

scripts.title: Tycoon dropper

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!

local DROP_VALUE = 5 -- money each block is worth
local DROP_SIZE = 1
local DROP_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40)

scripts.title: Tycoon upgrader
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a non-colliding Part that hangs over your conveyor so drops pass through it.
scripts.about: Money blocks that pass through the upgrader become worth more and change color.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these!
local MULTIPLY = 2 -- 2 = worth double
local NEW_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 255)

local upgrader = script.Parent
upgrader.CanCollide = false
upgrader.Transparency = 0.5

upgrader.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local value = hit:GetAttribute("Value")
	-- Only upgrade each block once at this upgrader
	if not value or hit:GetAttribute("Upgraded_" .. upgrader.Name) then
