scripts.title: XP and levels
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService; other server scripts can give XP by firing the BindableEvent ServerStorage.AddXP with (player, amount).
scripts.about: Adds Level to the leaderboard and an XP number; when you get enough XP you level up and the next level needs more.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local XP_PER_MINUTE = 10 -- free XP just for playing
local function xpNeeded(level)
	return 100 + (level - 1) * 50 -- level 1 needs 100, level 2 needs 150, ...
end

local addXP = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("AddXP") or Instance.new("BindableEvent")
addXP.Name = "AddXP"
addXP.Parent = ServerStorage

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	stats.Parent = player
	local level = Instance.new("IntValue")
	level.Name = "Level"
	level.Value = 1
	level.Parent = stats
	-- XP is an attribute so it does not crowd the leaderboard (GUIs can read it)
	player:SetAttribute("XP", 0)
	player:SetAttribute("XPNeeded", xpNeeded(1))
end)

local function giveXP(player, amount)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local level = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Level")
	if not level or type(amount) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	local xp = (player:GetAttribute("XP") or 0) + amount
	-- Level up as many times as the XP allows
	while xp >= xpNeeded(level.Value) do
		xp -= xpNeeded(level.Value)
		level.Value += 1
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Level up! You are level " .. level.Value)
	end
	player:SetAttribute("XP", xp)
	player:SetAttribute("XPNeeded", xpNeeded(level.Value))
end

addXP.Event:Connect(giveXP)

while true do
	task.wait(60)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		giveXP(player, XP_PER_MINUTE)
	end
end

scripts.title: AFK detector (client part)
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts, and add the AFK tag (server part) script too.
scripts.about: Notices when you have not touched any controls for a while (or left the window) and tells the server you are AFK.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Settings: change this number!
local AFK_AFTER = 60 -- seconds with no input before you count as AFK

local setAfk = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SetAFK")
local lastInput = os.clock()
local isAfk = false
local focused = true

local function setState(afk)
	if afk ~= isAfk then
		isAfk = afk
		setAfk:FireServer(afk)
	end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function()
	lastInput = os.clock()
	setState(false)
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		lastInput = os.clock()
	end
end)
-- Clicking away from the Roblox window counts as AFK straight away
UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
	focused = false
	setState(true)
end)
UserInputService.WindowFocused:Connect(function()
	focused = true
	lastInput = os.clock()
	setState(false)
end)

while true do
	task.wait(2)
	if focused then
		setState(os.clock() - lastInput > AFK_AFTER)
	end
end

scripts.title: AFK tag (server part)
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and add the AFK detector (client part) LocalScript too.
scripts.about: Shows a floating AFK sign above players who are away and saves it as an AFK attribute other scripts can check.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- The client uses this RemoteEvent to tell us about AFK
local setAfk = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SetAFK") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
setAfk.Name = "SetAFK"
setAfk.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function updateSign(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then
		return
	end
	local sign = head:FindFirstChild("AFKSign")
	if player:GetAttribute("AFK") and not sign then
		sign = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		sign.Name = "AFKSign"
		sign.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 30)
		sign.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = "AFK"
		label.TextScaled = true
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80)
		label.Parent = sign
		sign.Parent = head
	elseif not player:GetAttribute("AFK") and sign then
		sign:Destroy()
	end
end

setAfk.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, afk)
	if typeof(afk) ~= "boolean" then
		return -- ignore weird data
	end
	player:SetAttribute("AFK", afk)
	updateSign(player)
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		character:WaitForChild("Head")
		updateSign(player)
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Bonus coins for playing with friends
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService (needs a Coins stat, like from the Leaderstats with saving script).
scripts.about: Every minute, players get bonus coins for each Roblox friend who is in the same server.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local COINS_PER_FRIEND = 5
local EVERY = 60 -- seconds
local MAX_FRIENDS_COUNTED = 5

-- Count how many of this player's friends are in the server
local function countFriends(player)
	local count = 0
	for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if other ~= player then
			local ok, isFriend = pcall(function()
				return player:IsFriendsWith(other.UserId)
			end)
			if ok and isFriend then
				count = count + 1
			end
		end
	end
	return math.min(count, MAX_FRIENDS_COUNTED)
end

while true do
	task.wait(EVERY)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
		local friends = countFriends(player)
		player:SetAttribute("FriendsHere", friends) -- a GUI can show this
		if coins and friends > 0 then
			coins.Value = coins.Value + friends * COINS_PER_FRIEND
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Character grows as you level up
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService (needs a Level stat in leaderstats, like from the XP and levels script).
scripts.about: Your character gets a little bigger every level, like in a simulator game.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local STAT_NAME = "Level"
local GROW_PER_LEVEL = 0.05 -- 5 percent bigger each level
local MAX_SCALE = 3

local function resize(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local level = stats and stats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
	if not character or not level or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		return
	end
	local scale = math.clamp(1 + (level.Value - 1) * GROW_PER_LEVEL, 0.5, MAX_SCALE)
	if math.abs(character:GetScale() - scale) > 0.001 then
		character:ScaleTo(scale)
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		task.wait(0.1)
		resize(player)
	end)
	local stats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 30)
	local level = stats and stats:WaitForChild(STAT_NAME, 30)
	if level then
		level.Changed:Connect(function()
			resize(player)
		end)
	end
end)

scripts.title: Crouch key
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts (optional: paste a crouch animation id below).
scripts.about: Press C (or the Crouch button on phones) to crouch: you move slower and your camera goes lower.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these!
local CROUCH_SPEED = 8
local CAMERA_DROP = 1.5 -- how many studs the camera goes down
local CROUCH_ANIMATION_ID = "" -- like "rbxassetid://1234567" (leave empty for no animation)

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")
local normalSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
local crouching = false

local track
if CROUCH_ANIMATION_ID ~= "" then
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = CROUCH_ANIMATION_ID
	track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	track.Looped = true
end

local function setCrouch(on)
	crouching = on
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = on and CROUCH_SPEED or normalSpeed
	local offset = on and Vector3.new(0, -CAMERA_DROP, 0) or Vector3.zero
	TweenService:Create(humanoid, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { CameraOffset = offset }):Play()
	if track then
		if on then track:Play() else track:Stop() end
	end
end

ContextActionService:BindAction("Crouch", function(_, state)
	if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		setCrouch(not crouching)
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end, true, Enum.KeyCode.C)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("Crouch", "Crouch")

humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("Crouch")
end)

scripts.title: Custom health regen
scripts.where: Name this Script exactly Health and put it in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts (it replaces the Roblox one).
scripts.about: Heals players a little every second, but only after they have not been hurt for a few seconds.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local HEAL_PER_SECOND = 3 -- health back each second
local WAIT_AFTER_HIT = 4 -- seconds after getting hurt before healing starts

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local lastHealth = humanoid.Health
local lastHurt = 0

-- Remember when we last lost health
humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
	if health < lastHealth then
		lastHurt = os.clock()
	end
	lastHealth = health
end)

while humanoid.Health > 0 do
	task.wait(1)
	if os.clock() - lastHurt >= WAIT_AFTER_HIT and humanoid.Health < humanoid.MaxHealth and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.Health + HEAL_PER_SECOND, humanoid.MaxHealth)
		lastHealth = humanoid.Health
	end
end

scripts.title: Custom respawn time
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.
scripts.about: Lets you pick how long players wait before they come back to life, with a shorter wait for VIP user ids.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local RESPAWN_SECONDS = 3
local VIP_RESPAWN_SECONDS = 1
local VIP_USER_IDS = { [1] = true } -- put user ids here

-- We spawn characters ourselves instead of Roblox doing it
Players.CharacterAutoLoads = false

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			local waitTime = VIP_USER_IDS[player.UserId] and VIP_RESPAWN_SECONDS or RESPAWN_SECONDS
			player:SetAttribute("RespawnAt", os.time() + waitTime) -- a GUI could show this
			task.wait(waitTime)
			if player.Parent then
				player:LoadCharacter()
			end
		end)
	end)
	player:LoadCharacter() -- first spawn
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

scripts.title: Dash forward
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Press Q (or the Dash button on phones) to zoom forward quickly, with a short cooldown.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DASH_SPEED = 90
local COOLDOWN = 1.5 -- seconds between dashes

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local lastDash = 0

local function dash(_, state)
	if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	if os.clock() - lastDash < COOLDOWN or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end
	lastDash = os.clock()

	-- Dash the way we are walking, or the way we face if standing still
	local direction = humanoid.MoveDirection
	if direction.Magnitude < 0.1 then
		direction = root.CFrame.LookVector
	end
	direction = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z).Unit
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction * DASH_SPEED + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

ContextActionService:BindAction("Dash", dash, true, Enum.KeyCode.Q)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("Dash", "Dash")

humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("Dash")
end)

scripts.title: Double jump
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Lets players jump a second time while they are in the air (works with the jump button on phones and iPads too).
scripts.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DOUBLE_JUMP_POWER = 50 -- how high the second jump goes
local DELAY = 0.2 -- seconds after leaving the ground before you can jump again

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local leftGroundAt = nil -- when we left the ground
local usedDoubleJump = false

-- Keep track of when we are on the ground or in the air
humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
	if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed
		or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
		or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
		or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
		leftGroundAt = nil
		usedDoubleJump = false
	elseif newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
		if not leftGroundAt then
			leftGroundAt = os.clock()
		end
	end
end)

-- When the player presses jump in the air, jump again (only once!)
UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
	if usedDoubleJump or not leftGroundAt then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - leftGroundAt < DELAY then
		return
	end
	if humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
		return
	end

	usedDoubleJump = true
	humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
	local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, DOUBLE_JUMP_POWER, velocity.Z)
end)

scripts.title: Emote hotkeys
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts and paste your animation ids into the list.
scripts.about: Press 1, 2, 3 or 4 to play a dance or emote animation; moving stops it.
scripts.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Settings: put your own animation ids here (animations must be owned by you or your group)
local EMOTES = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.One] = "rbxassetid://507771019", -- Roblox dance 1
	[Enum.KeyCode.Two] = "rbxassetid://507776043", -- Roblox dance 2
	[Enum.KeyCode.Three] = "rbxassetid://507777268", -- Roblox dance 3
	[Enum.KeyCode.Four] = "rbxassetid://507770239", -- Roblox wave
}

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")

-- Load every animation once so they start instantly
local tracks = {}
for key, id in pairs(EMOTES) do
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = id
	tracks[key] = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	tracks[key].Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
end

local playing = nil

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, typing)
	if typing then
		return -- do not dance while typing in chat!
	end
	local track = tracks[input.KeyCode]
	if not track then
		return
	end
	if playing then
		playing:Stop()
	end
	if playing == track then
		playing = nil -- pressing the same key again stops it
	else
		track:Play()
		playing = track
	end
end)

-- Walking cancels the emote
humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MoveDirection"):Connect(function()
	if playing and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
		playing:Stop()
		playing = nil
	end
end)

scripts.title: Fall damage
scripts.where: Put this Script in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Players get hurt when they land after falling really fast; the faster they fell, the more it hurts.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SAFE_SPEED = 60 -- falling slower than this never hurts
local DAMAGE_PER_SPEED = 1.2 -- damage for every unit of speed over the safe speed

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local fastestFall = 0

local connection
connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root.Parent then
		connection:Disconnect()
		return
	end
	local downSpeed = -root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
	if downSpeed > 10 then
		-- Falling: remember the fastest we fell
		fastestFall = math.max(fastestFall, downSpeed)
	elseif downSpeed < 3 and fastestFall > 0 then
		-- We suddenly stopped falling, so we just landed!
		if fastestFall > SAFE_SPEED then
			humanoid:TakeDamage((fastestFall - SAFE_SPEED) * DAMAGE_PER_SPEED)
		end
		fastestFall = 0
	end
end)

scripts.title: Fly with a key
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Press F (or the Fly button on phones) to fly where your camera points; Space goes up and Ctrl goes down.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local FLY_SPEED = 50
local UP_DOWN_SPEED = 30

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local attachment = root:WaitForChild("RootAttachment")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local flying = false

-- LinearVelocity moves us, AlignOrientation turns us to face the camera
local mover = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
mover.Attachment0 = attachment
mover.MaxForce = math.huge
mover.Enabled = false
mover.Parent = root
local turner = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
turner.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
turner.Attachment0 = attachment
turner.Responsiveness = 20
turner.MaxTorque = math.huge
turner.Enabled = false
turner.Parent = root

local function toggleFly(_, state)
	if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	flying = not flying
	mover.Enabled = flying
	turner.Enabled = flying
	humanoid.PlatformStand = flying -- stops the walking animation fighting us
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end
-- true = also make a button on phones and tablets
ContextActionService:BindAction("Fly", toggleFly, true, Enum.KeyCode.F)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("Fly", "Fly")

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not flying then
		return
	end
	local velocity = humanoid.MoveDirection * FLY_SPEED
	-- Flying forward while looking up or down also moves you up or down
	local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then
		local forwardAmount = humanoid.MoveDirection:Dot(flatLook.Unit)
		velocity += Vector3.new(0, look.Y * FLY_SPEED * forwardAmount, 0)
		turner.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, flatLook)
	end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
		velocity += Vector3.new(0, UP_DOWN_SPEED, 0)
	elseif UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
		velocity -= Vector3.new(0, UP_DOWN_SPEED, 0)
	end
	mover.VectorVelocity = velocity
end)

humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("Fly")
end)

scripts.title: Healing pad
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Part you want to heal players.
scripts.about: Gives players health back when they touch it, with a wait before it works again.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local HEAL_AMOUNT = 25 -- health given each time
local COOLDOWN = 5 -- seconds before the same player can heal again

local pad = script.Parent
local lastHeal = {} -- when each player last healed

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	-- Skip if they're gone, or already at full health
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Health >= humanoid.MaxHealth then
		return
	end

	-- Still cooling down? Not yet!
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastHeal[player] and now - lastHeal[player] < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastHeal[player] = now

	-- Heal, but never above max health
	humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.Health + HEAL_AMOUNT, humanoid.MaxHealth)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastHeal[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Hunger system
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService; to make food, give any Tool a number Attribute named Food (how much it fills you up).
scripts.about: Players slowly get hungry, lose health when starving, and fill up by using food Tools.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local MAX_HUNGER = 100
local HUNGER_LOSS = 1 -- lost every few seconds
local LOSS_EVERY = 3 -- seconds
local STARVE_DAMAGE = 5 -- health lost each tick at 0 hunger

local function hookFood(player, tool)
	if not tool:IsA("Tool") or not tool:GetAttribute("Food") then
		return
	end
	-- Activated fires on the server when the player clicks with the tool
	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		local hunger = player.leaderstats.Hunger
		hunger.Value = math.min(hunger.Value + tool:GetAttribute("Food"), MAX_HUNGER)
		tool:Destroy() -- eaten!
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	local hunger = Instance.new("IntValue")
	hunger.Name = "Hunger"
	hunger.Value = MAX_HUNGER
	hunger.Parent = leaderstats

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		hunger.Value = MAX_HUNGER -- full again after respawning
		character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if child:IsA("Tool") and not child:GetAttribute("HungerHooked") then
				child:SetAttribute("HungerHooked", true)
				hookFood(player, child)
			end
		end)
	end)
end)

while true do
	task.wait(LOSS_EVERY)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local hunger = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Hunger")
		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hunger and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			hunger.Value = math.max(hunger.Value - HUNGER_LOSS, 0)
			if hunger.Value == 0 then
				humanoid:TakeDamage(STARVE_DAMAGE)
			end
		end
	end
end

local COOLDOWN = 20

local pad = script.Parent
local recent = {}

local function setVisible(character, visible)
	for _, thing in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if thing:IsA("BasePart") and thing.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			thing.Transparency = visible and 0 or 1
		elseif thing:IsA("Decal") then -- the face
			thing.Transparency = visible and 0 or 1
		end
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		-- Hide the name too
		humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = visible and Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.Viewer
			or Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	end
end

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player or recent[player] then
		return
	end
	recent[player] = true
	setVisible(character, false)
	task.wait(INVISIBLE_TIME)
	if character.Parent then
		setVisible(character, true)
	end
	task.wait(COOLDOWN - INVISIBLE_TIME)
	recent[player] = nil
end)

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

-- Do not fall apart, we will make the joints floppy instead
humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false

humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	for _, joint in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if joint:IsA("Motor6D") and joint.Part0 and joint.Part1 then
			-- Make two attachments in the same spots the motor used
			local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
			a0.CFrame = joint.C0
			a0.Parent = joint.Part0
			local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
			a1.CFrame = joint.C1
			a1.Parent = joint.Part1

			-- A ball socket lets the limb swing around loosely
			local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
			socket.Attachment0 = a0
			socket.Attachment1 = a1
			socket.LimitsEnabled = true
			socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
			socket.Parent = joint.Parent

			joint.Enabled = false
		end
	end

	-- Let the limbs bump into the floor instead of sinking through it
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			part.CanCollide = true
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Run out of air underwater
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService (it works with Terrain water).
scripts.about: Players have limited air when their head is under Terrain water and start losing health when it runs out.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local MAX_AIR = 15 -- seconds of air
local DROWN_DAMAGE = 10 -- health lost each second with no air

local terrain = workspace.Terrain

-- Is this spot inside Terrain water?
local function isInWater(position)
	local region = Region3.new(position - Vector3.new(2, 2, 2), position + Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)):ExpandToGrid(4)
	local materials = terrain:ReadVoxels(region, 4)
	return materials[1][1][1] == Enum.Material.Water
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player:SetAttribute("Air", MAX_AIR)
end)

while true do
	task.wait(1)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if head and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			local air = player:GetAttribute("Air") or MAX_AIR
			if isInWater(head.Position) then
				air = math.max(air - 1, 0)
				if air == 0 then
					humanoid:TakeDamage(DROWN_DAMAGE)
				end
			else
				air = math.min(air + 3, MAX_AIR) -- breathe again quickly
			end
			-- A GUI can read the "Air" attribute to show bubbles
			player:SetAttribute("Air", air)
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Slide while running
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: While running, press Left Ctrl (or the Slide button) to slide along the ground fast and low.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SLIDE_SPEED = 60
local SLIDE_TIME = 0.6 -- seconds
local COOLDOWN = 1.2

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local lastSlide = 0

local function slide(_, state)
	if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	-- Must be moving and on the ground
	if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude < 0.1 or humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	if os.clock() - lastSlide < COOLDOWN then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end
	lastSlide = os.clock()

	local direction = humanoid.MoveDirection.Unit
	humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0) -- camera goes low
	-- task.spawn runs the slide on its own, so the key handler can finish straight away
	task.spawn(function()
		local endTime = os.clock() + SLIDE_TIME
		while os.clock() < endTime and humanoid.Health > 0 do
			-- Slow down a little as the slide goes on
			local left = (endTime - os.clock()) / SLIDE_TIME
			local y = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction * (SLIDE_SPEED * left + humanoid.WalkSpeed) + Vector3.new(0, y, 0)
			task.wait()
		end
		TweenService:Create(humanoid, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { CameraOffset = Vector3.zero }):Play()
	end)
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

ContextActionService:BindAction("Slide", slide, true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("Slide", "Slide")
humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("Slide")
end)

scripts.title: Wall jump
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Jump while in the air next to a wall to kick off it and jump again, like in a parkour game.
scripts.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local UP_POWER = 50
local AWAY_POWER = 35
local WALL_DISTANCE = 2.5 -- how close a wall must be
local COOLDOWN = 0.3

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local lastWallJump = 0

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }

local function findWall()
	-- Look forward, back, left and right for a wall
	local cf = root.CFrame
	local directions = { cf.LookVector, -cf.LookVector, cf.RightVector, -cf.RightVector }
	for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do
		local result = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, direction * (root.Size.X / 2 + WALL_DISTANCE), rayParams)
		if result and math.abs(result.Normal.Y) < 0.3 then -- steep enough to be a wall
			return result.Normal
		end
	end
	return nil
end

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
	if humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
		return -- only in the air
	end
	if os.clock() - lastWallJump < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	local normal = findWall()
	if normal then
		lastWallJump = os.clock()
		-- Push away from the wall and up
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = normal * AWAY_POWER + Vector3.new(0, UP_POWER, 0)
		root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + Vector3.new(normal.X, 0, normal.Z))
	end
end)

scripts.title: Keep your body paint
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Works with the Paint your body pad script or anything that changes BodyColors.
scripts.about: Remembers the body colors a player painted themselves and puts them back after respawning and when they rejoin.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("BodyColors_v1")
local PARTS = { "HeadColor3", "TorsoColor3", "LeftArmColor3", "RightArmColor3", "LeftLegColor3", "RightLegColor3" }
local saved = {} -- saved[player] = { HeadColor3 = {r, g, b}, ... }
local changed = {}

local function apply(player, character)
	local colors = saved[player]
	if not colors then
		return
	end
	local bodyColors = character:WaitForChild("BodyColors", 5) or Instance.new("BodyColors")
	for _, prop in ipairs(PARTS) do
		local c = colors[prop]
		if c then
			bodyColors[prop] = Color3.fromRGB(c[1], c[2], c[3])
		end
	end
	bodyColors.Parent = character
end

local function watch(player, character)
	apply(player, character)
	local bodyColors = character:WaitForChild("BodyColors", 5)
	if not bodyColors then
		return
	end
	bodyColors.Changed:Connect(function()
		local colors = {}
		for _, prop in ipairs(PARTS) do
			local c = bodyColors[prop]
			colors[prop] = { math.floor(c.R * 255), math.floor(c.G * 255), math.floor(c.B * 255) }
		end
		saved[player] = colors
		changed[player] = true
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if ok and type(data) == "table" then
		saved[player] = data
	end
	-- CharacterAppearanceLoaded waits until the avatar's own colors are on, so ours go on top
	player.CharacterAppearanceLoaded:Connect(function(character)
		watch(player, character)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		watch(player, player.Character)
	end
end)

local function save(player)
	if changed[player] and saved[player] then
		pcall(function()
			store:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, saved[player])
		end)
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	save(player)
	saved[player], changed[player] = nil, nil
end)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(save, player)
	end
	task.wait(3)
end)

scripts.title: Rejoin where you left
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.
scripts.about: Saves where a player was standing when they left, and puts them back there the first time they spawn next visit.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("LastPosition_v1")
local lastPosition = {} -- updated while playing, because the character may be gone when they leave

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	-- DataStores cannot save a Vector3, so we saved a table {x, y, z}
	if ok and type(saved) == "table" and saved[1] then
		task.wait(0.5) -- let the spawn finish first
		character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(saved[1], saved[2] + 3, saved[3]))
	end
	-- Keep track of the position while they play
	task.spawn(function()
		while player.Parent do
			local current = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if current and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local p = current.Position
				lastPosition[player] = { math.floor(p.X), math.floor(p.Y), math.floor(p.Z) }
			end
			task.wait(2)
		end
	end)
end)

local function save(player)
	local position = lastPosition[player]
	if position then
		pcall(function()
			store:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, position)
		end)
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	save(player)
	lastPosition[player] = nil
end)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(save, player)
	end
	task.wait(3)
end)

scripts.title: Reset a player's save (admin)
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, put your own UserId in ADMINS, and set STORE_NAMES to the DataStore names your game uses.
scripts.about: Lets an admin type "/wipe PlayerName" in chat to delete that player's saved data (useful for testing or removing cheated stats).
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

-- Settings: change these!
local ADMINS = { 123456789 } -- your UserId (find it in your Roblox profile link)
local STORE_NAMES = { "PlayerCoins_v1", "PlayerProfile_v1" }

local function findPlayer(text)
	text = string.lower(text)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if string.sub(string.lower(player.Name), 1, #text) == text then
			return player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function wipe(admin, target)
	local key = "Player_" .. target.UserId
	for _, storeName in ipairs(STORE_NAMES) do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			DataStoreService:GetDataStore(storeName):RemoveAsync(key)
		end)
		if not ok then
			admin:SetAttribute("Notice", "Wipe failed in " .. storeName .. ": " .. tostring(err))
			return
		end
	end
	-- Kick them so their old numbers are not saved again when they leave
	target:Kick("Your data was reset by an admin. Please rejoin!")
	admin:SetAttribute("Notice", "Wiped " .. target.Name)
end

-- A chat command: typing "/wipe Name" in chat runs this on the server

scripts.title: Save blocks players build
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. It saves blocks inside Workspace.PlayerBuilds.<UserId> (the Block building tool puts them there).
scripts.about: Saves the position and color of every block a player built and rebuilds them when the player comes back.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlacedBlocks_v1")
local buildFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerBuilds") or Instance.new("Folder")
buildFolder.Name = "PlayerBuilds"
buildFolder.Parent = workspace

local MAX_SAVED = 200
local snapshot = {} -- the newest copy of each player's blocks, kept up to date
local loaded = {}

-- Turn a block into a small table: {x, y, z, r, g, b, sizeX, sizeY, sizeZ}
local function pack(part)
	local p, c, s = part.Position, part.Color, part.Size
	return { p.X, p.Y, p.Z, math.floor(c.R * 255), math.floor(c.G * 255), math.floor(c.B * 255), s.X, s.Y, s.Z }
end

local function updateSnapshot(player, folder)
	local list = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and #list < MAX_SAVED then
			table.insert(list, pack(part))
		end
	end
	snapshot[player] = list
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local folder = buildFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId)) or Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = tostring(player.UserId)
	folder.Parent = buildFolder
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if not ok then
		return -- do not save over blocks we failed to load
	end
	for _, info in ipairs(type(saved) == "table" and saved or {}) do
		local block = Instance.new("Part")
		block.Anchored = true
		block.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		block.Position = Vector3.new(info[1], info[2], info[3])
		block.Color = Color3.fromRGB(info[4], info[5], info[6])
		block.Size = Vector3.new(info[7] or 4, info[8] or 4, info[9] or 4)
		block.Parent = folder
	end
	updateSnapshot(player, folder)
	loaded[player] = true
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
		updateSnapshot(player, folder)
	end)
	folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
		updateSnapshot(player, folder)
	end)
end)

local function save(player)
	if loaded[player] and snapshot[player] then
		pcall(function()
			store:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, snapshot[player])
		end)
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	save(player)
	loaded[player], snapshot[player] = nil, nil
end)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(save, player)
	end
	task.wait(3)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerProfile_v1")

	Coins = 0,
	Gems = 0,
	Level = 1,
	Wins = 0,
}

	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)

		player:Kick("Could not load your data. Please rejoin!") -- safer than playing with empty data

scripts.title: Stop data copying between servers
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService (use it instead of other coin saving scripts).
scripts.about: Locks a player's save while they are in a server so a second server cannot load old coins at the same time (this stops item and coin duping).
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("LockedCoins_v1")
local LOCK_TIMEOUT = 300 -- seconds; a lock older than this is from a crashed server
local loaded = {}

-- Try to take the lock. Returns the saved data if we got it.
local function claim(player)
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	for _ = 1, 5 do
		local gotLock = false
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
				old = type(old) == "table" and old or { Coins = 0 }
				local lockedByOther = old.Lock and old.Lock ~= game.JobId and os.time() - (old.LockTime or 0) < LOCK_TIMEOUT
				if lockedByOther then
					return nil -- do not change anything, someone else has it
				end
				old.Lock = game.JobId
				old.LockTime = os.time()
				gotLock = true
				return old
			end)
		end)
		if ok and gotLock then
			return data
		end
		task.wait(5) -- the other server is probably still saving; try again
	end
	return nil
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local data = claim(player)
	if not data then
		player:Kick("Your data is still saving in another server. Please rejoin in a minute!")
		return
	end
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = data.Coins or 0
	coins.Parent = leaderstats
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	loaded[player] = true
end)

local function save(player, release)
	if not loaded[player] then
		return
	end
	local coins = player.leaderstats.Coins.Value
	pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(old)
			old = type(old) == "table" and old or {}
			if old.Lock and old.Lock ~= game.JobId then
				return nil -- another server owns it now; never overwrite
			end
			old.Coins = coins
			old.Lock = (not release) and game.JobId or nil
			old.LockTime = os.time()
			return old
		end)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	save(player, true) -- save and unlock
	loaded[player] = nil
end)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(save, player, true)
	end
	task.wait(3)
end)
while true do
	task.wait(120)
	for player in pairs(loaded) do
		task.spawn(save, player, false) -- autosave keeps the lock fresh
	end
end

scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part that has a SurfaceGui with a TextLabel in it.
scripts.about: Counts every player that has ever joined your game (across all servers) and shows the total on a sign.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local sign = script.Parent
local label = sign:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("GlobalStats_v1")
local KEY = "TotalJoins"

local pendingJoins = 0 -- joins in this server we still need to add

local function show(total)
	if label then
		label.Text = "Total joins: " .. tostring(total)
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
	pendingJoins += 1
end)

-- Every 60 seconds, add our joins to the shared total in one go
-- (doing it once a minute is kinder to DataStore limits than once per player)
local function flush()
	local adding = pendingJoins
	local ok, total = pcall(function()
		return store:IncrementAsync(KEY, adding)
	end)
	if ok then
		pendingJoins -= adding
		show(total)
	end
end

game:BindToClose(flush)

-- Show the starting number
local ok, total = pcall(function()
	return store:GetAsync(KEY)
end)
show(ok and total or 0)

while true do
	task.wait(60)
	flush()
end

scripts.title: Try saving again if it fails (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ServerScriptService and name it SafeStore. Use require(game.ServerScriptService.SafeStore).Get(store, key) and .Update(store, key, function).
scripts.about: Wraps DataStore calls so that if Roblox's servers have a hiccup, it waits and tries again a few times before giving up.

scripts.title: Upgrade old save files
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ServerScriptService and name it Migrate. In your loading code: data = require(game.ServerScriptService.Migrate)(data).
scripts.about: When you change how your game saves, this upgrades old players' saves step by step so nobody loses their stuff.
scripts.code:
-- Every save table gets a Version number. When you change your save format,
-- add one more step below and raise LATEST by 1.
local LATEST = 3

local steps = {}

-- Version 1 to 2: we renamed "Money" to "Coins"
steps[1] = function(data)
	data.Coins = data.Money or 0
	data.Money = nil
	return data
end

-- Version 2 to 3: we added a Gems stat and a list of owned items
steps[2] = function(data)
	data.Gems = data.Gems or 0
	data.Owned = data.Owned or {}
	return data
end

return function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		-- A brand new player, or a really old save that was just a number
		local oldCoins = type(data) == "number" and data or 0
		data = { Version = 1, Money = oldCoins }
	end
	data.Version = data.Version or 1
	-- Run each step in order until the save is up to date
	while data.Version < LATEST do
		local step = steps[data.Version]
		if not step then
			warn("No migration step for version " .. data.Version)
			break
		end
		data = step(data)
		data.Version += 1
	end
	return data
end

scripts.title: Wait for DataStore budget (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ServerScriptService and name it Budget. Before a save call: require(game.ServerScriptService.Budget).WaitFor("Set").
scripts.about: Checks how many DataStore requests Roblox lets your server make right now, and waits a moment if you are about to go over the limit.
scripts.code:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Budget = {}

-- The kinds of request you can wait for
local KINDS = {
	Get = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.GetAsync,
	Set = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.SetIncrementAsync,
	Update = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.UpdateAsync,
	Sorted = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.GetSortedAsync,
}

-- WaitFor("Set") returns when there is room for at least one more request of that kind.
-- It gives up after maxWait seconds (default 10) so a script never waits forever.
function Budget.WaitFor(kind, maxWait)
	local requestType = KINDS[kind] or KINDS.Set
	maxWait = maxWait or 10
	local waited = 0
	while DataStoreService:GetRequestBudgetForRequestType(requestType) < 1 do
		if waited >= maxWait then
			warn("DataStore budget still empty after " .. maxWait .. " seconds")
			return false
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
		waited += 0.5
	end
	return true
end

-- How many requests of that kind you can make right now
function Budget.Left(kind)
	return DataStoreService:GetRequestBudgetForRequestType(KINDS[kind] or KINDS.Set)
end

return Budget

scripts.title: Background music playlist
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts and paste your music ids into SONGS (find music in the Toolbox under Audio).
scripts.about: Plays your list of songs one after another in a shuffled order, forever, for each player.
scripts.code:
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: paste your song ids here, like "rbxassetid://1234567890"
local SONGS = {
	"",
	"",
}
local VOLUME = 0.4

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Remove empty entries so the script does not try to play nothing
local playlist = {}
for _, id in ipairs(SONGS) do
	if id ~= "" then
		table.insert(playlist, id)
	end
end
if #playlist == 0 then
	warn("Music playlist: add song ids to SONGS")
	return
end

local music = Instance.new("Sound")
music.Name = "PlaylistMusic"
music.Volume = VOLUME
music:SetAttribute("NormalVolume", VOLUME)
music.Parent = SoundService

-- Shuffle: mix up the order like shuffling cards
local function shuffle(list)
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(1, i)
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
	end
end

while true do
	shuffle(playlist)
	for _, id in ipairs(playlist) do
		music.SoundId = id
		-- Wait up to 10 seconds for the song to load (skip it if it never does)
		local waited = 0
		while not music.IsLoaded and waited < 10 do
			task.wait(0.25)
			waited += 0.25
		end
		if not music.IsLoaded then
			continue
		end
		-- Respect a "MusicMuted" setting from a settings menu
		music.Volume = player:GetAttribute("MusicMuted") and 0 or VOLUME
		music:Play()
		music.Ended:Wait()
		task.wait(1)
	end
end

scripts.title: Boombox tool
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool with a Handle, and paste song ids into SONGS. Players nearby hear it.
scripts.about: Click while holding the boombox to play the next song from your list; everyone near you can hear it.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: paste song ids here (only songs you are allowed to use)
local SONGS = {
	"",
	"",
}

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")

local music = Instance.new("Sound")
music.Name = "BoomboxMusic"
music.Volume = 0.7
music.Looped = true
music.RollOffMaxDistance = 80 -- quieter the further away you are
music.Parent = handle

local list = {}
for _, id in ipairs(SONGS) do
	if id ~= "" then
		table.insert(list, id)
	end
end

local index = 0
local lastClick = 0
tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	if #list == 0 or os.clock() - lastClick < 1 then
		return
	end
	lastClick = os.clock()
	index += 1
	if index > #list then
		-- After the last song, the next click turns the music off
		index = 0
		music:Stop()
		return
	end
	music.SoundId = list[index]
	music:Play()
end)

-- Stop playing when the boombox is put away
tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	music:Stop()
	index = 0
end)

scripts.title: Click sound on every button
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts and paste a click sound id into CLICK_ID (and a hover sound into HOVER_ID if you want).
scripts.about: Every button in your game makes a click sound when pressed, without adding a sound to each one.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

-- Settings: paste ids here
local CLICK_ID = ""
local HOVER_ID = ""

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function makeSound(id, volume)
	if id == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Volume = volume
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	return sound
end
local click = makeSound(CLICK_ID, 0.6)
local hover = makeSound(HOVER_ID, 0.25)

local function hook(object)
	if not object:IsA("GuiButton") or object:GetAttribute("NoClickSound") then
		return
	end
	object.Activated:Connect(function()
		if click then
			-- PlayLocalSound plays it just for you, even if it overlaps
			SoundService:PlayLocalSound(click)
		end
	end)
	object.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if hover then
			SoundService:PlayLocalSound(hover)
		end
	end)
end

for _, object in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
	hook(object)
end
playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(hook)

scripts.title: Different music in each area
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. Make a Folder named MusicZones in Workspace with see-through, CanCollide-off Parts; put a Sound inside each zone part.
scripts.about: When you walk into a zone, its song fades in and the old song fades out.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local zones = workspace:WaitForChild("MusicZones")
local FADE = TweenInfo.new(1.5)

-- Each zone's sound plays on this player's computer only (we move it into the player's GUI)
local zoneSounds = {}
for _, zone in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
	local sound = zone:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sound")
	if sound then
		local copy = sound:Clone()
		copy.Looped = true
		copy:SetAttribute("NormalVolume", sound.Volume)
		copy.Volume = 0
		copy.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		zoneSounds[zone] = copy
	end
end

local function isInside(part, position)
	local offset = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	return math.abs(offset.X) <= half.X and math.abs(offset.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(offset.Z) <= half.Z
end

local currentZone = nil
while true do
	task.wait(0.5)
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local newZone = nil
	if root then
		for zone in pairs(zoneSounds) do
			if isInside(zone, root.Position) then
				newZone = zone
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if newZone ~= currentZone then
		if currentZone then
			TweenService:Create(zoneSounds[currentZone], FADE, { Volume = 0 }):Play()
		end
		if newZone then
			local sound = zoneSounds[newZone]
			if not sound.IsPlaying and sound.SoundId ~= "" then
				sound:Play()
			end
			TweenService:Create(sound, FADE, { Volume = sound:GetAttribute("NormalVolume") }):Play()
		end
		currentZone = newZone
	end
end

scripts.title: Echo inside caves
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. Put see-through, CanCollide-off Parts covering your caves in a Folder named EchoZones, and give each a text Attribute named Reverb (like Cave, Hallway or Arena).
scripts.about: When you walk into a cave or big hall, every sound starts to echo like it really would in there.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local zones = workspace:WaitForChild("EchoZones")
local normal = SoundService.AmbientReverb

local function isInside(part, position)
	local offset = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	return math.abs(offset.X) <= half.X and math.abs(offset.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(offset.Z) <= half.Z
end

-- Turn the zone's text into a ReverbType (Cave if the name is wrong)
local function reverbFor(zone)
	local name = zone:GetAttribute("Reverb") or "Cave"
	local ok, reverb = pcall(function()
		return Enum.ReverbType[name]
	end)
	return ok and reverb or Enum.ReverbType.Cave
end

while true do
	task.wait(0.5)
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local wanted = normal
	if root then
		for _, zone in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
			if zone:IsA("BasePart") and isInside(zone, root.Position) then
				wanted = reverbFor(zone)
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if SoundService.AmbientReverb ~= wanted then
		SoundService.AmbientReverb = wanted
	end
end

scripts.title: Footstep sounds by floor type
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts and paste footstep sound ids into STEP_SOUNDS.
scripts.about: Plays a different footstep sound for grass, wood, metal, sand and more, faster when you run.
scripts.code:
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

-- Settings: one sound id per floor material ("" means use the Default one)
local STEP_SOUNDS = {
	Default = "",
	Grass = "",
	Wood = "",
	WoodPlanks = "",
	Metal = "",
	DiamondPlate = "",
	Sand = "",
	Snow = "",
}

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Turn down Roblox's own running sound so the two do not overlap
local defaultRunning = root:WaitForChild("Running", 5)
if defaultRunning and defaultRunning:IsA("Sound") then
	defaultRunning.Volume = 0
end

local step = Instance.new("Sound")
step.Volume = 0.6
step.Parent = root

while humanoid.Health > 0 do
	local speed = (root.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude
	local material = humanoid.FloorMaterial
	if speed > 2 and material ~= Enum.Material.Air then
		local id = STEP_SOUNDS[material.Name]
		if not id or id == "" then
			id = STEP_SOUNDS.Default
		end
		if id ~= "" then
			step.SoundId = id
			step.PlaybackSpeed = 0.9 + math.random() * 0.2 -- tiny changes sound more natural
			step:Play()
		end
		-- Faster walking means faster steps
		task.wait(math.clamp(5 / speed, 0.2, 0.5))
	else
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end

scripts.title: Heartbeat when health is low
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts and paste a heartbeat sound id into HEARTBEAT_ID.
scripts.about: When your health drops low you hear a heartbeat that gets faster the closer you are to zero, and the screen goes a bit gray.
scripts.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

-- Settings: change these!
local HEARTBEAT_ID = ""
local LOW = 0.3 -- below 30 percent health

local humanoid = script.Parent:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

local beat = Instance.new("Sound")
beat.SoundId = HEARTBEAT_ID
beat.Volume = 0.8
beat.Parent = SoundService

local gray = Lighting:FindFirstChild("LowHealthGray") or Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
gray.Name = "LowHealthGray"
gray.Saturation = 0
gray.Parent = Lighting

humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	gray.Saturation = 0
	beat:Destroy()
end)

while humanoid.Health > 0 do
	local fraction = humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth
	if fraction < LOW then
		gray.Saturation = -0.8 * (1 - fraction / LOW) -- grayer as health drops
		if HEARTBEAT_ID ~= "" then
			beat:Play()
		end
		-- 1 second between beats at 30 percent, down to 0.4 at almost zero
		task.wait(0.4 + 0.6 * (fraction / LOW))
	else
		gray.Saturation = 0
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
end

scripts.title: Muffled sound underwater
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. Works with Terrain water.
scripts.about: When your camera goes under terrain water, sounds become muffled and echoey and the screen turns a little blue.
scripts.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local terrain = workspace.Terrain

local normalReverb = SoundService.AmbientReverb
local tint = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
tint.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255)
tint.Enabled = false
tint.Parent = Lighting

-- Ask the terrain which material is at a point
local function isWater(position)
	local region = Region3.new(position - Vector3.new(2, 2, 2), position + Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)):ExpandToGrid(4)
	local materials = terrain:ReadVoxels(region, 4)
	return materials[1][1][1] == Enum.Material.Water
end

local wasUnder = false
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local under = isWater(camera.CFrame.Position)
	if under ~= wasUnder then
		wasUnder = under
		-- AmbientReverb changes how every sound echoes
		SoundService.AmbientReverb = under and Enum.ReverbType.UnderWater or normalReverb
		tint.Enabled = under
	end
end)

scripts.title: Play a sound in one line (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage and name it SFX. Then in any script: require(game.ReplicatedStorage.SFX).Play("rbxassetid://123", somePart).
scripts.about: A helper that makes a sound, plays it once at a part (or everywhere), and cleans it up when it finishes.
scripts.code:
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local SFX = {}

-- Play(id, where, volume, pitch)
--   where: a Part (sound comes from there) or nil (heard everywhere the same)
function SFX.Play(soundId, where, volume, pitch)
	if type(soundId) ~= "string" or soundId == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = soundId
	sound.Volume = volume or 0.6
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = pitch or 1
	sound.Parent = where or SoundService
	sound:Play()
	-- Remove it when done (or after 30 seconds if it never ends)
	sound.Ended:Once(function()
		sound:Destroy()
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(sound, 30)
	return sound
end

-- PlayRandomPitch: same sound but slightly different each time (great for hits and steps)
function SFX.PlayRandomPitch(soundId, where, volume)
	return SFX.Play(soundId, where, volume, 0.9 + math.random() * 0.2)
end

-- PlayAt: plays from a spot in the world, even with no part there
function SFX.PlayAt(soundId, position, volume)
	local spot = Instance.new("Part")
	spot.Anchored = true
	spot.CanCollide = false
	spot.CanQuery = false
	spot.Transparency = 1
	spot.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	spot.Position = position
	spot.Parent = workspace
	Debris:AddItem(spot, 30)
	return SFX.Play(soundId, spot, volume)
end

return SFX

scripts.title: Playable piano
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a piano Model. Name the key Parts 1, 2, 3... from left to right, and paste ONE piano note sound id into NOTE_ID.
scripts.about: Click a key (or step on it) to play a note; each key plays a higher note than the one before it, like a real piano.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these!
local NOTE_ID = "" -- a single piano note; we change its pitch for every key
local STEP_ON_KEYS = true -- also play when you walk on them

local piano = script.Parent

local function setupKey(key, number)
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = NOTE_ID
	-- Each key is one half-step higher: multiply pitch by 2^(1/12) per key
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = 2 ^ ((number - 1) / 12)
	sound.Parent = key
	local normalColor = key.Color
	local lastPlay = 0

	local function play()
		if NOTE_ID == "" or os.clock() - lastPlay < 0.15 then
			return
		end
		lastPlay = os.clock()
		sound.TimePosition = 0
		sound:Play()
		-- Flash the key
		key.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90)
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			key.Color = normalColor
		end)
	end

	local click = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
	click.MaxActivationDistance = 20
	click.Parent = key
	click.MouseClick:Connect(play)
	if STEP_ON_KEYS then
		key.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			if hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
				play()
			end
		end)
	end
end

for _, key in ipairs(piano:GetDescendants()) do
	local number = tonumber(key.Name)
	if key:IsA("BasePart") and number then

end

scripts.title: Smooth music changes (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage and name it MusicFader. In a LocalScript: require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MusicFader).PlaySong("rbxassetid://123").
scripts.about: Switches songs by fading the old one out while the new one fades in, so music never cuts off suddenly.
scripts.code:
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local MusicFader = {}
MusicFader.Volume = 0.5
MusicFader.FadeTime = 2

local current = nil

-- PlaySong(id): fades to this song. Calling it with the same song does nothing.
function MusicFader.PlaySong(soundId)
	if current and current.SoundId == soundId then
		return
	end
	local old = current
	if old then
		local fadeOut = TweenService:Create(old, TweenInfo.new(MusicFader.FadeTime), { Volume = 0 })
		fadeOut:Play()
		fadeOut.Completed:Once(function()
			old:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	if not soundId or soundId == "" then
		current = nil -- an empty id means fade to silence
		return
	end
	local new = Instance.new("Sound")
	new.SoundId = soundId
	new.Looped = true
	new.Volume = 0
	new.Parent = SoundService
	new:Play()
	TweenService:Create(new, TweenInfo.new(MusicFader.FadeTime), { Volume = MusicFader.Volume }):Play()
	current = new
end

-- Stop(): fade out to silence
function MusicFader.Stop()
	MusicFader.PlaySong(nil)
end

return MusicFader

scripts.title: Choose your team (server part)
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Use it with the Team picker buttons LocalScript.
scripts.about: Lets players switch teams from a menu, but only to a team that is not already bigger than the others.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local COOLDOWN = 5
local MAX_DIFFERENCE = 1 -- a team can have at most this many more players than the smallest

local pickTeam = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PickTeam") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
pickTeam.Name = "PickTeam"
pickTeam.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local lastPick = {}

pickTeam.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, team)
	-- Never trust the client: check it is a real Team
	if typeof(team) ~= "Instance" or not team:IsA("Team") or team.Parent ~= Teams or player.Team == team then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - (lastPick[player] or 0) < COOLDOWN then
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Wait a moment before switching again")
		return
	end
	local smallest = math.huge
	for _, other in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		local count = #other:GetPlayers()
		if other == player.Team then
			count -= 1 -- do not count yourself on your old team
		end
		smallest = math.min(smallest, count)
	end
	if #team:GetPlayers() + 1 - smallest > MAX_DIFFERENCE then
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", team.Name .. " is full right now")
		return
	end
	lastPick[player] = os.clock()
	player.Team = team
	player:LoadCharacter()
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastPick[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Cops and robbers jail
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Make Teams named Cops and Robbers, and add a Part named JailCell (inside a closed room) to Workspace.
scripts.about: When a cop touches a robber, the robber is arrested and sent to jail for a while, and the cop gets a reward.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

-- Settings: change these!
local JAIL_TIME = 30
local ARREST_REWARD = 50

local cops = Teams:WaitForChild("Cops")
local robbers = Teams:WaitForChild("Robbers")
local jailCell = workspace:WaitForChild("JailCell")
local jailed = {}

local function arrest(cop, robber)
	jailed[robber] = true
	local character = robber.Character
	if character then
		character:PivotTo(jailCell.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
	end
	local coins = cop:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and cop.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if coins then
		coins.Value += ARREST_REWARD
	end
	cop:SetAttribute("Notice", "You arrested " .. robber.DisplayName .. "! +" .. ARREST_REWARD)
	-- Count down the jail time, then let them out at their spawn
	for seconds = JAIL_TIME, 1, -1 do
		if not robber.Parent then
			return
		end
		robber:SetAttribute("Notice", "In jail: " .. seconds)
		task.wait(1)
	end
	jailed[robber] = nil
	robber:LoadCharacter()
end

local function hookCop(player, character)
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				local other = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
				if player.Team == cops and other and other.Team == robbers and not jailed[other] then
					task.spawn(arrest, player, other)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		hookCop(player, character)
		-- A robber who respawns while still jailed goes back to jail
		if jailed[player] then
			task.wait(0.5)
			character:PivotTo(jailCell.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
		end
	end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	jailed[player] = nil
end)

	for _, source in ipairs({ folder, teamTools:FindFirstChild("Everyone") }) do

scripts.title: Keep teams even
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Make your Teams in the Teams service and turn AutoAssignable off on each one (this script does the assigning).
scripts.about: Puts each new player on the smallest team, and when someone leaves it moves a player over if one team gets 2 or more bigger.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

local function teamsBySize()
	local list = Teams:GetTeams()
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return #a:GetPlayers() < #b:GetPlayers()
	end)
	return list
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local smallest = teamsBySize()[1]
	if smallest then
		player.Team = smallest
	end
end)

local function rebalance()
	local list = teamsBySize()
	local smallest, biggest = list[1], list[#list]
	if not smallest or smallest == biggest then
		return
	end
	if #biggest:GetPlayers() - #smallest:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
		-- Move the player who joined the big team most recently (just pick one at random)
		local members = biggest:GetPlayers()
		local mover = members[math.random(1, #members)]
		mover.Team = smallest
		mover:SetAttribute("Notice", "Moved to " .. smallest.Name .. " to keep teams fair")
		mover:LoadCharacter() -- respawn at the new team's spawn
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function()
	task.wait(1) -- let them finish leaving first
	rebalance()
end)

scripts.title: Mix up the teams (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ServerScriptService and name it ShuffleTeams. Call require(game.ServerScriptService.ShuffleTeams)() at the start of a round.
scripts.about: Puts every player on a random team so the teams are mixed up and even, then respawns everyone at their new spawn.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

-- teamNames (optional): only shuffle into these teams, like {"Red", "Blue"}
return function(teamNames)
	local teams = {}
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		if not teamNames or table.find(teamNames, team.Name) then
			table.insert(teams, team)
		end
	end
	if #teams == 0 then
		warn("ShuffleTeams: no teams found")
		return
	end
	-- Shuffle the players like cards
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	for i = #players, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(1, i)
		players[i], players[j] = players[j], players[i]
	end
	-- Deal them out one by one: team 1, team 2, team 1, team 2...
	for i, player in ipairs(players) do
		player.Team = teams[(i - 1) % #teams + 1]
	end
	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		task.spawn(function()
			player:LoadCharacter()
		end)
	end
end

scripts.title: See teammates through walls
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.
scripts.about: Draws a glowing outline in your team color around your teammates, even when they are behind walls.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local me = Players.LocalPlayer

local function refresh(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or player == me then
		return
	end
	local old = character:FindFirstChild("TeamOutline")
	local sameTeam = me.Team ~= nil and player.Team == me.Team
	if not sameTeam then
		if old then
			old:Destroy()
		end
		return
	end
	local outline = old or Instance.new("Highlight")
	outline.Name = "TeamOutline"
	outline.FillTransparency = 1 -- only the outline, not a solid color
	outline.OutlineColor = player.TeamColor.Color
	outline.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop -- shows through walls
	outline.Parent = character
end

local function refreshAll()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		refresh(player)
	end
end

local function watch(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(0.5)
		refresh(player)
	end)
	player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function()
		if player == me then
			refreshAll() -- I switched teams: everyone might change
		else
			refresh(player)
		end
	end)
	refresh(player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watch)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	watch(player)
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)

scripts.title: Team capture point
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an anchored, see-through Part that marks the capture area (CanCollide off). Make a few of them for a domination game!
scripts.about: Standing in the zone slowly captures it for your team (it changes to your color), and the owning team earns a point every few seconds.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local CAPTURE_TIME = 8 -- seconds for one player to capture
local POINT_EVERY = 5 -- seconds between points for the owner

local zone = script.Parent
local owner = nil -- the Team that owns it now
local progress = 0 -- 0 to 1
local capturingTeam = nil
local pointTimer = 0

local params = OverlapParams.new()

local function teamsInZone()
	local counts = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(zone, params)) do
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(part.Parent)
		local humanoid = part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if player and player.Team and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
			counts[player.Team] = (counts[player.Team] or 0) + 1
		end
	end
	return counts
end

while true do
	task.wait(0.5)
	local counts = teamsInZone()
	local present = {}
	for team in pairs(counts) do
		table.insert(present, team)
	end
	if #present == 1 and present[1] ~= owner then
		-- Only one team here and it is not the owner: capture!
		local team = present[1]
		if capturingTeam ~= team then
			capturingTeam, progress = team, 0
		end
		progress += 0.5 * counts[team] / CAPTURE_TIME -- more players capture faster
		zone.Color = owner and owner.TeamColor.Color:Lerp(team.TeamColor.Color, progress) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(team.TeamColor.Color, progress)
		if progress >= 1 then
			owner, capturingTeam, progress = team, nil, 0
			zone.Color = team.TeamColor.Color
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				player:SetAttribute("Notice", team.Name .. " captured " .. zone.Name .. "!")
			end
		end
	elseif #present == 0 then
		capturingTeam, progress = nil, 0
		zone.Color = owner and owner.TeamColor.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	-- The owner earns points
	if owner then
		pointTimer += 0.5
		if pointTimer >= POINT_EVERY then
			pointTimer = 0
			owner:SetAttribute("Score", (owner:GetAttribute("Score") or 0) + 1)
		end
	end
end

			end

scripts.title: Team points from knockouts
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Weapons must add a "creator" tag to victims (the weapon scripts here do). Show the score with the Team score display GUI.
scripts.about: Every time someone knocks out a player on another team, their team's Score goes up by one; the first team to the goal wins.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

-- Settings: change these!
local GOAL = 25

local matchOver = false

local function resetScores()
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		team:SetAttribute("Score", 0)
	end
end

local function onDied(victim, humanoid)
	local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	local killer = tag and tag.Value
	if matchOver or not (killer and killer:IsA("Player") and killer.Team and killer.Team ~= victim.Team) then
		return
	end
	local team = killer.Team
	local score = (team:GetAttribute("Score") or 0) + 1
	team:SetAttribute("Score", score)
	if score >= GOAL then
		matchOver = true
		workspace:SetAttribute("Announcement", "")
		workspace:SetAttribute("Announcement", team.Name .. " wins the match!")
		for _, player in ipairs(team:GetPlayers()) do
			local wins = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Wins")
			if wins then
				wins.Value += 1
			end
		end
		task.wait(5)
		resetScores()
		matchOver = false
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			onDied(player, humanoid)
		end)
	end)
end)
resetScores()
