scripts.title: Axe that chops trees
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an axe Tool with a Handle part, put the Tool in StarterPack, and tag your tree Models with Tree (move each tree's Pivot to the bottom of its trunk so it tips over nicely).
scripts.about: Swing the axe next to a tree to chop it; after a few hits it falls over, gives Wood and grows back later.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local HITS_TO_FELL = 4
local WOOD_PER_TREE = 5
local REACH = 7
local REGROW_TIME = 30

local tool = script.Parent
local lastSwing = 0

local function giveWood(player)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then
		return
	end
	local wood = stats:FindFirstChild("Wood")
	if not wood then
		wood = Instance.new("IntValue")
		wood.Name = "Wood"
		wood.Parent = stats
	end
	wood.Value += WOOD_PER_TREE
end

local function fell(tree, player)
	tree:SetAttribute("Fallen", true)
	giveWood(player)
	local standing = tree:GetPivot()
	-- Tip the tree over with a tween on a CFrameValue
	local value = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	value.Value = standing
	value.Changed:Connect(function(cf)
		tree:PivotTo(cf)
	end)
	TweenService:Create(value, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Value = standing * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(85)) }):Play()
	task.delay(REGROW_TIME, function()
		value:Destroy()
		tree:PivotTo(standing)
		tree:SetAttribute("Fallen", nil)
		tree:SetAttribute("Chops", nil)
	end)
end

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	local character = tool.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not player or not root or os.clock() - lastSwing < 0.6 then
		return
	end
	lastSwing = os.clock()
	local anim = Instance.new("StringValue")
	anim.Name = "toolanim"
	anim.Value = "Slash"
	anim.Parent = tool

	for _, tree in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Tree")) do
		if tree:IsA("Model") and not tree:GetAttribute("Fallen") then
			local distance = (tree:GetPivot().Position - root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
			if distance.Magnitude <= REACH then
				local chops = (tree:GetAttribute("Chops") or 0) + 1
				tree:SetAttribute("Chops", chops)
				if chops >= HITS_TO_FELL then
					fell(tree, player)
				end
				break
			end
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Basic sword
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool that has a part named Handle, then put the Tool in StarterPack.
scripts.about: Click or tap to swing the sword and hurt other players and NPCs it hits (never yourself).
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DAMAGE = 25 -- health taken per hit
local SWING_TIME = 0.4 -- seconds a swing can hit things
local COOLDOWN = 0.8 -- seconds between swings
local TEAM_DAMAGE = false -- true = you can hurt your own team

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local swinging = false
local canSwing = true
local hitThisSwing = {} -- each enemy can only be hit once per swing

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	if not canSwing then
		return
	end
	canSwing = false
	swinging = true
	hitThisSwing = {}

	-- Play Roblox's built-in sword slash animation
	local anim = Instance.new("StringValue")
	anim.Name = "toolanim"
	anim.Value = "Slash"
	anim.Parent = tool

	task.wait(SWING_TIME)
	swinging = false
	task.wait(math.max(COOLDOWN - SWING_TIME, 0))
	canSwing = true
end)

handle.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if not swinging then
		return
	end
	local owner = tool.Parent -- the character holding the sword
	local character = hit.Parent
	if not character or character == owner then
		return -- no hitting yourself!
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or hitThisSwing[humanoid] then
		return
	end

	-- Skip teammates (only if your game has teams)
	local ownerPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(owner)
	local victimPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not TEAM_DAMAGE and ownerPlayer and victimPlayer and victimPlayer.Team ~= nil
		and victimPlayer.Team == ownerPlayer.Team then
		return
	end

	hitThisSwing[humanoid] = true
	humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
end)

scripts.title: Block building tool
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool with a Handle part, add the Tool aiming (client part) LocalScript to the same Tool, and put the Tool in StarterPack.
scripts.about: Click to place blocks that snap to a grid; the server checks you are close enough and limits how many blocks each player can build.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local GRID = 4 -- block size and grid size in studs
local REACH = 40 -- how far away you can build
local MAX_BLOCKS = 200 -- per player
local COOLDOWN = 0.15

local tool = script.Parent
local clickPosition = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
clickPosition.Name = "ClickPosition"
clickPosition.Parent = tool

local buildFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerBuilds") or Instance.new("Folder")
buildFolder.Name = "PlayerBuilds"
buildFolder.Parent = workspace
local lastPlace = 0

-- Round a position to the nearest grid spot
local function snap(position)
	local function r(n)
		return math.floor(n / GRID + 0.5) * GRID
	end
	return Vector3.new(r(position.X), r(position.Y), r(position.Z))
end

clickPosition.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target)
	local character = tool.Parent
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= player or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" or not root then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - lastPlace < COOLDOWN or (target - root.Position).Magnitude > REACH then
		return
	end
	lastPlace = os.clock()

	-- Each player's blocks go in their own folder so we can count them
	local myFolder = buildFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId))
	if not myFolder then
		myFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		myFolder.Name = tostring(player.UserId)
		myFolder.Parent = buildFolder
	end
	if #myFolder:GetChildren() >= MAX_BLOCKS then
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Block limit reached!")
		return
	end

	-- Nudge the click point back toward the player so the block sits ON the surface, not inside it
	local towardPlayer = (root.Position - target).Unit * (GRID / 2)
	local position = snap(target + towardPlayer)
	-- Do not place a block inside another block or inside a player
	if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(position), Vector3.new(GRID, GRID, GRID) * 0.9) > 0 then
		return
	end
	local block = Instance.new("Part")
	block.Size = Vector3.new(GRID, GRID, GRID)
	block.Position = position
	block.Anchored = true
	block.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	block.Color = player.TeamColor.Color
	block.Parent = myFolder
end)

-- Clean up a player's blocks when they leave
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local myFolder = buildFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId))
	if myFolder then
		myFolder:Destroy()
	end
end)

scripts.title: Boomerang
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool with a Handle part, add the Tool aiming (client part) LocalScript to the same Tool, and put the Tool in StarterPack.
scripts.about: Throws a spinning boomerang toward your click; it hits enemies on the way out and on the way back to you.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DISTANCE = 40 -- how far it flies before turning around
local SPEED = 60
local DAMAGE = 15
local HIT_RADIUS = 3

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local clickPosition = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
clickPosition.Name = "ClickPosition"
clickPosition.Parent = tool
local flying = false

clickPosition.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target)
	local character = tool.Parent
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if flying or Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= player or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" or not root then
		return
	end
	local offset = (target - handle.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	if offset.Magnitude < 1 then
		return
	end
	flying = true
	handle.Transparency = 1 -- the one in your hand disappears while it flies

	local rang = handle:Clone()
	rang.Anchored = true
	rang.CanCollide = false
	rang.Transparency = 0
	rang.Parent = workspace

	local position = handle.Position
	local direction = offset.Unit
	local travelled = 0
	local returning = false
	local hitOut, hitBack = {}, {}
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, rang }

	local connection
	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		local step = SPEED * deltaTime
		if not returning then
			position += direction * step
			travelled += step
			returning = travelled >= DISTANCE
		else
			local home = root.Position - position
			if home.Magnitude < 3 or not root.Parent then
				connection:Disconnect()
				rang:Destroy()
				handle.Transparency = 0
				flying = false
				return
			end
			position += home.Unit * math.min(step, home.Magnitude)
		end
		rang.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, os.clock() * 20, 0) -- spin!
		local hitList = returning and hitBack or hitOut
		for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, HIT_RADIUS, params)) do
			local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid and not hitList[humanoid] then
				hitList[humanoid] = true
				humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
			end
		end
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Bow and arrow
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool with a Handle part (the bow), add the Tool aiming (client part) LocalScript to the same Tool, and put the Tool in StarterPack.
scripts.about: Shoots arrows that fly in an arc, hurt what they hit and stick into walls for a few seconds.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local ARROW_SPEED = 160
local DAMAGE = 35
local COOLDOWN = 0.8

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local clickPosition = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
clickPosition.Name = "ClickPosition"
clickPosition.Parent = tool
local lastShot = 0

clickPosition.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target)
	local character = tool.Parent
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= player or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - lastShot < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastShot = os.clock()

	local position = handle.Position
	if (target - position).Magnitude < 1 then
		return
	end
	local velocity = (target - position).Unit * ARROW_SPEED
	local arrow = Instance.new("Part")
	arrow.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 3)
	arrow.Anchored = true
	arrow.CanCollide = false
	arrow.CanQuery = false
	arrow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 85, 50)
	arrow.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + velocity)
	arrow.Parent = workspace
	Debris:AddItem(arrow, 8)

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, arrow }
	local gravity = Vector3.new(0, -workspace.Gravity * 0.5, 0) -- arrows drop a little

	local connection
	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		velocity += gravity * deltaTime
		local step = velocity * deltaTime
		local result = workspace:Raycast(position, step, params)
		if result then
			connection:Disconnect()
			-- Stick into whatever we hit
			arrow.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(result.Position, result.Position + velocity)
			if not result.Instance.Anchored then
				arrow.Anchored = false
				local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
				weld.Part0 = arrow
				weld.Part1 = result.Instance
				weld.Parent = arrow
				arrow.Massless = true
			end
			local model = result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local victim = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
			local teammate = victim and victim.Team and victim.Team == player.Team and not player.Neutral
			if humanoid and not teammate then
				local tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
				tag.Name = "creator"
				tag.Value = player
				tag.Parent = humanoid
				Debris:AddItem(tag, 2)
				humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
			end
			return
		end
		position += step
		arrow.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + velocity)
	end)
end)

scripts.about: Click somewhere you can see to blink there instantly; the server checks it is close enough and not through a wall.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local MAX_DISTANCE = 60
local COOLDOWN = 2

local tool = script.Parent
local clickPosition = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
clickPosition.Name = "ClickPosition"
clickPosition.Parent = tool
local lastTeleport = 0

clickPosition.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target)
	local character = tool.Parent
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= player or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" or not root then

scripts.title: Damage helper with kill credit (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ServerScriptService and name it Damage, then require it from your server weapon Scripts.
scripts.about: One safe function for hurting things: it skips teammates, respects force fields and leaves a creator tag so kill rewards know who did it.
scripts.code:
--[[ How to use it from a server Script:
	local Damage = require(game.ServerScriptService.Damage)
	Damage.deal(attackerPlayer, enemyHumanoid, 25)
	if Damage.canHurt(attackerPlayer, enemyHumanoid) then ... end
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local TAG_TIME = 3 -- seconds a hit still counts for the kill

local Damage = {}

-- Is this humanoid allowed to be hurt by this player?
function Damage.canHurt(attacker, humanoid)
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	local victim = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent)
	if victim == attacker then
		return false -- no hurting yourself
	end
	if victim and attacker and not attacker.Neutral and victim.Team ~= nil and victim.Team == attacker.Team then
		return false -- same team
	end
	return true
end

-- Hurt a humanoid and remember who did it. Returns true if damage was dealt.
function Damage.deal(attacker, humanoid, amount)
	if not Damage.canHurt(attacker, humanoid) then
		return false
	end
	-- Swap the old tag for a fresh one
	local old = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	if attacker then
		local tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		tag.Name = "creator"
		tag.Value = attacker
		tag.Parent = humanoid
		Debris:AddItem(tag, TAG_TIME)
	end
	humanoid:TakeDamage(amount) -- TakeDamage does nothing if they have a ForceField
	return true
end

-- Who last hurt this humanoid? (a Player, or nil)
function Damage.getKiller(humanoid)
	local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	return tag and tag.Value
end

return Damage

scripts.title: Fireball spell

scripts.about: Casts a glowing fireball that flies toward where you click and sets enemies on fire for a few seconds.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPEED = 70
local HIT_DAMAGE = 20
local BURN_DAMAGE = 5 -- per second
local BURN_TIME = 4
local COOLDOWN = 1.5
local MAX_DISTANCE = 250

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local clickPosition = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
clickPosition.Name = "ClickPosition"
clickPosition.Parent = tool
local lastCast = 0

local function burn(humanoid, caster)
	local root = humanoid.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or root:FindFirstChild("Burning") then
		return
	end
	local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
	fire.Name = "Burning"
	fire.Parent = root
	for _ = 1, BURN_TIME do
		task.wait(1)
		if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			break
		end
		humanoid:TakeDamage(BURN_DAMAGE)
	end
	fire:Destroy()
end

clickPosition.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target)
	local character = tool.Parent
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= player or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - lastCast < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastCast = os.clock()

	local position = handle.Position
	if (target - position).Magnitude < 1 then
		return
	end
	local direction = (target - position).Unit
	local ball = Instance.new("Part")
	ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	ball.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	ball.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	ball.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
	ball.Anchored = true
	ball.CanCollide = false
	ball.CanQuery = false
	ball.Position = position
	local flame = Instance.new("Fire")
	flame.Size = 4
	flame.Parent = ball
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 50)
	light.Range = 14
	light.Parent = ball
	ball.Parent = workspace

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, ball }
	local travelled = 0
	local connection
	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		local step = direction * SPEED * deltaTime
		local result = workspace:Raycast(position, step, params)
		travelled += step.Magnitude
		if result or travelled > MAX_DISTANCE then
			connection:Disconnect()
			ball:Destroy()
			local model = result and result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local victim = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
			local teammate = victim and victim.Team and victim.Team == player.Team and not player.Neutral
			if humanoid and not teammate then
				local tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
				tag.Name = "creator"
				tag.Value = player
				tag.Parent = humanoid
				Debris:AddItem(tag, BURN_TIME + 1)
				humanoid:TakeDamage(HIT_DAMAGE)
				task.spawn(burn, humanoid, player)
			end
			return
		end
		position += step
		ball.Position = position
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Floating damage numbers
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.
scripts.about: Whenever a player or NPC loses health, a red number pops up above them and floats away.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local watched = {}

local function popNumber(head, amount)
	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 40)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10) / 10, 2, 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.MaxDistance = 100
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "-" .. math.floor(amount + 0.5)
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 60)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	label.Parent = billboard
	billboard.Parent = head

	-- Float up and fade out
	local info = TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	TweenService:Create(billboard, info, { StudsOffset = billboard.StudsOffset + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(label, info, { TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(billboard, 0.9)
end

local function watch(humanoid)
	if watched[humanoid] then
		return
	end
	watched[humanoid] = true
	local last = humanoid.Health
	humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
		local lost = last - health
		last = health
		local head = humanoid.Parent and humanoid.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if lost >= 1 and head then
			popNumber(head, lost)
		end
	end)
	humanoid.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if not humanoid:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			watched[humanoid] = nil
		end
	end)
end

-- Watch every humanoid in the game, now and later
for _, thing in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if thing:IsA("Humanoid") then
		watch(thing)
	end
end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(thing)
	if thing:IsA("Humanoid") then
		watch(thing)
	end
end)

scripts.title: Grappling hook
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool with a Handle part, add the Tool aiming (client part) LocalScript to the same Tool, and put the Tool in StarterPack.
scripts.about: Click a wall or ceiling to shoot a rope at it and get pulled there fast.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local RANGE = 120
local PULL_SPEED = 90
local MAX_PULL_TIME = 2.5
local COOLDOWN = 1

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local clickPosition = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
clickPosition.Name = "ClickPosition"
clickPosition.Parent = tool
local busy = false

clickPosition.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target)
	local character = tool.Parent
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if busy or Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= player or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" or not root then
		return
	end
	local offset = target - handle.Position
	if offset.Magnitude < 1 then
		return
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	local result = workspace:Raycast(handle.Position, offset.Unit * RANGE, params)
	if not result or not result.Instance.Anchored then
		return -- only grab onto things that do not move
	end
	busy = true

	-- An attachment stuck where the hook landed
	local hookPoint = Instance.new("Attachment")
	hookPoint.Parent = result.Instance
	hookPoint.WorldPosition = result.Position

	-- A rope you can see, from the gun to the hook
	local gunPoint = Instance.new("Attachment")
	gunPoint.Parent = handle
	local rope = Instance.new("RopeConstraint")
	rope.Attachment0 = gunPoint
	rope.Attachment1 = hookPoint
	rope.Visible = true
	rope.Length = (result.Position - handle.Position).Magnitude + 5
	rope.Parent = handle

	-- AlignPosition pulls the player's body toward the hook
	local pull = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
	pull.Attachment0 = root:FindFirstChild("RootAttachment")
	pull.Attachment1 = hookPoint
	pull.MaxVelocity = PULL_SPEED
	pull.MaxForce = math.huge
	pull.Responsiveness = 50
	pull.Parent = root

	local started = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - started < MAX_PULL_TIME and (root.Position - result.Position).Magnitude > 5 do
		task.wait()
	end
	pull:Destroy()
	rope:Destroy()
	gunPoint:Destroy()
	hookPoint:Destroy()
	task.wait(COOLDOWN)
	busy = false
end)

scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool with a Handle part and put the Tool in StarterPack.

-- Settings: change this number!
local GRAVITY_LEFT = 0.25 -- 0.25 = only a quarter of normal gravity while holding it

local tool = script.Parent
local force = nil

tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
	local character = tool.Parent
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local attachment = root and root:FindFirstChild("RootAttachment")
	if not attachment then
		return
	end
	-- A VectorForce pushes up against gravity on the whole character
	local mass = 0
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			mass += part:GetMass()
		end
	end
	force = Instance.new("VectorForce")
	force.Attachment0 = attachment
	force.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	force.Force = Vector3.new(0, mass * workspace.Gravity * (1 - GRAVITY_LEFT), 0)
	force.Parent = root
end)

tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	if force then
		force:Destroy()
		force = nil
	end
end)

scripts.about: Click while holding the potion to drink it and get health back; it has a few sips before it is used up.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local HEAL_PER_SIP = 35
local SIPS = 3
local DRINK_TIME = 0.8 -- seconds per sip

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local sipsLeft = SIPS
local drinking = false
tool.ToolTip = "Healing Potion (" .. sipsLeft .. " sips)"

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	local character = tool.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if drinking or not player or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	if humanoid.Health >= humanoid.MaxHealth then
		return -- already full, save it!
	end
	drinking = true

	-- Tilt the bottle up like you are drinking
	tool.Grip = tool.Grip * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-60), 0, 0)
	task.wait(DRINK_TIME)
	tool.Grip = tool.Grip * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(60), 0, 0)

	humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.Health + HEAL_PER_SIP, humanoid.MaxHealth)
	sipsLeft -= 1
	tool.ToolTip = "Healing Potion (" .. sipsLeft .. " sips)"
	if sipsLeft <= 0 then
		tool:Destroy() -- all gone
		return
	end
	drinking = false
end)

scripts.title: Hitbox helper (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ServerScriptService and name it Hitbox, then require it from your server weapon Scripts.
scripts.about: Finds every enemy humanoid inside a box or a sphere (never the attacker), so making melee attacks is one line.
scripts.code:
--[[ How to use it from a server Script:
	local Hitbox = require(game.ServerScriptService.Hitbox)
	-- A 5 by 5 by 6 box just in front of the player
	local enemies = Hitbox.box(character, root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -4), Vector3.new(5, 5, 6))
	for _, humanoid in ipairs(enemies) do
		humanoid:TakeDamage(10)
	end
	-- Everyone within 12 studs of a spot
	local nearby = Hitbox.sphere(character, root.Position, 12)
]]

local Hitbox = {}

-- Turn a list of parts into a list of humanoids (each one only once)
local function humanoidsFrom(parts, ignoreCharacter)
	local found, list = {}, {}
	for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
		local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and model ~= ignoreCharacter and humanoid.Health > 0 and not found[humanoid] then
			found[humanoid] = true
			table.insert(list, humanoid)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function makeParams(ignoreCharacter)
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreCharacter and { ignoreCharacter } or {}
	return params
end

function Hitbox.box(attackerCharacter, cframe, size)
	local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe, size, makeParams(attackerCharacter))
	return humanoidsFrom(parts, attackerCharacter)
end

function Hitbox.sphere(attackerCharacter, position, radius)
	local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, radius, makeParams(attackerCharacter))
	return humanoidsFrom(parts, attackerCharacter)
end

-- Optional: show the box for half a second while you test (only in Studio)
function Hitbox.debugBox(cframe, size)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.Transparency = 0.7
	part.Color = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
	part.CFrame = cframe
	part.Size = size
	part.Parent = workspace
	game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(part, 0.5)
end

return Hitbox

scripts.title: Kill streak rewards
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService (weapons must leave a creator tag, like the Damage helper module does).
scripts.about: Counts how many players you defeat without dying and gives rewards at 3, 5 and 10 in a row, telling the whole server.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: streak number -> what happens
local REWARDS = {
	[3] = { message = "is on a 3 kill streak!", speed = 4 },
	[5] = { message = "is on a RAMPAGE (5 streak)!", speed = 8, coins = 50 },
	[10] = { message = "is UNSTOPPABLE (10 streak)!", speed = 12, coins = 200 },
}

local streaks = {}

local function tellEveryone(text)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", text)
	end
end

local function reward(killer)
	local streak = streaks[killer]
	local prize = REWARDS[streak]
	killer:SetAttribute("Streak", streak)
	if not prize then
		return
	end
	tellEveryone(killer.DisplayName .. " " .. prize.message)
	local humanoid = killer.Character and killer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and prize.speed then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed += prize.speed
	end
	local stats = killer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if coins and prize.coins then
		coins.Value += prize.coins
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	streaks[player] = 0
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			-- Dying ends your own streak
			streaks[player] = 0
			player:SetAttribute("Streak", 0)
			local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
			local killer = tag and tag.Value
			if killer and killer:IsA("Player") and killer ~= player and streaks[killer] then
				streaks[killer] += 1
				reward(killer)
			end
		end)
	end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	streaks[player] = nil
end)

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	local character = tool.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)

	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not player or not root or os.clock() - lastSwing < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastSwing = os.clock()

	-- Play the built-in tool swing animation
	local anim = Instance.new("StringValue")
	anim.Name = "toolanim"
	anim.Value = "Slash"
	anim.Parent = tool

	-- Look for an ore just in front of the player
	local spot = root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * (REACH / 2)
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(spot, REACH / 2)) do
		if CollectionService:HasTag(part, "Ore") and not part:GetAttribute("Broken") then
			local hitsLeft = (part:GetAttribute("HitsLeft") or part:GetAttribute("Health") or 3) - HIT_POWER
			part:SetAttribute("HitsLeft", hitsLeft)
			if hitsLeft <= 0 then
				breakOre(part, player)
			end
			break -- one ore per swing
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Place a timed bomb
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool with a Handle part and put the Tool in StarterPack.
scripts.about: Click to drop a ticking bomb at your feet; it beeps faster and faster and then explodes.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local FUSE = 4 -- seconds
local DAMAGE = 80
local BLAST_RADIUS = 14
local COOLDOWN = 8

local tool = script.Parent
local lastBomb = 0

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	local character = tool.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not player or not root or os.clock() - lastBomb < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastBomb = os.clock()

	local bomb = Instance.new("Part")
	bomb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	bomb.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
	bomb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	bomb.Position = root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
	bomb.Parent = workspace
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	light.Range = 6
	light.Parent = bomb

	-- Blink faster and faster until it goes off
	local started = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - started < FUSE do
		light.Enabled = not light.Enabled
		bomb.Color = light.Enabled and Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		local left = FUSE - (os.clock() - started)
		task.wait(math.max(left / 8, 0.05))
	end

	local boom = Instance.new("Explosion")
	boom.Position = bomb.Position
	boom.BlastRadius = BLAST_RADIUS
	boom.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
	local hurt = {}
	boom.Hit:Connect(function(part, distance)
		local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and not hurt[humanoid] then
			hurt[humanoid] = true
			local tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
			tag.Name = "creator"
			tag.Value = player
			tag.Parent = humanoid
			Debris:AddItem(tag, 2)
			humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE * (1 - distance / BLAST_RADIUS))
		end
	end)
	boom.Parent = workspace
	bomb:Destroy()
end)

scripts.about: Press F or click with no tool to throw a punch (with a Punch button on phones); the server decides if it hits.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: put a punch animation id here (optional)
local PUNCH_ANIMATION_ID = "" -- like "rbxassetid://123456"

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")
local punchEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Punch")

local track
if PUNCH_ANIMATION_ID ~= "" then
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = PUNCH_ANIMATION_ID
	track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
end

local function punch(_, state)
	if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	-- Do not punch while holding a tool (tools use the click)
	if character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	if track then
		track:Play()
	end
	punchEvent:FireServer()
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end

ContextActionService:BindAction("Punch", punch, true, Enum.KeyCode.F, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("Punch", "Punch")

humanoid.Died:Connect(function()

scripts.title: Punch combat (server part)
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and add the Punch combat (client part) LocalScript too.
scripts.about: Checks each punch on the server with a cooldown and a small hitbox in front of the player, then damages and knocks back who it hits.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DAMAGE = 10
local COOLDOWN = 0.5
local REACH = 4 -- how far in front the hitbox is
local KNOCKBACK = 30

local punchEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Punch") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
punchEvent.Name = "Punch"
punchEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local lastPunch = {}

punchEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - (lastPunch[player] or 0) < COOLDOWN then
		return -- too fast (stops auto clickers and cheaters)
	end
	lastPunch[player] = os.clock()

	-- A box in front of the player is the "fist"
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	local boxCFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -REACH)
	local hitSomeone = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(boxCFrame, Vector3.new(4, 5, 4), params)) do
		local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local enemy = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if enemy and enemy.Health > 0 and not hitSomeone[enemy] then
			hitSomeone[enemy] = true
			local tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
			tag.Name = "creator"
			tag.Value = player
			tag.Parent = enemy
			Debris:AddItem(tag, 2)
			enemy:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
			local enemyRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if enemyRoot then
				enemyRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * KNOCKBACK + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
			end
		end
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastPunch[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Raycast gun (server part)
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool with a Handle part, add the Tool aiming (client part) LocalScript to the same Tool, and put the Tool in StarterPack.
scripts.about: A gun the server controls: it checks every shot, uses ammo, reloads with R, and draws a laser line to what it hit.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these!
local DAMAGE = 20
local HEADSHOT_MULTIPLIER = 2
local RANGE = 300
local FIRE_RATE = 0.15 -- seconds between shots
local MAG_SIZE = 12
local RELOAD_TIME = 1.5
local AUTOMATIC = false -- true = hold to keep shooting

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")

local clickPosition = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
clickPosition.Name = "ClickPosition"
clickPosition.Parent = tool
local reloadEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
reloadEvent.Name = "Reload"
reloadEvent.Parent = tool

tool:SetAttribute("Ammo", MAG_SIZE)
tool:SetAttribute("MaxAmmo", MAG_SIZE)
tool:SetAttribute("Automatic", AUTOMATIC)
tool:SetAttribute("FireRate", FIRE_RATE)

local lastShot = 0
local reloading = false

local function reload()
	if reloading or tool:GetAttribute("Ammo") == MAG_SIZE then
		return
	end
	reloading = true
	tool:SetAttribute("Reloading", true)
	task.wait(RELOAD_TIME)
	tool:SetAttribute("Ammo", MAG_SIZE)
	tool:SetAttribute("Reloading", false)
	reloading = false
end

local function drawTracer(from, to)
	local beam = Instance.new("Part")
	beam.Anchored = true
	beam.CanCollide = false
	beam.CanQuery = false
	beam.CanTouch = false
	beam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	beam.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 120)
	beam.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, (to - from).Magnitude)
	beam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((from + to) / 2, to)
	beam.Parent = workspace
	Debris:AddItem(beam, 0.05)
end

local function hurt(attacker, humanoid, amount)
	local victim = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent)
	if victim and victim.Team and victim.Team == attacker.Team and not attacker.Neutral then
		return -- no hurting teammates
	end
	-- The "creator" tag tells kill scripts who did it
	local tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
	tag.Name = "creator"
	tag.Value = attacker
	tag.Parent = humanoid
	Debris:AddItem(tag, 2)
	humanoid:TakeDamage(amount)
end

clickPosition.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target)
	local character = tool.Parent
	-- Only the player holding the gun may shoot it, and only with real data
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= player or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	if reloading or os.clock() - lastShot < FIRE_RATE * 0.9 then
		return
	end
	local ammo = tool:GetAttribute("Ammo")
	if ammo <= 0 then
		task.spawn(reload)
		return
	end
	lastShot = os.clock()
	tool:SetAttribute("Ammo", ammo - 1)

	local origin = handle.Position
	local offset = target - origin
	if offset.Magnitude < 0.1 then
		return
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, offset.Unit * RANGE, params)
	drawTracer(origin, result and result.Position or origin + offset.Unit * RANGE)

	if result then
		local model = result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			local damage = result.Instance.Name == "Head" and DAMAGE * HEADSHOT_MULTIPLIER or DAMAGE
			hurt(player, humanoid, damage)
		end
	end
end)

reloadEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(tool.Parent) == player then
		reload()
	end
end)

scripts.title: Rocket launcher
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool with a Handle part, add the Tool aiming (client part) LocalScript to the same Tool, and put the Tool in StarterPack.
scripts.about: Fires a rocket that flies straight to where you clicked and explodes, hurting everyone nearby.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPEED = 80 -- studs per second
local MAX_DISTANCE = 400
local BLAST_RADIUS = 10
local MAX_DAMAGE = 60 -- damage right in the middle (less further away)
local COOLDOWN = 2

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local clickPosition = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
clickPosition.Name = "ClickPosition"
clickPosition.Parent = tool
local lastShot = 0

local function explode(position, shooter)
	local boom = Instance.new("Explosion")
	boom.Position = position
	boom.BlastRadius = BLAST_RADIUS
	boom.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0 -- we do our own damage below
	local hurt = {}
	boom.Hit:Connect(function(part, distance)
		local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or hurt[humanoid] then
			return
		end
		hurt[humanoid] = true
		local victim = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
		if victim and victim ~= shooter and victim.Team and victim.Team == shooter.Team and not shooter.Neutral then
			return -- teammates are safe
		end
		local tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		tag.Name = "creator"
		tag.Value = shooter
		tag.Parent = humanoid
		Debris:AddItem(tag, 2)
		humanoid:TakeDamage(MAX_DAMAGE * (1 - distance / BLAST_RADIUS))
	end)
	boom.Parent = workspace
end

clickPosition.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target)
	local character = tool.Parent
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= player or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - lastShot < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastShot = os.clock()

	local position = handle.Position
	if (target - position).Magnitude < 1 then
		return
	end
	local direction = (target - position).Unit
	local rocket = Instance.new("Part")
	rocket.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 2.5)
	rocket.Anchored = true
	rocket.CanCollide = false
	rocket.CanQuery = false
	rocket.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 90)
	rocket.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction)
	local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
	fire.Size = 2
	fire.Parent = rocket
	rocket.Parent = workspace

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, rocket }
	local travelled = 0

	-- Move the rocket a little each frame and check if it hit something on the way
	local connection
	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		local step = direction * SPEED * deltaTime
		local result = workspace:Raycast(position, step, params)
		travelled += step.Magnitude
		if result or travelled > MAX_DISTANCE then
			connection:Disconnect()
			rocket:Destroy()
			explode(result and result.Position or position, player)
			return
		end
		position += step
		rocket.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction)
	end)
end)

scripts.about: Fires many pellets at once in a cone, so it is strong up close and weak far away.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local PELLETS = 8
local DAMAGE_PER_PELLET = 8
local SPREAD_DEGREES = 6
local RANGE = 80
local COOLDOWN = 0.9

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local clickPosition = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
clickPosition.Name = "ClickPosition"
clickPosition.Parent = tool

local lastShot = 0

local function tracer(from, to)
	local line = Instance.new("Part")
	line.Anchored = true
	line.CanCollide = false
	line.CanQuery = false
	line.CanTouch = false
	line.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	line.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100)
	line.Size = Vector3.new(0.06, 0.06, (to - from).Magnitude)
	line.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((from + to) / 2, to)
	line.Parent = workspace
	Debris:AddItem(line, 0.05)
end

clickPosition.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target)
	local character = tool.Parent
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= player or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - lastShot < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastShot = os.clock()

	local origin = handle.Position
	if (target - origin).Magnitude < 0.1 then
		return
	end
	local aim = CFrame.lookAt(origin, target)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }

	local damageDone = {} -- add up pellets per humanoid
	for _ = 1, PELLETS do
		-- Tilt each pellet a little bit in a random direction
		local spread = aim * CFrame.Angles(
			math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * SPREAD_DEGREES),
			math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * SPREAD_DEGREES),
			0
		)
		local direction = spread.LookVector * RANGE
		local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
		tracer(origin, result and result.Position or origin + direction)
		local model = result and result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			damageDone[humanoid] = (damageDone[humanoid] or 0) + DAMAGE_PER_PELLET
		end
	end

	for humanoid, damage in pairs(damageDone) do
		local victim = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent)
		local teammate = victim and victim.Team and victim.Team == player.Team and not player.Neutral
		if not teammate and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			local tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
			tag.Name = "creator"
			tag.Value = player
			tag.Parent = humanoid
			Debris:AddItem(tag, 2)
			humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
		end
	end
end)

scripts.about: Throws snowballs that splat on whatever they hit; players who get hit are slowed down for a moment.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local THROW_SPEED = 90
local DAMAGE = 5
local SLOW_SPEED = 8
local SLOW_TIME = 2
local COOLDOWN = 0.5

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local clickPosition = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
clickPosition.Name = "ClickPosition"
clickPosition.Parent = tool
local lastThrow = 0

local function slowDown(humanoid)
	if humanoid:GetAttribute("Slowed") then
		return
	end
	humanoid:SetAttribute("Slowed", true)
	local normal = humanoid.WalkSpeed
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = SLOW_SPEED
	task.delay(SLOW_TIME, function()
		if humanoid.Parent then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = normal
			humanoid:SetAttribute("Slowed", nil)
		end
	end)
end

clickPosition.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target)
	local character = tool.Parent
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= player or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - lastThrow < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastThrow = os.clock()

	local start = handle.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	if (target - start).Magnitude < 1 then
		return
	end
	local ball = Instance.new("Part")
	ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	ball.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	ball.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	ball.Material = Enum.Material.Snow
	ball.CanCollide = false
	ball.Position = start
	ball.Parent = workspace
	ball:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	-- Aim a bit high because gravity pulls it down
	ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (target - start).Unit * THROW_SPEED + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
	Debris:AddItem(ball, 5)

	ball.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		if hit:IsDescendantOf(character) or not ball.Parent then
			return
		end
		local model = hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
			slowDown(humanoid)
		end
		ball:Destroy() -- splat!
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Sword with 3-hit combo

scripts.about: Click quickly to chain three swings; each hit in the combo does more damage and the last one knocks enemies back.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: damage for hit 1, 2 and 3 of the combo
local COMBO_DAMAGE = { 10, 15, 25 }
local COMBO_WINDOW = 0.8 -- seconds you have to click again to keep the combo going
local SWING_COOLDOWN = 0.35
local REACH = 5
local FINISHER_KNOCKBACK = 60

local tool = script.Parent
local comboStep = 0
local lastSwing = 0

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	local character = tool.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local now = os.clock()
	if not player or not root or now - lastSwing < SWING_COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	-- Keep the combo going if we clicked in time, otherwise start over
	if now - lastSwing > COMBO_WINDOW or comboStep >= #COMBO_DAMAGE then
		comboStep = 0
	end
	comboStep += 1
	lastSwing = now

	local anim = Instance.new("StringValue")
	anim.Name = "toolanim"
	anim.Value = comboStep == #COMBO_DAMAGE and "Lunge" or "Slash"
	anim.Parent = tool

	-- Hitbox: a box in front of the player
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	local hit = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -REACH / 2 - 1), Vector3.new(5, 5, REACH), params)) do
		local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local enemy = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local victim = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
		local teammate = victim and victim.Team and victim.Team == player.Team and not player.Neutral
		if enemy and enemy.Health > 0 and not hit[enemy] and not teammate then
			hit[enemy] = true
			local tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
			tag.Name = "creator"
			tag.Value = player
			tag.Parent = enemy
			Debris:AddItem(tag, 2)
			enemy:TakeDamage(COMBO_DAMAGE[comboStep])
			-- The last hit of the combo sends them flying
			local enemyRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if comboStep == #COMBO_DAMAGE and enemyRoot then
				enemyRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * FINISHER_KNOCKBACK + Vector3.new(0, 25, 0)
			end
		end
	end
	tool:SetAttribute("Combo", comboStep) -- a GUI can show the combo number
end)

scripts.title: Throwable grenade
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool with a Handle part, add the Tool aiming (client part) LocalScript to the same Tool, and put the Tool in StarterPack.
scripts.about: Throws a grenade in an arc to where you click; it bounces around and explodes after a short fuse.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local FUSE = 2.5 -- seconds before it explodes
local DAMAGE = 70
local BLAST_RADIUS = 12
local COOLDOWN = 3
local MAX_THROW = 120 -- studs

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local clickPosition = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
clickPosition.Name = "ClickPosition"
clickPosition.Parent = tool
local lastThrow = 0

clickPosition.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target)
	local character = tool.Parent
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= player or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - lastThrow < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastThrow = os.clock()

	local start = handle.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	local offset = target - start
	if offset.Magnitude > MAX_THROW then
		offset = offset.Unit * MAX_THROW
	end
	-- Physics trick: pick a flight time, then work out the speed that lands on the target
	local flightTime = math.clamp(offset.Magnitude / 50, 0.4, 1.5)
	local gravity = Vector3.new(0, -workspace.Gravity, 0)
	local velocity = offset / flightTime - gravity * flightTime / 2

	local grenade = Instance.new("Part")
	grenade.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	grenade.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	grenade.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 80, 50)
	grenade.Position = start
	grenade.Parent = workspace
	grenade:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	grenade.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity

	task.delay(FUSE, function()
		if not grenade.Parent then
			return
		end
		local boom = Instance.new("Explosion")
		boom.Position = grenade.Position
		boom.BlastRadius = BLAST_RADIUS
		boom.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
		local hurt = {}
		boom.Hit:Connect(function(part, distance)
			local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid and not hurt[humanoid] then
				hurt[humanoid] = true
				local victim = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
				local teammate = victim and victim ~= player and victim.Team and victim.Team == player.Team and not player.Neutral
				if not teammate then
					local tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
					tag.Name = "creator"
					tag.Value = player
					tag.Parent = humanoid
					Debris:AddItem(tag, 2)
					humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE * (1 - distance / BLAST_RADIUS))
				end
			end
		end)
		boom.Parent = workspace
		grenade:Destroy()
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Tool aiming (client part)
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript inside a Tool together with one of the server weapon scripts (Raycast gun, Rocket launcher, Grenade, Bow, Freeze ray and others).
scripts.about: Sends the spot you click or tap to the tool's server script, holds to keep firing if the tool is automatic, and presses R to reload.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local tool = script.Parent
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse() -- works with mouse clicks AND phone taps
local clickPosition = tool:WaitForChild("ClickPosition")

local equipped = false
local holding = false

local function fire()
	mouse.TargetFilter = player.Character -- do not aim at yourself
	clickPosition:FireServer(mouse.Hit.Position)
end

tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
	equipped = true
end)

tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	equipped = false
	holding = false
end)

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	holding = true
	fire()
	-- Automatic tools (Attribute Automatic = true) keep firing while you hold
	if tool:GetAttribute("Automatic") then
		local rate = tool:GetAttribute("FireRate") or 0.1
		while holding and equipped do
			task.wait(rate)
			if holding and equipped then
				fire()
			end
		end
	end
end)

tool.Deactivated:Connect(function()
	holding = false
end)

-- Press R to reload (only if the tool has a Reload event)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, typing)
	if typing or not equipped or input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.R then
		return
	end
	local reload = tool:FindFirstChild("Reload")
	if reload then
		reload:FireServer()
	end
end)

scripts.title: Tool hold and attack animations
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript inside any Tool and paste your own animation ids below.
scripts.about: Plays your own holding pose while the tool is out and an attack animation each time you click.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: paste animation ids you made (leave one empty to skip it)
local HOLD_ANIMATION_ID = "" -- like "rbxassetid://123456"
local ATTACK_ANIMATION_ID = ""

local tool = script.Parent
local holdTrack, attackTrack

local function load(character, id, priority, looped)
	if id == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		return nil
	end
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = id
	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	track.Priority = priority
	track.Looped = looped
	return track
end

tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
	local character = tool.Parent
	-- Load once, then reuse (loading again and again wastes memory)
	if not holdTrack and HOLD_ANIMATION_ID ~= "" then
		holdTrack = load(character, HOLD_ANIMATION_ID, Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle, true)
	end
	if not attackTrack and ATTACK_ANIMATION_ID ~= "" then
		attackTrack = load(character, ATTACK_ANIMATION_ID, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action, false)
	end
	if holdTrack then
		holdTrack:Play(0.2)
	end
end)

tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	if holdTrack then
		holdTrack:Stop(0.2)
	end
end)

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	if attackTrack and not attackTrack.IsPlaying then
		attackTrack:Play(0.05)
	end
end)

scripts.title: Car boost pad
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an anchored, flat Part on your road. Point the part's front face the way cars should be launched.
scripts.about: Any car that drives over the pad gets a big push forward in the pad's direction, perfect for race tracks.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these!
local BOOST_SPEED = 150
local COOLDOWN = 1 -- seconds before the same car can boost again

local pad = script.Parent
pad.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
local recent = {}

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	-- Find the car's seat to know this is a vehicle
	local car = hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	local seat = car and car:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true)
	if not seat or not seat.Occupant then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - (recent[car] or 0) < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	recent[car] = os.clock()
	-- Keep the car's up and down speed, but replace forward speed with a boost
	local current = seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local boost = pad.CFrame.LookVector * BOOST_SPEED
	seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(boost.X, current.Y, boost.Z)
	task.delay(COOLDOWN * 2, function()
		recent[car] = nil
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Car crash damage
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a car Model with a VehicleSeat.
scripts.about: Hard crashes hurt the car; it starts smoking when badly damaged and explodes when its health reaches zero.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these!
local MAX_HEALTH = 100
local CRASH_SPEED = 30 -- losing more speed than this in one moment counts as a crash
local RESPAWN_PARTS_AFTER = 10

local car = script.Parent
local seat = car:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true)
car:SetAttribute("Health", MAX_HEALTH)

local smoke = Instance.new("Smoke")
smoke.Enabled = false
smoke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
smoke.Parent = seat

local lastVelocity = seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity
local destroyed = false

local function explode()
	destroyed = true
	local blast = Instance.new("Explosion")
	blast.Position = seat.Position
	blast.BlastRadius = 10
	blast.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0 -- do not kill players inside, just push them
	blast.Parent = workspace
	if seat.Occupant then
		seat.Occupant.Sit = false
	end
	for _, part in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		end
	end
	seat.Disabled = true -- nobody can drive a wreck
	task.wait(RESPAWN_PARTS_AFTER)
	car:Destroy()
end

while car.Parent and not destroyed do
	task.wait(0.1)
	local velocity = seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local speedLost = (lastVelocity - velocity).Magnitude
	lastVelocity = velocity
	if speedLost > CRASH_SPEED then
		local health = car:GetAttribute("Health") - (speedLost - CRASH_SPEED)
		car:SetAttribute("Health", math.max(0, health))
		smoke.Enabled = health < MAX_HEALTH * 0.4
		if health <= 0 then
			explode()
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Car fuel and gas station
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a car Model with a VehicleSeat. To refuel, make an anchored Part named GasPump somewhere and drive into it.
scripts.about: The car uses fuel while you drive; when it runs out the car stops, and touching a GasPump fills it back up.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these!
local MAX_FUEL = 100
local USE_PER_SECOND = 1.5 -- at full throttle

local car = script.Parent
local seat = car:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true)
local normalSpeed = seat.MaxSpeed
local normalTorque = seat.Torque
car:SetAttribute("Fuel", MAX_FUEL) -- a speed GUI can show this

-- Refill when any part of the car touches a GasPump
for _, part in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") then
		part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			if hit.Name == "GasPump" and car:GetAttribute("Fuel") < MAX_FUEL then
				car:SetAttribute("Fuel", MAX_FUEL)
				local humanoid = seat.Occupant
				local player = humanoid and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent)
				if player then
					player:SetAttribute("Notice", "Tank full!")
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

while car.Parent do
	task.wait(0.5)
	local fuel = car:GetAttribute("Fuel")
	if seat.Occupant and fuel > 0 then
		fuel = math.max(0, fuel - math.abs(seat.ThrottleFloat) * USE_PER_SECOND * 0.5)
		car:SetAttribute("Fuel", fuel)
	end
	-- No fuel means no engine power (works with the built-in VehicleSeat motor)
	seat.MaxSpeed = fuel > 0 and normalSpeed or 0
	seat.Torque = fuel > 0 and normalTorque or 0
	car:SetAttribute("OutOfFuel", fuel <= 0) -- your own drive script can check this
end

scripts.title: Car headlights

		spot.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
		spot.Range = 40
		spot.Angle = 60
		spot.Brightness = 3
		spot.Enabled = false
		spot.Parent = part
		table.insert(lights, { part = part, spot = spot })
	end
end

local on = false
local function setLights(state)
	on = state
	for _, light in ipairs(lights) do
		light.spot.Enabled = on
		light.part.Material = on and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.Glass
	end
end

local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Lights"

prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 6

prompt.Enabled = false
prompt.Parent = seat

seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
	prompt.Enabled = seat.Occupant ~= nil
end)

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	local humanoid = seat.Occupant
	if humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent) == player then
		setLights(not on)
	end
end)

setLights(false)

scripts.title: Drivable boat
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a boat Model with a VehicleSeat. Make the boat parts light (Custom Physical Properties, low Density) so it floats on Terrain water.
scripts.about: Pushes the boat forward and turns it with W, A, S, D from the VehicleSeat, keeping it upright on the waves.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these!
local SPEED = 40
local TURN_SPEED = 1.2 -- radians per second

local boat = script.Parent
local seat = boat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true)

local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
attachment.Parent = seat

-- LinearVelocity pushes along the water (only X and Z, so it can still bob up and down)
local push = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
push.Attachment0 = attachment
push.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Plane
push.PrimaryTangentAxis = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
push.SecondaryTangentAxis = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
push.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
push.MaxForce = 0
push.Parent = seat

-- AlignOrientation keeps it flat and facing where we steer
local align = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
align.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
align.Attachment0 = attachment
align.MaxTorque = 0
align.Responsiveness = 15
align.Parent = seat

local heading = select(2, seat.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ())

seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
	local humanoid = seat.Occupant
	local player = humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent)
	if player then
		pcall(seat.SetNetworkOwner, seat, player) -- pcall: fails safely if the car is anchored
	else
		pcall(seat.SetNetworkOwnershipAuto, seat)
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	if not seat.Occupant then
		push.MaxForce = 0
		align.MaxTorque = 0
		return
	end
	push.MaxForce = 50000
	align.MaxTorque = 100000
	heading -= seat.SteerFloat * TURN_SPEED * deltaTime
	align.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, heading, 0)
	local forward = CFrame.Angles(0, heading, 0).LookVector
	push.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.new(forward.X, forward.Z) * seat.ThrottleFloat * SPEED
end)

scripts.title: Drivable car with hinge wheels
scripts.where: Put this Script inside your car Model. The car needs a VehicleSeat, back wheels attached with HingeConstraints named DriveLeft and DriveRight, and front wheels on HingeConstraints named SteerLeft and SteerRight (on a steering part).
scripts.about: Reads W, A, S, D from the VehicleSeat to spin the back wheels and turn the front wheels, so the car really drives.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local MAX_SPEED = 60 -- studs per second
local WHEEL_RADIUS = 1.5 -- half your wheel's size
local TURN_ANGLE = 30 -- degrees the front wheels turn
local MOTOR_TORQUE = 10000
local FLIP_LEFT = -1 -- if one side spins backwards, change this to 1

local car = script.Parent
local seat = car:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true)
local driveLeft = car:FindFirstChild("DriveLeft", true)
local driveRight = car:FindFirstChild("DriveRight", true)
local steerLeft = car:FindFirstChild("SteerLeft", true)
local steerRight = car:FindFirstChild("SteerRight", true)

-- Make the hinges the right kind
for _, motor in ipairs({ driveLeft, driveRight }) do
	motor.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Motor
	motor.MotorMaxTorque = MOTOR_TORQUE
end
for _, servo in ipairs({ steerLeft, steerRight }) do
	servo.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
	servo.ServoMaxTorque = MOTOR_TORQUE
	servo.AngularSpeed = 5
end

-- Give the driver control of the car's physics so it feels smooth for them
seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
	local humanoid = seat.Occupant
	local player = humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent)
	if player then
		pcall(seat.SetNetworkOwner, seat, player) -- pcall: fails safely if the car is anchored
	else
		pcall(seat.SetNetworkOwnershipAuto, seat)
	end
end)

local function update()
	-- ThrottleFloat: 1 = W, -1 = S. SteerFloat: -1 = A, 1 = D
	local spin = seat.ThrottleFloat * MAX_SPEED / WHEEL_RADIUS
	if car:GetAttribute("OutOfFuel") then
		spin = 0 -- the fuel script says the tank is empty
	end
	driveLeft.AngularVelocity = spin * FLIP_LEFT
	driveRight.AngularVelocity = -spin * FLIP_LEFT
	local angle = seat.SteerFloat * TURN_ANGLE
	steerLeft.TargetAngle = angle
	steerRight.TargetAngle = angle
end
seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ThrottleFloat"):Connect(update)
seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SteerFloat"):Connect(update)
car:GetAttributeChangedSignal("OutOfFuel"):Connect(update)
update()

scripts.title: Flip the car back over
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a car Model that has a VehicleSeat.
scripts.about: If the car lands upside down or on its side for 3 seconds, it lifts up and turns itself right-side up.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change this!
local STUCK_TIME = 3

local car = script.Parent
local seat = car:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true)
local tippedSince = nil

while car.Parent do
	task.wait(0.5)
	-- UpVector.Y is 1 when the car is flat, 0 on its side, -1 upside down
	local up = seat.CFrame.UpVector.Y
	local slow = seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 5
	if up < 0.4 and slow then
		tippedSince = tippedSince or os.clock()
		if os.clock() - tippedSince > STUCK_TIME then
			-- Keep the direction it was facing, but make it flat and lift it up
			local look = seat.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
			if look.Magnitude < 0.1 then
				look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
			end
			local position = car:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
			car:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(position, position + look.Unit))
			seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			seat.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			tippedSince = nil
		end
	else
		tippedSince = nil
	end
end

scripts.title: Helicopter
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a helicopter Model with a VehicleSeat facing forward.
scripts.about: When someone sits in the pilot seat the helicopter lifts off to cruising height; W and S fly forward and back, A and D turn, and it lands when empty.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these!
local CRUISE_HEIGHT = 60 -- studs above where it took off
local SPEED = 50
local TURN_SPEED = 1.2

local heli = script.Parent
local seat = heli:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true)

local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
attachment.Parent = seat
local mover = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
mover.Attachment0 = attachment
mover.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
mover.MaxForce = 0
mover.Parent = seat
local align = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
align.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
align.Attachment0 = attachment
align.MaxTorque = 0
align.Responsiveness = 8
align.Parent = seat

local groundY = seat.Position.Y
local heading = select(2, seat.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ())

seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
	local humanoid = seat.Occupant
	local player = humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent)
	if player then
		pcall(seat.SetNetworkOwner, seat, player) -- pcall: fails safely if the car is anchored
	else
		pcall(seat.SetNetworkOwnershipAuto, seat)
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	local flying = seat.Occupant ~= nil
	local targetY = flying and groundY + CRUISE_HEIGHT or groundY
	local height = seat.Position.Y - groundY
	if not flying and height < 2 then
		mover.MaxForce = 0 -- landed: let it rest
		align.MaxTorque = 0
		return
	end
	mover.MaxForce = 1e6
	align.MaxTorque = 1e6
	heading -= seat.SteerFloat * TURN_SPEED * deltaTime
	local yaw = CFrame.Angles(0, heading, 0)
	-- Tilt forward a little when flying forward, like a real helicopter
	align.CFrame = yaw * CFrame.Angles(-seat.ThrottleFloat * 0.2, 0, 0)
	local climb = math.clamp((targetY - seat.Position.Y) * 0.8, -15, 15)
	local forward = flying and yaw.LookVector * seat.ThrottleFloat * SPEED or Vector3.zero
	mover.VectorVelocity = forward + Vector3.new(0, climb, 0)
end)

scripts.title: Hoverboard
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a VehicleSeat shaped like a flat board (make it about 2 x 0.5 x 5 studs and unanchored).
scripts.about: Stand on the board to ride it: it floats above the ground and over bumps, W and S go forward and back, A and D turn.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these!
local HOVER_HEIGHT = 3
local SPEED = 45
local TURN_SPEED = 2.5

local board = script.Parent

local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
attachment.Parent = board
local mover = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
mover.Attachment0 = attachment
mover.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
mover.MaxForce = 0
mover.Parent = board
local align = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
align.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
align.Attachment0 = attachment
align.MaxTorque = 0
align.Responsiveness = 20
align.Parent = board

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local heading = select(2, board.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ())

board:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
	local humanoid = board.Occupant
	local player = humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent)
	if player then
		pcall(board.SetNetworkOwner, board, player)
	else
		pcall(board.SetNetworkOwnershipAuto, board)
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	local rider = board.Occupant
	if not rider then
		mover.MaxForce = 0
		align.MaxTorque = 0
		return
	end
	mover.MaxForce = 1e5
	align.MaxTorque = 1e5
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { board, rider.Parent }
	-- Look straight down to find the ground under the board
	local ground = workspace:Raycast(board.Position, Vector3.new(0, -20, 0), params)
	local up = 0
	if ground then
		up = (ground.Position.Y + HOVER_HEIGHT - board.Position.Y) * 6 -- spring up or down to the right height
	else
		up = -30 -- nothing below: fall
	end
	heading -= board.SteerFloat * TURN_SPEED * deltaTime
	local facing = CFrame.Angles(0, heading, 0)
	align.CFrame = facing
	mover.VectorVelocity = facing.LookVector * board.ThrottleFloat * SPEED + Vector3.new(0, up, 0)
end)

scripts.title: Only the owner can drive

seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()

scripts.title: Remove abandoned cars
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a car Model that has a VehicleSeat.
scripts.about: If nobody sits in the car for a while, it fades away so the map does not fill up with old cars.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change this!
local EMPTY_TIME = 60 -- seconds with no driver before it is removed

local car = script.Parent
local seat = car:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true)
local emptySince = os.clock()

seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
	if not seat.Occupant then
		emptySince = os.clock()
	end
end)

while car.Parent do
	task.wait(5)
	-- Also check passenger seats: any Seat with someone in it keeps the car
	local anyone = false
	for _, s in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
		if (s:IsA("Seat") or s:IsA("VehicleSeat")) and s.Occupant then
			anyone = true
		end
	end
	if anyone then
		emptySince = os.clock()
	elseif os.clock() - emptySince > EMPTY_TIME then
		-- Fade out, then delete
		for step = 1, 10 do
			for _, part in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					part.Transparency = math.max(part.Transparency, step / 10)
				end
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		car:Destroy()
	end
end

scripts.title: Simple airplane
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a plane Model with a VehicleSeat facing the front of the plane. Use a long, flat open area as a runway.
scripts.about: Hold W to speed up and take off, S to slow down, and A or D to bank and turn; slow planes sink back to the ground.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these!
local MAX_SPEED = 120
local TAKEOFF_SPEED = 50
local ACCELERATION = 20
local TURN_RATE = 0.8

local plane = script.Parent
local seat = plane:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true)

local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
attachment.Parent = seat
local mover = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
mover.Attachment0 = attachment
mover.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
mover.MaxForce = 0
mover.Parent = seat
local align = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
align.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
align.Attachment0 = attachment
align.MaxTorque = 0
align.Responsiveness = 10
align.Parent = seat

local speed = 0
local heading = select(2, seat.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ())

seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
	local humanoid = seat.Occupant
	local player = humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent)
	if player then
		pcall(seat.SetNetworkOwner, seat, player) -- pcall: fails safely if the car is anchored
	else
		pcall(seat.SetNetworkOwnershipAuto, seat)
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	if not seat.Occupant then
		speed = math.max(speed - ACCELERATION * deltaTime * 2, 0)
		if speed == 0 then
			mover.MaxForce = 0
			align.MaxTorque = 0
			return
		end
	else
		speed = math.clamp(speed + seat.ThrottleFloat * ACCELERATION * deltaTime, 0, MAX_SPEED)
	end
	mover.MaxForce = 1e6
	align.MaxTorque = 1e6
	heading -= seat.SteerFloat * TURN_RATE * deltaTime
	-- Fast planes nose up and climb; slow planes nose down and sink
	local lift = (speed - TAKEOFF_SPEED) / MAX_SPEED -- below 0 when too slow
	local pitch = math.clamp(lift, -0.3, 0.3)
	local roll = -seat.SteerFloat * 0.5
	align.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, heading, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, roll)
	local forward = CFrame.Angles(0, heading, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
	local velocity = forward.LookVector * speed
	if speed < TAKEOFF_SPEED then
		velocity += Vector3.new(0, -20, 0) -- not fast enough: gravity wins
	end
	mover.VectorVelocity = velocity
end)
