scripts.title: Train that follows a track
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a train Model (unanchored parts welded together, with a PrimaryPart set). Put Parts named 1, 2, 3... along the track in a Folder named TrainStops in Workspace.
scripts.about: The train glides from stop to stop along the track, waits at each station so players can hop on, and players can ride on it.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these!
local SPEED = 30 -- studs per second
local WAIT_AT_STOP = 5

local train = script.Parent
local main = train.PrimaryPart
local stopsFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("TrainStops")

local stops = {}
for _, part in ipairs(stopsFolder:GetChildren()) do
	if tonumber(part.Name) then
		table.insert(stops, part)
	end
end
table.sort(stops, function(a, b)
	return tonumber(a.Name) < tonumber(b.Name)
end)

-- Physics movers so players standing on the train ride along with it
main:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
attachment.Parent = main
local alignPosition = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
alignPosition.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
alignPosition.Attachment0 = attachment
alignPosition.MaxForce = 1e7
alignPosition.MaxVelocity = SPEED
alignPosition.Responsiveness = 20
alignPosition.Parent = main
local alignOrientation = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
alignOrientation.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
alignOrientation.Attachment0 = attachment
alignOrientation.MaxTorque = 1e7
alignOrientation.Responsiveness = 10
alignOrientation.Parent = main

local height = 3 -- how far above each stop part the train rides
local index = 1
alignPosition.Position = main.Position
alignOrientation.CFrame = main.CFrame

while #stops > 1 do
	local stop = stops[index]
	local target = stop.Position + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
	-- Face the next stop
	local flat = (target - main.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	if flat.Magnitude > 1 then
		alignOrientation.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, flat.Unit)
	end
	alignPosition.Position = target
	-- Wait until we are close to the stop
	while (main.Position - target).Magnitude > 2 do
		RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
	end
	task.wait(WAIT_AT_STOP)
	index = index % #stops + 1
end

scripts.title: Breakable glass window
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a thin Anchored glass Part (a window).
scripts.about: Running into the window hard (or clicking it) shatters it into flying shards; it fixes itself later.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local BREAK_SPEED = 20 -- how fast you must run into it
local SHARDS = 12
local REPAIR_TIME = 10

local glass = script.Parent
glass.Anchored = true
glass.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
glass.Transparency = 0.5
local broken = false

local function shatter()
	if broken then
		return
	end
	broken = true
	glass.Transparency = 1
	glass.CanCollide = false
	for _ = 1, SHARDS do
		local shard = Instance.new("Part")
		shard.Size = Vector3.new(math.random() + 0.3, math.random() + 0.3, 0.1)
		shard.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
		shard.Transparency = 0.4
		shard.Color = glass.Color
		-- Start somewhere on the window
		local offset = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * glass.Size.X, (math.random() - 0.5) * glass.Size.Y, 0)
		shard.CFrame = glass.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset) * CFrame.Angles(math.random(), math.random(), math.random())
		shard.Parent = workspace
		shard.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-15, 15), math.random(0, 15), math.random(-15, 15))
		Debris:AddItem(shard, 4)
	end
	task.wait(REPAIR_TIME)
	glass.Transparency = 0.5
	glass.CanCollide = true
	broken = false
end

glass.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if broken then
		return
	end
	local character = hit.Parent
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	-- Unanchored things (players, balls, cars) going fast enough break it
	local speed = root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude or hit.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
	if (Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) or not hit.Anchored) and speed >= BREAK_SPEED then
		shatter()
	end
end)

local clicker = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
clicker.Parent = glass
clicker.MouseClick:Connect(shatter)

scripts.title: Changing seasons
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService; parts tagged Leaves (Tag Editor) change color with the seasons too.
scripts.about: Cycles through spring, summer, autumn and winter, changing grass, leaves and light colors each season.
scripts.code:
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- Settings: how long each season lasts and its colors
local SEASON_LENGTH = 300 -- seconds
local SEASONS = {
	{ name = "Spring", grass = Color3.fromRGB(110, 200, 90), leaves = Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 110), ambient = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140) },
	{ name = "Summer", grass = Color3.fromRGB(90, 170, 60), leaves = Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 50), ambient = Color3.fromRGB(160, 150, 130) },
	{ name = "Autumn", grass = Color3.fromRGB(170, 150, 70), leaves = Color3.fromRGB(220, 120, 40), ambient = Color3.fromRGB(150, 120, 100) },
	{ name = "Winter", grass = Color3.fromRGB(230, 235, 240), leaves = Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 250), ambient = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 180) },
}

local terrain = workspace.Terrain

while true do
	for _, season in ipairs(SEASONS) do
		workspace:SetAttribute("Season", season.name) -- other scripts can read this
		-- Terrain grass and leaf colors change for the whole map
		terrain:SetMaterialColor(Enum.Material.Grass, season.grass)
		terrain:SetMaterialColor(Enum.Material.LeafyGrass, season.grass)
		for _, part in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Leaves")) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.Color = season.leaves
			end
		end
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = season.ambient
		-- Snow falls in winter if you have the Snow script
		if season.name == "Winter" then
			workspace:SetAttribute("Weather", "Snow")
		elseif workspace:GetAttribute("Weather") == "Snow" then
			workspace:SetAttribute("Weather", "Clear")
		end
		task.wait(SEASON_LENGTH)
	end
end

scripts.title: Dark cave zone
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts and make a Folder named DarkZones in Workspace with invisible, non-colliding Parts filling your caves.
scripts.about: The screen slowly gets darker and colder when you walk into a cave, and brightens again when you come out.
scripts.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DARK_BRIGHTNESS = -0.35
local DARK_TINT = Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 255)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local zones = workspace:WaitForChild("DarkZones")

local grade = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
grade.Name = "CaveDarkness"
grade.Parent = Lighting

local function isInside(part, point)
	local p = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	return math.abs(p.X) <= half.X and math.abs(p.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(p.Z) <= half.Z
end

local dark = false
while true do
	task.wait(0.25)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local inside = false
	for _, zone in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
		if zone:IsA("BasePart") and isInside(zone, camera.CFrame.Position) then
			inside = true
			break
		end
	end
	if inside ~= dark then
		dark = inside
		local goal = dark and { Brightness = DARK_BRIGHTNESS, TintColor = DARK_TINT, Saturation = -0.4 }
			or { Brightness = 0, TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Saturation = 0 }
		TweenService:Create(grade, TweenInfo.new(1.5), goal):Play()
	end
end

scripts.title: Day and night cycle
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.
scripts.about: Makes the sun move across the sky so day turns into night and back again.
scripts.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DAY_LENGTH = 10 -- minutes for one full day and night
local START_TIME = 8 -- the hour the game starts at (0 = midnight, 12 = noon)
local UPDATE_EVERY = 0.1 -- seconds between updates

Lighting.ClockTime = START_TIME

-- How many in-game hours pass each real second
local hoursPerSecond = 24 / (DAY_LENGTH * 60)

while true do
	local dt = task.wait(UPDATE_EVERY)
	-- Move the clock forward (% 24 makes it go back to 0 after midnight)
	Lighting.ClockTime = (Lighting.ClockTime + hoursPerSecond * dt) % 24
end

scripts.title: Day and night skyboxes
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and put two Sky objects named DaySky and NightSky in ServerStorage.
scripts.about: Swaps the skybox to your night sky after sunset and back to your day sky in the morning.
scripts.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- Settings: change these! (hours, 0 to 24)
local NIGHT_STARTS = 18.5
local DAY_STARTS = 6

local daySky = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("DaySky")
local nightSky = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("NightSky")
local current = nil

local function update()
	local hour = Lighting.ClockTime
	local wanted = (hour >= NIGHT_STARTS or hour < DAY_STARTS) and nightSky or daySky
	if wanted == current then
		return
	end
	current = wanted
	-- Remove any sky that is in Lighting now, then put a copy of the right one in
	for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Sky") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	wanted:Clone().Parent = Lighting
end

Lighting:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ClockTime"):Connect(update)
update()

scripts.title: Disco party lights
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model or Folder of Parts (dance floor tiles, light bulbs or SpotLights).
scripts.about: Every beat, all the parts and lights in the folder jump to new random party colors.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local BEATS_PER_MINUTE = 120
local COLORS = {
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 80),
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40),
	Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 120),
	Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 255),
	Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 255),
}

local holder = script.Parent
local secondsPerBeat = 60 / BEATS_PER_MINUTE

while true do
	for _, thing in ipairs(holder:GetDescendants()) do
		local color = COLORS[math.random(#COLORS)]
		if thing:IsA("BasePart") then
			thing.Color = color
			thing.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		elseif thing:IsA("Light") then
			thing.Color = color
		end
	end
	task.wait(secondsPerBeat)
end

scripts.title: Drifting clouds
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.
scripts.about: Fills the sky with puffy white clouds that slowly float across and wrap around (only on your screen, so it costs the server nothing).
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local CLOUD_COUNT = 25
local AREA = 1200 -- studs wide the sky area is
local HEIGHT = 250
local WIND = Vector3.new(6, 0, 2) -- direction and speed of the wind

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "LocalClouds"
folder.Parent = workspace

local clouds = {}
for _ = 1, CLOUD_COUNT do
	local cloud = Instance.new("Part")
	cloud.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	cloud.Size = Vector3.new(math.random(40, 80), math.random(12, 20), math.random(30, 60))
	cloud.Anchored = true
	cloud.CanCollide = false
	cloud.CanQuery = false
	cloud.CanTouch = false
	cloud.CastShadow = false
	cloud.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	cloud.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	cloud.Transparency = 0.15
	cloud.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-AREA / 2, AREA / 2), HEIGHT + math.random(-20, 20), math.random(-AREA / 2, AREA / 2))
	cloud.Parent = folder
	table.insert(clouds, cloud)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	for _, cloud in ipairs(clouds) do
		local p = cloud.Position + WIND * deltaTime
		-- Wrap around to the other side when a cloud floats too far
		if p.X > AREA / 2 then p = p - Vector3.new(AREA, 0, 0) end
		if p.Z > AREA / 2 then p = p - Vector3.new(0, 0, AREA) end
		if p.X < -AREA / 2 then p = p + Vector3.new(AREA, 0, 0) end
		if p.Z < -AREA / 2 then p = p + Vector3.new(0, 0, AREA) end
		cloud.Position = p
	end
end)

scripts.title: Earthquake
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService; unanchored parts in a Folder named Shakeable in Workspace get thrown around too.
scripts.about: Every few minutes the ground rumbles: everyone's camera shakes and loose objects bounce around.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local QUAKE_EVERY = 240 -- seconds between earthquakes
local QUAKE_TIME = 8 -- how long each one lasts
local SHAKE_STRENGTH = 0.6 -- camera shake (studs)

local shakeable = workspace:FindFirstChild("Shakeable")

local function setCameraShake(strength)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			-- CameraOffset moves the player's camera a little; random values every tick = shaking
			humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(
				(math.random() - 0.5) * strength,
				(math.random() - 0.5) * strength,
				(math.random() - 0.5) * strength
			)
		end
	end
end

while true do
	task.wait(QUAKE_EVERY)
	workspace:SetAttribute("Earthquake", true)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		player:SetAttribute("Notice", "EARTHQUAKE!")
	end
	local stop = os.clock() + QUAKE_TIME
	while os.clock() < stop do
		setCameraShake(SHAKE_STRENGTH)
		if shakeable then
			for _, part in ipairs(shakeable:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part.Anchored then
					local push = Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), math.random(5, 15), math.random(-10, 10))
					part:ApplyImpulse(push * part.AssemblyMass)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	setCameraShake(0)
	workspace:SetAttribute("Earthquake", false)
end

scripts.title: Erupting volcano
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored, non-colliding Part sitting in the crater at the top of your volcano.
scripts.about: Every so often the volcano rumbles, glows and shoots burning lava rocks in all directions that hurt players.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local ERUPT_EVERY = 60 -- seconds between eruptions
local ROCKS = 20
local ROCK_SPEED = 90
local DAMAGE = 25

local crater = script.Parent
crater.CanCollide = false
local glow = Instance.new("PointLight")
glow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 30)
glow.Range = 60
glow.Brightness = 0
glow.Parent = crater

local function throwRock()
	local rock = Instance.new("Part")
	rock.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
	rock.Material = Enum.Material.CrackedLava
	rock.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 30)
	rock.CFrame = crater.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
	local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
	fire.Size = 5
	fire.Parent = rock
	rock.Parent = workspace
	rock:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	-- Mostly up, a bit sideways in a random direction
	local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	local sideways = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * math.random(20, 50)
	rock.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, ROCK_SPEED, 0) + sideways

	local hurt = {}
	rock.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local character = hit.Parent
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) and not hurt[humanoid] then
			hurt[humanoid] = true
			humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
		end
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(rock, 8)
end

while true do
	task.wait(ERUPT_EVERY)
	-- Rumble: the glow gets brighter
	for i = 1, 10 do
		glow.Brightness = i / 2
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	for _ = 1, ROCKS do
		throwRock()
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	glow.Brightness = 0
end

scripts.title: Explosive barrels chain reaction
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and tag your barrel Parts with ExplosiveBarrel (Tag Editor in the Properties window).
scripts.about: Click a barrel to blow it up; any other barrel close by blows up too, then they all come back later.
scripts.code:
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local BLAST_RADIUS = 12
local CHAIN_DELAY = 0.25 -- seconds before nearby barrels go off
local RESPAWN_TIME = 20

local function explode(barrel)
	if barrel:GetAttribute("Exploded") then
		return
	end
	barrel:SetAttribute("Exploded", true)

	local boom = Instance.new("Explosion")
	boom.Position = barrel.Position
	boom.BlastRadius = BLAST_RADIUS
	boom.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0.4 -- only the middle of the blast is deadly
	boom.Parent = workspace

	barrel.Transparency = 1
	barrel.CanCollide = false

	-- Set off the neighbours!
	for _, other in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("ExplosiveBarrel")) do
		if other ~= barrel and (other.Position - barrel.Position).Magnitude <= BLAST_RADIUS then
			task.delay(CHAIN_DELAY, explode, other)
		end
	end

	task.delay(RESPAWN_TIME, function()
		barrel.Transparency = 0
		barrel.CanCollide = true
		barrel:SetAttribute("Exploded", nil)
	end)
end

local function setup(barrel)
	if not barrel:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	barrel.Anchored = true
	local clicker = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
	clicker.MaxActivationDistance = 40
	clicker.Parent = barrel
	clicker.MouseClick:Connect(function()
		explode(barrel)
	end)
end

for _, barrel in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("ExplosiveBarrel")) do
	setup(barrel)
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("ExplosiveBarrel"):Connect(setup)

scripts.title: Fireworks launcher
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part on the ground (the launcher).
scripts.about: Click the launcher to shoot a firework into the sky that bursts into colorful sparks.
scripts.code:
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local HEIGHT = 80 -- how high the firework goes
local FLIGHT_TIME = 1.2
local SPARKS = 120

local launcher = script.Parent
local clicker = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
clicker.Parent = launcher

local function launch()
	local color = Color3.fromHSV(math.random(), 0.8, 1)
	local rocket = Instance.new("Part")
	rocket.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 1.5, 0.5)
	rocket.Anchored = true
	rocket.CanCollide = false
	rocket.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	rocket.Color = color
	rocket.Position = launcher.Position + Vector3.new(0, launcher.Size.Y, 0)
	rocket.Parent = workspace

	-- Sparks that burst out at the top
	local sparks = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	sparks.LightEmission = 1
	sparks.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.6, 0)
	sparks.Speed = NumberRange.new(30, 45)
	sparks.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 1.6)
	sparks.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	sparks.Drag = 2
	sparks.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -15, 0)
	sparks.Rate = 0 -- we Emit them all at once
	sparks.Parent = rocket

	-- Fly up
	local start = rocket.Position
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < FLIGHT_TIME do
		local alpha = (os.clock() - t0) / FLIGHT_TIME
		rocket.Position = start + Vector3.new(math.sin(alpha * 10) * 0.5, HEIGHT * alpha, 0)
		task.wait()
	end
	rocket.Transparency = 1
	sparks:Emit(SPARKS)
	Debris:AddItem(rocket, 3)
end

local busy = false
clicker.MouseClick:Connect(function()
	if busy then
		return
	end
	busy = true
	task.spawn(launch)
	task.wait(0.5)
	busy = false
end)

scripts.title: Flickering light
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a lamp Part that has a PointLight, SpotLight or SurfaceLight inside it.
scripts.about: Makes the light flicker on and off at random like a broken bulb in a horror game.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local FLICKER_CHANCE = 0.3 -- how often it flickers (0 to 1)
local MIN_BRIGHTNESS = 0

local lamp = script.Parent
local light = lamp:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Light")
if not light then
	warn("Put a PointLight, SpotLight or SurfaceLight inside the lamp!")
	return
end
local normalBrightness = light.Brightness
local normalMaterial = lamp.Material

local function setOn(on)
	light.Brightness = on and normalBrightness or MIN_BRIGHTNESS
	lamp.Material = on and normalMaterial or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
end

while true do
	if math.random() < FLICKER_CHANCE then
		-- A quick burst of flickers
		for _ = 1, math.random(2, 6) do
			setOn(false)
			task.wait(math.random() * 0.1 + 0.03)
			setOn(true)
			task.wait(math.random() * 0.15 + 0.03)
		end
	end
	task.wait(math.random() * 2 + 0.5)
end

scripts.title: Foggy zone
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts and make a Folder named FogZones in Workspace with invisible, non-colliding Parts covering foggy areas.
scripts.about: When you walk into a fog zone thick fog rolls in, and it clears up again when you leave.
scripts.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local FOG_DENSITY = 0.6 -- for Atmosphere (0 to 1)
local FOG_END = 60 -- for old-style fog (studs you can see)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local zones = workspace:WaitForChild("FogZones")
local atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
local normalDensity = atmosphere and atmosphere.Density
local normalFogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd

local function isInside(part, point)
	local p = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	return math.abs(p.X) <= half.X and math.abs(p.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(p.Z) <= half.Z
end

local foggy = false
while true do
	task.wait(0.3)
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local inside = false
	if root then
		for _, zone in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
			if zone:IsA("BasePart") and isInside(zone, root.Position) then
				inside = true
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if inside ~= foggy then
		foggy = inside
		local info = TweenInfo.new(2)
		if atmosphere then
			TweenService:Create(atmosphere, info, { Density = foggy and FOG_DENSITY or normalDensity }):Play()
		else
			TweenService:Create(Lighting, info, { FogEnd = foggy and FOG_END or normalFogEnd }):Play()
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Footprints
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.
scripts.about: Leaves little footprints behind walking players that slowly fade away (great for snow or sand maps).
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local STEP_EVERY = 0.35 -- seconds between prints
local FADE_TIME = 6
local PRINT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(60, 50, 40)

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "Footprints"
folder.Parent = workspace
local leftFoot = {}

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function stamp(player, root, humanoid)
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character, folder }
	-- Every other step goes left, then right
	leftFoot[player] = not leftFoot[player]
	local side = leftFoot[player] and -0.5 or 0.5
	local origin = (root.CFrame * CFrame.new(side, 0, 0)).Position
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -(humanoid.HipHeight + 4), 0), rayParams)
	if not hit then
		return
	end
	local mark = Instance.new("Part")
	mark.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.05, 1)
	mark.Anchored = true
	mark.CanCollide = false
	mark.CanQuery = false
	mark.CanTouch = false
	mark.Color = PRINT_COLOR
	mark.Transparency = 0.3
	-- Lie flat on the ground facing the way the player walks
	local forward = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	mark.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hit.Position, hit.Position + forward) + Vector3.new(0, 0.03, 0)
	mark.Parent = folder
	TweenService:Create(mark, TweenInfo.new(FADE_TIME), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(mark, FADE_TIME)
end

while true do
	task.wait(STEP_EVERY)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local velocity = root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local walking = velocity and Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude > 2 and math.abs(velocity.Y) < 5
		if root and humanoid and walking then
			stamp(player, root, humanoid)
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Forest generator
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a big flat Anchored Part (the forest area); optional: put tree Models in a Folder named Trees in ServerStorage.
scripts.about: Places lots of trees at random spots on the ground above the part, each a little bigger or smaller and turned differently.
scripts.code:
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local TREE_COUNT = 60
local MIN_SCALE, MAX_SCALE = 0.8, 1.4

local area = script.Parent
local templates = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Trees")

-- A simple tree made of parts, used when you have no tree models
local function simpleTree()
	local tree = Instance.new("Model")
	local trunk = Instance.new("Part")
	trunk.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 8, 1.5)
	trunk.Position = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
	trunk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 75, 45)
	trunk.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
	trunk.Anchored = true
	trunk.Parent = tree
	local leaves = Instance.new("Part")
	leaves.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	leaves.Size = Vector3.new(7, 7, 7)
	leaves.Position = Vector3.new(0, 9, 0)
	leaves.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 60)
	leaves.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
	leaves.Anchored = true
	leaves.Parent = tree
	tree.PrimaryPart = trunk
	return tree
end

local forest = Instance.new("Model")
forest.Name = "Forest"
forest.Parent = workspace

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { forest }

for _ = 1, TREE_COUNT do
	local x = (math.random() - 0.5) * area.Size.X
	local z = (math.random() - 0.5) * area.Size.Z
	local top = area.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, 200, z)
	-- Shoot a ray down to find the ground
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(top.Position, Vector3.new(0, -400, 0), rayParams)
	if hit then
		local list = templates and templates:GetChildren() or {}
		local tree = #list > 0 and list[math.random(#list)]:Clone() or simpleTree()
		tree:ScaleTo(MIN_SCALE + math.random() * (MAX_SCALE - MIN_SCALE))
		local bottomOffset = tree:GetPivot().Position.Y - tree:GetBoundingBox().Position.Y + tree:GetExtentsSize().Y / 2
		tree:PivotTo(CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, bottomOffset, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.random() * math.pi * 2, 0))
		tree.Parent = forest
	end
end

scripts.title: Glowing light pulse
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part; it adds a PointLight if there is not one already.
scripts.about: Makes a soft light that slowly glows brighter and dimmer and shifts color, great for crystals and portals.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these!
local COLOR_A = Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255)
local COLOR_B = Color3.fromRGB(200, 80, 255)
local MAX_BRIGHTNESS = 4
local PULSE_TIME = 1.5

local part = script.Parent
part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
local light = part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("PointLight") or Instance.new("PointLight")
light.Range = 16
light.Color = COLOR_A
light.Brightness = 0.5
light.Parent = part
part.Color = COLOR_A

-- Repeat forever (-1) and reverse back each time (true)
local info = TweenInfo.new(PULSE_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)
TweenService:Create(light, info, { Brightness = MAX_BRIGHTNESS, Color = COLOR_B }):Play()
TweenService:Create(part, info, { Color = COLOR_B }):Play()

scripts.title: Hills terrain generator
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService (it builds Terrain around the middle of the map when the game starts).
scripts.about: Uses math.noise to build smooth random hills out of grass, rock and sand Terrain, plus water in the low spots.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SIZE = 256 -- studs across (keep it a multiple of 4)
local HILL_HEIGHT = 40
local SMOOTHNESS = 80 -- bigger = wider, gentler hills
local WATER_LEVEL = 8
local SEED = math.random(1, 10000) -- a new world every time (use a number for the same world)

local terrain = workspace.Terrain
local STEP = 4 -- terrain is made of 4 stud blocks

for x = -SIZE / 2, SIZE / 2 - STEP, STEP do
	for z = -SIZE / 2, SIZE / 2 - STEP, STEP do
		-- math.noise gives a smooth bumpy number between about -0.5 and 0.5
		local n = math.noise(x / SMOOTHNESS, z / SMOOTHNESS, SEED + 0.5)
		local height = math.floor((n + 0.5) * HILL_HEIGHT / STEP) * STEP + STEP

		local material = Enum.Material.Grass
		if height <= WATER_LEVEL + STEP then
			material = Enum.Material.Sand
		elseif height > HILL_HEIGHT * 0.7 then
			material = Enum.Material.Rock
		end
		-- Fill a column from the bottom up to the height
		terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(x, height / 2, z), Vector3.new(STEP, height, STEP), material)

		if height < WATER_LEVEL then
			local depth = WATER_LEVEL - height
			terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(x, height + depth / 2, z), Vector3.new(STEP, depth, STEP), Enum.Material.Water)
		end
	end
	task.wait() -- give the server a tiny break each row
end

scripts.title: Knock-down brick wall
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part placed where the wall should stand (the part becomes the wall's floor marker).
scripts.about: Builds a wall of loose physics bricks that players can smash through, and rebuilds it every so often.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local BRICKS_WIDE = 8
local BRICKS_HIGH = 6
local BRICK_SIZE = Vector3.new(4, 2, 2)
local REBUILD_EVERY = 45 -- seconds

local base = script.Parent
base.Transparency = 1
base.CanCollide = false

local wall = Instance.new("Model")
wall.Name = "BrickWall"
wall.Parent = workspace

local function build()
	wall:ClearAllChildren()
	for row = 0, BRICKS_HIGH - 1 do
		-- Every other row is shifted half a brick, like a real wall
		local shift = (row % 2 == 1) and BRICK_SIZE.X / 2 or 0
		for column = 0, BRICKS_WIDE - 1 do
			local brick = Instance.new("Part")
			brick.Size = BRICK_SIZE
			brick.Material = Enum.Material.Brick
			brick.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150 + math.random(-15, 15), 70, 50)
			local x = (column - BRICKS_WIDE / 2 + 0.5) * BRICK_SIZE.X + shift
			local y = row * BRICK_SIZE.Y + BRICK_SIZE.Y / 2
			brick.CFrame = base.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, y - base.Size.Y / 2, 0)
			brick.Parent = wall
		end
	end
	-- Let the server do the physics so everyone sees the same mess
	for _, brick in ipairs(wall:GetChildren()) do
		brick:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	end
end

while true do
	build()
	task.wait(REBUILD_EVERY)
end

scripts.title: Meteor shower
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a big flat, invisible, non-colliding Anchored Part high in the sky above where meteors should land.
scripts.about: Flaming meteors fall from the sky at random spots and explode when they hit the ground.
scripts.code:
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local METEOR_EVERY = 2 -- seconds between meteors
local SIZE = 4
local FALL_SPEED = 120

local sky = script.Parent
sky.Transparency = 1
sky.CanCollide = false
sky.CanTouch = false

local function dropMeteor()
	local x = (math.random() - 0.5) * sky.Size.X
	local z = (math.random() - 0.5) * sky.Size.Z
	local meteor = Instance.new("Part")
	meteor.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	meteor.Size = Vector3.new(SIZE, SIZE, SIZE)
	meteor.Material = Enum.Material.Basalt
	meteor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 30)
	meteor.CFrame = sky.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, 0, z)
	local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
	fire.Size = SIZE * 2
	fire.Heat = 20
	fire.Parent = meteor
	meteor.Parent = workspace
	meteor:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	-- Falls at an angle so it looks cool
	meteor.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-20, 20), -FALL_SPEED, math.random(-20, 20))

	local landed = false
	meteor.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		if landed or hit:IsDescendantOf(meteor) then
			return
		end
		landed = true
		local boom = Instance.new("Explosion")
		boom.Position = meteor.Position
		boom.BlastRadius = SIZE * 2
		boom.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0.3
		boom.Parent = workspace
		meteor:Destroy()
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(meteor, 10)
end

	dropMeteor()

scripts.title: NPC that follows players
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an NPC Model that has a Humanoid and a HumanoidRootPart (for example a Rig made with the Rig Builder in the Avatar tab).
scripts.about: The NPC walks after the nearest player, and can hurt them if you turn on TOUCH_DAMAGE.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")

-- Settings: change these!
local CHASE_DISTANCE = 100 -- players closer than this get followed
local STOP_DISTANCE = 5 -- stop walking this close to the player
local USE_PATHFINDING = false -- true = walks around walls
local TOUCH_DAMAGE = 0 -- set to 10 to make it a zombie that hurts

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
-- Unanchor the NPC so it can walk, and let the server move it smoothly
for _, part in ipairs(npc:GetDescendants()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") then
		part.Anchored = false
	end
end
pcall(function() root:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end)

-- Find the closest living player
local function findNearest()
	local nearest, nearestDistance = nil, CHASE_DISTANCE
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local theirRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local theirHumanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if theirRoot and theirHumanoid and theirHumanoid.Health > 0 then
			local distance = (theirRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
			if distance < nearestDistance then
				nearest, nearestDistance = theirRoot, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return nearest, nearestDistance
end

-- Walk toward a spot (around walls if pathfinding is on)
local function walkTo(position)
	if USE_PATHFINDING then
		local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, position)
		end)
		local waypoints = ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success and path:GetWaypoints()
		local nextPoint = waypoints and (waypoints[2] or waypoints[1])
		if nextPoint then
			if nextPoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
				humanoid.Jump = true
			end
			humanoid:MoveTo(nextPoint.Position)
			return
		end
	end
	humanoid:MoveTo(position)
end

-- Hurt players it touches (only if TOUCH_DAMAGE is more than 0)
local lastHit = {}
humanoid.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	local theirHumanoid = player and hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local now = os.clock()
	-- Only hurt the same player once per second
	if TOUCH_DAMAGE > 0 and theirHumanoid and now - (lastHit[player] or 0) >= 1 then
		lastHit[player] = now
		theirHumanoid:TakeDamage(TOUCH_DAMAGE)
	end
end)

-- Keep chasing while the NPC is alive
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
	local target, distance = findNearest()
	if target and distance > STOP_DISTANCE then
		walkTo(target.Position)
	end
	task.wait(0.25)
end

scripts.title: Particle burst helper (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage and name it Effects, then require it from any Script or LocalScript.
scripts.about: One line to make a burst of particles anywhere, like when you collect a coin or hit an enemy.
scripts.code:
--[[ How to use it:
	local Effects = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Effects)
	Effects.burst(somePart.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0), 30)  -- 30 yellow sparks
	Effects.ring(somePart.Position, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))              -- a quick flat ring of dust
]]

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local Effects = {}

-- Makes an invisible part to hold the particles for a moment
local function holderAt(position)
	local holder = Instance.new("Part")
	holder.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	holder.Transparency = 1
	holder.Anchored = true
	holder.CanCollide = false
	holder.CanQuery = false
	holder.CanTouch = false
	holder.Position = position
	holder.Parent = workspace
	Debris:AddItem(holder, 3)
	return holder
end

function Effects.burst(position, color, amount)
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.8
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.5, 0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 20)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8)
	emitter.Drag = 4
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = holderAt(position)
	emitter:Emit(amount or 20)
end

function Effects.ring(position, color)
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.8, 0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(15)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(0, 180) -- flat circle
	emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4)
	emitter.Drag = 5
	emitter.Rate = 0
	local holder = holderAt(position)
	holder.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
	emitter.Parent = holder
	emitter:Emit(40)
end

return Effects

scripts.title: Plant that grows in stages
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part sitting on the ground (the plant).
scripts.about: The plant grows bigger in stages and turns green, then can be harvested for coins and starts again as a seed.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local STAGES = 4
local SECONDS_PER_STAGE = 10
local HARVEST_COINS = 20

local plant = script.Parent
plant.Anchored = true
local fullSize = plant.Size
local bottomY = plant.Position.Y - fullSize.Y / 2 -- keep the bottom on the ground

local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Harvest"
prompt.ObjectText = "Plant"
prompt.Enabled = false
prompt.Parent = plant

local function setStage(stage)
	local fraction = stage / STAGES
	local size = fullSize * math.max(fraction, 0.15)
	local goal = {
		Size = size,
		Position = Vector3.new(plant.Position.X, bottomY + size.Y / 2, plant.Position.Z),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 110, 70):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 70), fraction),
	}
	TweenService:Create(plant, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), goal):Play()
end

local function grow()
	for stage = 0, STAGES do
		setStage(stage)
		if stage < STAGES then
			task.wait(SECONDS_PER_STAGE)
		end
	end
	prompt.Enabled = true -- ready to harvest!
end

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	prompt.Enabled = false
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if coins then
		coins.Value += HARVEST_COINS
	end
	task.spawn(grow)
end)

grow()

scripts.title: Plants swaying in the wind
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts and put your Anchored grass, flower and bush parts in a Folder named Plants in Workspace.
scripts.about: Gently rocks every plant back and forth like a breeze is blowing (on each player's screen, so it is smooth and free for the server).
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SWAY_DEGREES = 6
local SWAY_SPEED = 1.5

local folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Plants")
local plants = {}

-- Remember where each plant started, and pivot from its bottom so it bends like a stem
for _, part in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") then
		local bottom = part.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -part.Size.Y / 2, 0)
		table.insert(plants, {
			part = part,
			bottom = bottom,
			offset = bottom:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame),
			phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2, -- so they do not all move together
		})
	end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local t = os.clock() * SWAY_SPEED
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
	for _, plant in ipairs(plants) do
		-- Skip faraway plants to save time
		if (plant.bottom.Position - camera).Magnitude < 150 then
			local angle = math.rad(math.sin(t + plant.phase) * SWAY_DEGREES)
			plant.part.CFrame = plant.bottom * CFrame.Angles(angle, 0, angle * 0.5) * plant.offset
		end
	end
end)

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local MIN_WAIT, MAX_WAIT = 3, 10 -- seconds between stars
local HEIGHT = 400

local function isNight()
	return Lighting.ClockTime >= 19 or Lighting.ClockTime < 5
end

local function shootStar()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
	local start = camera + Vector3.new(math.random(-600, 600), HEIGHT, math.random(-600, 600))
	local finish = start + Vector3.new(math.random(-300, 300), -120, math.random(-300, 300))

	local star = Instance.new("Part")
	star.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
	star.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	star.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	star.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 230)
	star.Anchored = true
	star.CanCollide = false
	star.CanQuery = false
	star.CanTouch = false
	star.Position = start
	-- A trail makes the glowing tail
	local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.7, 0)
	a0.Parent = star
	local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.7, 0)
	a1.Parent = star
	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Attachment0 = a0
	trail.Attachment1 = a1
	trail.Lifetime = 0.6
	trail.LightEmission = 1
	trail.FaceCamera = true
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
	trail.Parent = star
	star.Parent = workspace

	local fly = TweenService:Create(star, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Position = finish, Transparency = 1 })
	fly:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(star, 2)
end

while true do
	task.wait(math.random(MIN_WAIT, MAX_WAIT))
	if isNight() then
		shootStar()
	end
end

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- Settings: change these! (hours, 0 to 24)
local LIGHTS_ON_AT = 18
local LIGHTS_OFF_AT = 6.5

local folder = workspace:WaitForChild("StreetLights")
local lightsOn = nil

local function setLights(on)
	for _, thing in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
		if thing:IsA("Light") then
			thing.Enabled = on
		elseif thing:IsA("BasePart") and thing:GetAttribute("Bulb") ~= false then
			-- Bulbs glow at night (give a part the attribute Bulb = false to skip it)
			thing.Material = on and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.Glass
		end

	local hour = Lighting.ClockTime
	local shouldBeOn = hour >= LIGHTS_ON_AT or hour < LIGHTS_OFF_AT
	if shouldBeOn ~= lightsOn then
		lightsOn = shouldBeOn
		setLights(lightsOn)
	end
end

Lighting:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ClockTime"):Connect(update)

scripts.title: Sunset and night colors
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService (works with any day and night cycle script).
scripts.about: Tints the whole world warm orange at sunrise and sunset and cool blue at night, changing smoothly with the time of day.
scripts.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- Settings: colors for each part of the day
local DAY = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local SUNSET = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 150)
local NIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(170, 190, 255)

local grade = Lighting:FindFirstChild("TimeOfDayGrade") or Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
grade.Name = "TimeOfDayGrade"
grade.Parent = Lighting

-- How close is a time to a target hour? (1 = right on it, 0 = far away)
local function closeness(hour, target, width)
	local distance = math.abs(hour - target)
	return math.clamp(1 - distance / width, 0, 1)
end

local function update()
	local hour = Lighting.ClockTime
	local sunsetAmount = math.max(closeness(hour, 6, 1.5), closeness(hour, 18, 1.5))
	local nightAmount = (hour < 5 or hour > 19.5) and 1 or math.max(closeness(hour, 4.5, 1), closeness(hour, 20, 1))
	local color = DAY:Lerp(SUNSET, sunsetAmount):Lerp(NIGHT, nightAmount)
	grade.TintColor = color
	grade.Saturation = 0.1 * sunsetAmount - 0.15 * nightAmount
end

Lighting:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ClockTime"):Connect(update)
update()

-- A ColorCorrection lets us darken and flash the whole screen

thunder.SoundId = THUNDER_SOUND_ID
thunder.Volume = 0.8

		if THUNDER_SOUND_ID ~= "" then
			thunder.PlaybackSpeed = 0.8 + math.random() * 0.4
			thunder:Play()
		end

		grade.Saturation = -0.3

			flash()
